description_en: Ringmaster shines 3 spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for 0.3 seconds after leaving the light.
description_zh: 百戏大王用3束聚光灯照亮一片区域。灯光下的敌人有几率丢失攻击，隐身状态下也会显形。被光束击中的幻象会逐渐消散，每秒失去一定百分比的最大生命值。这些效果在灯束离开后会粘滞0.3秒。
lore_en: Are you ready for your fifteen seconds? The limelight draws no distinction between infamy and fame.
lore_zh: 上台的十五秒你准备好了吗？聚光灯下不必在意自己的名声。

description_en:
Use: Saddle Up
Summons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for 10 seconds. 1.5s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than 20 dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.
description_zh:
使用：上车
召唤一辆快速的独轮车并骑上去，持续10秒。上车1.5秒后受到来自敌方英雄的伤害超过20点会让他下车。撞到树木会将其摧毁，并且独轮车会减速。攻击、使用持续施法类技能或者撞到单位和其他障碍物都会使他下车。

description_en: Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the 2 furthest enemy units within Enchantress' attack range + 100.
description_zh: 向后跳跃，躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道，并向魅惑魔女的攻击距离+100范围内最远的2个敌方单位发动一次附有推进的攻击。
lore_en: Sproink is as Sproink does.
lore_zh: 跃动就是活跃灵动。

description_en:
Supercharges Clockwerks abilities:

Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.
Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.
Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target.
Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.
Jetpack: Moves faster.

Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.
description_zh:
使发条技师的所有技能变得强力：

弹幕冲击：作用范围提升，并且可以作用于范围内所有敌人。
能量齿轮：成型范围提升，并且发条技师靠近能量齿轮时护甲提升。
照明火箭：伤害、视野和减速时间提升，并且发射时向目标两侧各额外发射一枚。
发射钩爪：眩晕范围和时间均有提升。
喷气背包：移动得更快。

持续时间结束后发条技师的移动和攻击速度降到最低。
lore_en: Rattletrap understands the limitations of his armor. Just as he understands the risks of pushing past them in times of need.
lore_zh: 瑞托崔普明白他装甲的局限性。就像他明白在必要的情况下越界的风险。

special_values.name: hookshot_radius_bonus_pct
special_values.heading_zh: 发射钩爪额外作用范围：

special_values.name: hookshot_duration_bonus_pct
special_values.heading_zh: 发射钩爪额外眩晕时间：

special_values.name: rocket_flare_duration_pct
special_values.heading_zh: 照明火箭额外持续时间：

description_en: In MegaMeepo form, Meepo flings the topmost meepo towards a target within a 900 range, dealing damage and slowing their movement speed.
description_zh: 在超大米波形态下，米波将最上端的米波向900范围内目标扔出，造成伤害和减速。
lore_en: You go first!
lore_zh: 你先上！
notes_en: Does not trigger spell reflect.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术反弹。

description_en: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain 40% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within 1200 range of each other.
description_zh: 狼人撕咬友方英雄或类英雄单位，使其获得变身效果。自身和目标都获得40%吸血效果，并且双方距离只要不超过1200就能共用吸血效果。
lore_en: Does this bite look infected?
lore_zh: 咬的这一口像是被传染了吗？
notes_en: Wolf Bite cooldown matches the cooldown of the current level of Shapeshift.
notes_zh: 饿狼撕咬的冷却时间与变身的当前等级相同。

description_en: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through. Does 35% less damage to creeps.
description_zh: 朝目标地点制造藤蔓。藤蔓对穿过的敌人造成减速和伤害。对非英雄单位造成的伤害减少35%。
lore_en: The tendrils of Rooftrellen's influence stretch to all corners of the forest.
lore_zh: 带有鲁夫特伦影响力的卷须延伸到了森林的各个角落。

description_en:
CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows with a range of Drow's Attack Range + 475. Lasts up to 1.75 seconds.

Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.
description_zh:
持续施法 - 卓尔游侠在最多1.75秒内不断地射出阵阵箭矢，对卓尔游侠攻击距离 + 475的距离内击中的敌人造成额外伤害，并施加霜冻之箭效果。

卓尔游侠在施放数箭齐发时可以缓慢移动和使用物品。
lore_en: In the ranger's youth, learning to fire multiple arrows at once was considered a distracting frivolity. In the war of the Ancients, such technique has become strange necessity.
lore_zh: 在游侠的童年，学习同时射出多支箭矢被视为不够专心的轻浮行为。而在遗迹的大战中，这样的技巧奇特地成为了必要。
notes_en: Arrow base damage pierces magic immunity.
Frost Arrows' damage and slow do not pierce magic immunity.
notes_zh: 箭矢的基础伤害无视减益免疫。
霜冻之箭的额外伤害和减速效果不无视减益免疫。

name_zh: +2% 顽皮克敌生命/魔法回复
+20% 竭心光环降低生命恢复

description_en: CHANNELED - Ringmaster twirls his whip for up to 1 second then cracks it. Whipped enemies are damaged and flee in fear from Ringmaster. Channel time exponentially increases damage and extends the fear duration, but reduces the radius.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 百戏大王卷起他的鞭子，最多持续1秒，然后猛甩出去。被鞭打的敌人会受到伤害，并且被恐惧，逃离百戏大王。持续施法时间会使伤害和恐惧时间成倍增加，但是作用范围减少。
lore_en: From unhappy crowds to unruly acts, nothing persuades a pack of animals quite like the crack of the Ringmaster's whip.
lore_zh: 从难以取悦的观众到难以驾驭的表演，对于一群动物，百戏大王手中的长鞭最具有说服力。

description_en: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.
description_zh: 把一名友方英雄装进可动的异维度箱子。友军被装入后拥有相位移动状态，获得额外魔法抗性、减速抗性和移动速度。并且无法成为目标，被锁闭、沉默和缴械。效果结束后或者移动到初始区域之外箱子都会打开。
lore_en: An adept assistant has nothing to fear within the confines of The Box. An amateur has...much darker prospects indeed.
lore_zh: 熟练的助手在道具箱内不必心惊胆战。而业余的助手……前景就黯淡多了。
scepter_en: Escape Act has 2 charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.
scepter_zh: 逃生技拥有2点能量点数。逃生箱打开时会朝所有方向放出尖刀戏匕首，并且范围内所有敌人受到伤害。

description_en:
Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by -50%.

Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than 0.5 seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after 4 seconds.
description_zh:
百戏大王推出奇观轮向目标地点滚去，击退沿途的敌人。到达目的地后，范围内的敌人会持续受到伤害，并且被减速-50%。

敌方英雄面对转轮超过0.5秒会被迷住，朝其走去。首个敌人着迷后会触发转轮爆炸的倒计时。如果没有触发倒计时，在4秒后转轮会自动爆炸。
lore_en: No, brave friends, illusions are for charlatans and card sharks. What you witness today is the power of true magic. But only if you dare set your gaze upon...the mesmerizing wheel.
lore_zh: 不，勇敢的朋友们，幻术是骗子和赌徒的把戏。今天你见证的是魔法的真正力量。但前提是要敢于凝视……迷人的转轮。

description_en: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.
description_zh: 百戏大王向自己精心选择的地点扔出一把匕首。匕首击中敌人会造成即时伤害，短暂减速击中的单位，并且使他们流血。流血的英雄受到基于目标最大生命值一定百分比的每秒伤害，流血的非英雄单位受到每秒固定伤害。
lore_en: Passed down through generations, it simply wouldn't be a Kettle Circus without the Great Cogliostro's signature trick.
lore_zh: 代代相传的表演，少了伟大的科里奥斯特罗的招牌戏法，那就不能称之为卡特尔马戏团。

special_values.name: bleed_health_pct
special_values.heading_zh: 每秒最大生命值伤害（英雄）：

description_en:
Ringmaster receives a random single-use Dark Carnival Souvenir whenever an enemy hero dies within 925 units of him. Additional Souvenirs are held as charges.

If Ringmaster does not have a Souvenir when he dies he will be granted one.
description_zh:
只要百戏大王附近925范围内有敌方英雄阵亡，他就会随机获得一件可用一次的暗黑狂欢纪念品。额外的纪念品会以能量的形式存下。

如果百戏大王没有纪念品，阵亡时会获得一件。

description_en:
Use: Proportion Distortion
Creates 1 imperfect image of your hero that lasts 18 seconds. Your illusion deals 100% and takes 300% damage.
description_zh:
使用：比例失真
制造英雄的1个不完美幻象，持续18秒。幻象继承100%攻击力，承受300%伤害。
notes_en: Has a 0.2 second cast time during which you are invulnerable.
notes_zh: 有0.2秒的施法时间，其间处于无敌状态。

description_en:
Use: Whoopsie
Propels your hero forward 400 units. Leaves a 250 radius stink cloud behind for 3 seconds that slows enemies by -30%.
description_zh:
使用：噗
把英雄向前推动400距离。在身后留下一团250范围的臭云，持续3秒，使敌人减速-30%。

description_en:
Use: Forcefully Imbibe
Temporarily increases an allied hero's Strength by 5 plus 1 per Ringmaster's level for 8 seconds. The effect holds for 4 seconds and then deteriorates over the duration.
description_zh:
使用：强力吸收
暂时提升友方英雄的力量，数值为5 + 1 * 百戏大王等级，持续8秒。效果会维持4秒然后在持续时间内不断减弱。

name_en: Escape Act Grants Strong Dispel and Flying
name_zh: 逃生技提供强驱散和飞行状态

name_en: +150 Wheel of Wonder Radius and Range
+15 Cold Embrace Base Heal Per Second
name_zh: +15 极寒之拥基础每秒治疗

description_en: Performs a short Omnislash for 1 seconds.
description_zh: 发动一次短时间的无敌斩，持续1秒。
lore_en: A briefer onslaught for those less deserving of the honor.
lore_zh: 为了不配获得荣耀的人准备的短暂猛攻。

description_en: Causes a wave to travel outwards in all directions forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact and dealing damage, and grants Terrorblade Metamorphosis for a short time.
description_zh: 放出一道能量波，朝所有方向向外行进，击中敌方英雄将使其恐惧并造成伤害，同时恐怖利刃短时间内获得魔化状态。
lore_en: A shockwave of power strong enough to break the walls of Foulfell itself.
lore_zh: 一道威力十足的冲击波，可以冲破荒邪之狱的障壁。

name_en: 50 Attack Speed on Open Wounds Target

description_en: Enemy units in range of Sand Storm have their movement speed slowed by 35% and miss 35% of their attacks.
description_zh: 沙尘暴范围内敌方单位的移动速度将被减缓35%，攻击有35%几率落空。

name_en: +15 Movespeed to Beastmaster and his summons
name_zh: 兽王及其召唤物+15 移速
description_en: The Movespeed Aura is global, persists through death, and affects Beastmaster and all his summons.
description_zh: 移动速度光环为全地图生效，死亡后依然有效，作用于兽王和他的所有召唤物。

name_zh: 窃取的技能-40% 魔法消耗

name_en: +125 Frost Blast Radius and Area Damage
name_zh: +125 寒霜爆发范围/范围伤害

description_en: Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause Leshrac to take amplified damage.
description_zh: 使拉席克和范围内所有敌人变为虚无状态，他们无法攻击，并且承受的魔法伤害增加，移动速度被减缓。拉席克的移动速度得到提升，而不是减缓。拉席克受到的魔法伤害不会增加。
lore_en: When it serves his purpose, Leshrac briefly reduces his presence in the Terrene Plane.
lore_zh: 拉席克可以暂时减少他在尘世位面的存在，只要这能助他达成目的。

name_en: +20 Finger of Death Damage Per Kill
name_zh: +20 死亡之指每次击杀伤害

description_en:
Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for 3s. Restores 25% of his max health over that duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
description_zh:
挖掘进入地下，对自身施加驱散效果，无敌且不能作为目标，持续3秒。持续时间内回复最大生命值的25%。被缠绕时无法施放。

驱散类型：弱驱散
lore_en: I'm diggin' here!
lore_zh: 我在这挖呀挖呀挖！

description_en: Releases a Tidal Wave that spawns behind Kunkka. Deals damage and drags enemies along it. Enemies cannot attack while being dragged.
description_zh: 释放一道在昆卡身后出现的潮汐波。造成点伤害，并将敌人沿着波浪拖拽距离。敌人被拖拽时无法攻击。
lore_en: A good sailor knows the timing of the tides like the back of his hand.
lore_zh: 优秀的水手对潮汐的时间了如指掌。

name_en: +250 Health to Beastmaster and his summons
name_zh: 兽王及其召唤物+250 生命
description_en: The Max Health Aura is global, persists through death, and affects Beastmaster and all his summons.
description_zh: 生命上限光环为全地图生效，死亡后依然有效，作用于兽王和他的所有召唤物。

name_zh: +6 维萨吉和佣兽基础攻击力

description_en: Bouncing attacks deal 50% damage.
description_zh: 弹射攻击造成50%伤害。

description_en: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.
description_zh: 发条技师开动喷气背包，获得飞行移动状态，飞行视野和移动速度加成。发条技师的转身速率大幅降低，并且无法攻击。在加成状态的持续时间内可以开启和关闭喷气背包。
lore_en: Sure it's blown up over fourteen testing dummies, but at least they all flew!
lore_zh: 的确是炸掉了十四个测试的假人，但至少他们都飞起来了！

description_en: Passively grants Lifestealer Attack Speed.
description_zh: 被动提升噬魂鬼的攻击速度。
lore_en: Distant memories of the Vile Council fuel one mind to plotting and the other to more immediate dark ends.
lore_zh: 对邪恶议会的遥远记忆让一个意识开始策划，而另一个则是马上实施暗黑的手段。

description_en: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.
description_zh: 巫医暂时变成死亡守卫，死亡守卫的攻击速度有所降低。这段时间内自己为隐藏状态。

description_en: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets 900 unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.
description_zh: 宙斯作出神圣一跳，向前跳跃并震击最近的可见敌人（以英雄优先），造成伤害，并减缓其移动速度、攻击速度。宙斯获得附近900范围的顺畅视野，持续3秒。
lore_en: Though temporarily barred from the heavens, Zeus can still manage a measure of godly flight.
lore_zh: 尽管宙斯暂时被禁止进入天界，但他还是可以进行一定程度上的神圣飞行。

description_en:
Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
description_zh:
炼金术士向友军目标扔出一瓶药剂，施加弱驱散效果，并提供攻击速度、移动速度和生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散
lore_en: After Razzil's great grandfather tested an early version of this potion on himself, a surviving family member immediately saw the profit potential.
lore_zh: 拉泽尔的曾祖父在他自己身上试验了这种药水的早期版本，之后一名幸存的家族成员马上看到了潜在的商机。

description_en: Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.
description_zh: 向目标地点咳出一团满是刺针的毛团。毛团会在该地点爆开，范围内的敌人都将受到多个鼻液叠加效果和单次刺针扫射的作用。
lore_en: Every part of Bristleback's body is a weapon -- even the parts he accidentally swallowed.
lore_zh: 钢背兽身体的每个部位都是武器——就连他不小心吞下的也是。

description_en: Creates a shield around the target ally, absorbing a percentage of the damage of next 3 attacks from enemy heroes. When damage is absorbed, a fireball is launched at the attacker. Can be cast on towers.
description_zh: 创造一个围绕友军目标的护盾，吸收接下来3次来自敌方英雄攻击的一定百分比伤害。吸收伤害后向攻击者发射火球。可以对防御塔施放。
lore_en: There is immense luck involved in Aggron not just setting friends on fire.
lore_zh: 阿格隆没把火放到朋友身上就已经是走了大运了。
notes_en: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an 1000 area of effect to receive Fire Shield.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，1000范围内的友方单位将随机获得烈火护盾效果。

description_en: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend 0.6 seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.
description_zh: 马格纳斯顶起前方的敌人，将其甩在身后。敌人受到伤害，滞空0.6秒并处于眩晕状态，而且落地后还会眩晕一段时间。
lore_en: Survivors of Joerlak will never forget the sight of Magnus tossing countless enemies into rivers of fire and clouds of ash.
lore_zh: 杰尔拉克山的幸存者不会忘记那一幕，马格纳斯把无数的敌人抛进火焰的河流和灰烬的云朵。

description_en: Releases a flame in the direction Timbersaw is facing. Applies a debuff that deals damage per second and slows enemy movement speed. Affects buildings for reduced damage.
description_zh: 伐木机向面朝的方向放出一道火焰。施加一个负面效果，造成每秒伤害，并减缓敌人的移动速度。对建筑造成的伤害有所减少。
lore_en: A single saw can only cut so much. A single spark can burn forever.
lore_zh: 一把锯子只能砍那么点东西。一个火花可以永远燃烧下去。

description_en: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.
description_zh: 以矢量为目标。召唤出一阵强风，将目标区域内所有敌人朝目标方向推去。
lore_en: At last Lyralei has learned to call upon the might of her true birthright.
lore_zh: 莱瑞蕾终于学会召唤她真正本源的力量。

name_zh: +40% 余烬佳酿伤害/持续时间

description_en:
Omniknight imbues his hammer with holy power, causing his attack to have increased range, deal pure damage based on a percentage of his base damage and slow his target for a short duration.

Omniknight heals for 40% of the damage dealt over 4s.
description_zh:
全能骑士将神圣之力注入他的战锤，使他的攻击距离提升，会根据基础攻击力的一定百分比造成纯粹伤害，并且使目标短时间内被减速。

全能骑士会在4秒内回复40%造成的伤害。
lore_en: The knight is merely a means to move the hammer.
lore_zh: 骑士仅仅是让锤子动起来的一种手段。

name_en: Attacks apply 1 Stack of Sticky Napalm

description_en: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.
description_zh: 点燃一片区域，对其中的敌人持续造成伤害，伤害效果还会粘滞。近战形态下施放距离较近。
lore_en: Most Dragon Knights name no greater horror than the scourge of dragon's fire.
lore_zh: 大多数龙骑士声称的恐怖莫过于让生灵涂炭的龙火。

description_en: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position. Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.
description_zh: 瘟疫法师变成一个大死亡脉冲，向目标单位的地点移动。到达该地点后，死亡脉冲会扩散至附近敌人和友军。
lore_en: The Rumusque Faithful consider Necrophos to be more plague than person.
lore_zh: 鲁姆斯克的信徒认为瘟疫法师比起人更像是瘟疫。
notes_en: Does not trigger spell reflect.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术反弹。

description_en: Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.
description_zh: 幻影刺客对附近范围内敌人放出尖利的刀刃，击中时造成每名受害者最大生命值一定百分比的伤害并施加破坏效果。
lore_en: A sister is generally given a single name, but powerful names often have plentiful allies.
lore_zh: 通常魅影之纱只会赋予一个名字，但是多个强大的名字意味着众多的盟友。

name_zh: +5% 侵略大军移速加成/承伤降低
+25% 灵魂形态光明速度加成

description_en: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed. Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for 2s.
description_zh: 维萨吉获得飞行移动状态和移动速度加成。攻击或施法后，将失去移速加成和飞行移动状态，同时维萨吉和他的佣兽在2秒内拥有额外攻击力。
lore_en: Those on the mortal plane are blind to the stirrings of the agents of the afterlife.
lore_zh: 来世的媒介在尘世间四处扰动，但世人视而不见。
scepter_en: Increases movement speed, damage, and duration. Turns Visage and familiars invisible for the duration until the flying movement is lost.
scepter_zh: 移动速度、额外攻击力和持续时间提升。维萨吉和佣兽在持续时间内为隐身状态，直到失去飞行移动状态。

description_en: Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past 3 seconds. Max power is reached after 1100 distance moved.
description_zh: 被动技能。使黑暗贤者下次对英雄的攻击具有克敌机先效果，可以打出目标的复制体，并且根据过去3秒内黑暗贤者的移动距离造成伤害和眩晕。移动1100距离以上将造成最大威力。
lore_en: As a young soldier, long before he became a leader of his people, Ish'Kafel was known amongst his fellow recruits as quite the pugilist.
lore_zh: 早在依什卡菲尔成为族人的领袖之前，他身为年轻的士兵在战友中就被称为拳击手。

description_en: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.
description_zh: 向目标区域扔出一枚手雷，对敌人造成伤害并将他们和狙击手一同击退。受到作用的敌人被击退后还会被缴械和减速。
lore_en: ATTN: IN CASE OF DANGER PULL PIN
lore_zh: 注意：如有危险，请拔出插销

description_en: Costs part of Terrorblade's current HP to cast, providing Terrorblade and nearby illusions bonus movement, HP Regen and attack speed. Does not affect Reflection illusions. Can't be cast while in Metamorphosis and Metamorphosis will remove Demon Zeal.
description_zh: 施放需消耗恐怖利刃当前生命值的一部分，为恐怖利刃和他附近的幻象提供生命恢复、移动和攻击速度加成。不会影响倒影的幻象。魔化状态下无法施放，而且施放魔化会移除狂魔效果。
lore_en: Fear is fueled by confusion when Terrorblade's enemies see that the first cut he makes is one to embolden himself.
lore_zh: 当恐怖利刃的敌人发现他砍出的第一刀是为了给自己壮胆，他们的困惑加剧了恐惧。

description_en: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy that turns them into stone for 1s.
description_zh: 美杜莎受到指向性技能作用后会对该敌人放出单体的秘术异蛇，把他们变成石头，持续1秒。
lore_en: Point your gaze at her if you dare.
lore_zh: 要是有胆就把目光放她身上。

name_zh: 月之暗面提供+20% 闪避
description_en: Evasion works at all times during the buff
description_zh: 闪避在状态效果内始终有效

name_en: Debuff Immunity While Channeling Tame the Beasts
name_zh: 驯兽术持续施法时减益免疫
description_en: Also grants 50% magic resistance.
description_zh: 另外还提供50%魔法抗性。

description_en: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.
description_zh: 在目标地点创造一团云雾。作用范围内所有友军为隐藏状态，受到暗影之舞的作用。
lore_en: Nothing worse than a job going bad thanks to some clompy-footed friend.
lore_zh: 没有比搞砸更难受的事了，全怪某个笨手笨脚的朋友。

name_en: Earth Spike affects a 30 degree cone
+15% To Hell And Back Debuff/Spell Amp
name_zh: +15% 下地狱再上来负面状态/技能增强
+15%/300 瞥视距离转为伤害/最高伤害
查克拉魔法施加强驱散

name_en: 160 DPS in 700 Radius Around Fiend's Gate
name_zh: 恶魔之扉对700范围内造成每秒160伤害

name_en: +1 Agility gain/stolen per Essence Shift Stack
name_zh: +1 能量转移敏捷获取/失去

description_en: Max Fear duration increased by +0.45s
description_zh: 最长恐惧持续时间提升+0.45秒

description_en: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magical damage to an enemy hero with his abilities, he gains a small magic damage barrier. Each buff stacks independently.
description_zh: 每次天怒法师用技能对敌方英雄造成魔法伤害时，他都会获得小型的魔法伤害护盾。每个加成状态独立叠加。
lore_en: The court mages of Skywrath may only deploy their magic in defense of the kingdom and the throne.
lore_zh: 天怒王国的当朝法师只能使用他们的法力来保卫王国和王座。

name_en: +8 Upheaval Attack Speed per second on Allies
name_zh: 剧变每秒向友军提供+8 攻速
description_en: Maximum of +70 Attack Speed
description_zh: 最高+70 攻击速度

name_zh: +6 时间膨胀每个冷却技能提供每秒伤害
毒刺降低15% 生命恢复

description_en: Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for 3.5 seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least 1500 away from each other.
description_zh: 打开2个传送门，一个在孽主身旁，另一个在目标地点。英雄可以对一个传送门持续施法3.5秒，传送至另一端。传送门之间的距离必须超过1500。
lore_en: They come without warning, leaving fire and blood where kingdoms once flourished.
lore_zh: 他们的到来全无征兆，王国曾经繁荣的地方只剩下烈火和血海。
notes_en: Double-click to teleport to your team's base, in front of your fountain
notes_zh: 双击会在己方基地的泉水前打开另一个传送门。
scepter_en: Summons a Pit of Malice around each of the portals. Reduces cooldown.
scepter_zh: 在传送门两端各召唤一个怨念深渊。减少冷却时间。

name_zh: -125% 混沌之军幻象承受伤害

description_en: Broodmother may create up to 5 invisible web lines touching any existing web. Enemy Heroes that cross the web line will spring the trap, becoming rooted, revealed in fog, and take damage over time. Multiple Heroes can trip on the same line until it's destroyed after being initially triggered. Broodmother's team is alerted via the minimap when an enemy has triggered the snare.
description_zh: 育母蜘蛛可以制造出最多5个触碰已有蛛网的隐形网线。敌方英雄穿过网线将会触发陷阱，被缠绕，在战争迷雾中显形，并持续受到伤害。网线一开始被触发后，多名英雄还可以在同根网线上被绊倒，直到网线被摧毁。只要有人触发陷阱，育母蜘蛛的队友就会在小地图上发现。
lore_en: The slightest tremor of her web is all Arachnia needs to find her prey.
lore_zh: 蛛网上细微的颤动就是艾拉齐娜找到猎物所需要的一切。

description_en: Lobs a Sticky Bomb towards the target area. If it lands next to an enemy hero, the bomb will stick to it, slowing its movement speed. After a few seconds the bomb will explode, dealing damage in an area around the detonation and applying a secondary slow for 3 seconds.
description_zh: 向目标区域抛出一个粘性炸弹。如果炸弹落在一个敌方英雄身旁，炸弹会粘上去，减缓其移动速度。数秒后炸弹会爆炸，对爆炸区域内造成伤害，并再次施加减速，持续3秒。
lore_en: Such revolutionary brilliance was meant to be shared.
lore_zh: 这样革命性的才华本应与他人分享。

description_en:
Techies trigger an electric charge on the target ally, giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time. Enemies attacking the target take damage and are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel.

At the end of the effect or if detonated early with the sub-ability, the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius and dealing damage.
description_zh:
工程师对友军目标放出电荷，使他们短时间内获得移动速度加成。攻击目标的敌人会受到伤害被暂时缴械，并且受到弱驱散效果。

效果结束时，或者用子技能提前引爆后电荷将会爆炸，使范围内所有敌人缴械并受到伤害。
lore_en: A steady bomb hand prefers an abundance of personal space.
lore_zh: 想要双手稳稳地握住炸弹更需要大量个人空间。

description_en: Grants Debuff Immunity with 60% magic resistance, as well as bonus HP Regen.
description_zh: 提供减益免疫状态和60%魔法抗性，以及额外生命恢复。
lore_en: The All Seeing One casts down his protection over those that Purist calls friend.
lore_zh: 全知之主对那些被普利斯特称为“朋友”的人降下保护结界。

name_zh: 隔空取物着陆造成300 伤害

name_en: +1.5% Wild Axes Damage Amp Per Stack
name_zh: +1.5% 野性之斧每次伤害加深

description_en:
Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for 2 seconds.

The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
description_zh:
向一个敌人扔出一枚光弹，造成伤害，将其向远离修补匠的方向传送并且缠绕，同时降低施法和攻击距离，持续2秒。

目标距离修补匠越近，传送距离越大。
lore_en: Tinker's deadliest weapon instantly turns an enemy into space dust. Research to resolve the annoying 'perfect copy' side effect... is ongoing.
lore_zh: 修补匠最致命的武器能瞬间将敌人化为太空尘埃。研究如何解决令人讨厌的 “完美复制” 副作用... 还在进行中。
notes_en: Max teleportation distance is 60% of Warp Flare's cast range, which decreases down to 0 at max cast range.
notes_zh: 最大传送距离为60%折跃耀光施法距离，在最大施法距离时降至0。

description_en:
Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration. At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
description_zh:
净愈目标友方单位，在持续时间内移除负面效果。在持续时间结束时该单位受到治疗效果。崩裂禁锢中的单位依然可以受到邪恶净愈的效果。

驱散类型：弱驱散
lore_en: The only one permitted to harm his more useful followers is Shadow Demon himself.
lore_zh: 唯一容许伤害他的追随者的，就是暗影恶魔本人。
notes_en: Negative buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Cleanse.
notes_zh: 净愈的持续时间内将持续移除目标的负面状态。

name_en: +2.5% Astral Spirit Bonus Move Speed Per Hero
name_zh: +2.5% 灵体游魂触碰英雄移速

description_en: Brings forth rain to the target area. Enemies standing in the area receive damage and have reduced Heal Amplification. Allies in the area heal and have increased incoming Heal Amplification.
description_zh: 在目标范围内降下大雨。站在该区域的敌人受到每秒伤害，并且治疗增强被削弱。区域内友军被治疗，并且具有治疗增强效果。
lore_en: Through mixture of the astral and the atmospheric, Nerif bends a single reality into paradoxical alignment.
lore_zh: 通过将精神与大气相混合，奈里夫把单一的现实扭曲成矛盾的结合。

description_en: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.
description_zh: 使莉娜获得顺畅的移动状态，并且提升技能伤害和魔法抗性。开启时获得炽魂的最高叠加层数。
lore_en: A natural defense equally suited to keeping anything from unwanted sisters to snarling hellbeasts at bay.
lore_zh: 一道天然的屏障，不论是拦住讨厌的姐妹还是可怕的野兽都能轻松做到。

name_en: Hand of God applies a Strong Dispel

description_en: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a 450 AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.
description_zh: 向一个方向滑行，在原地制造一个自身的冰晶克隆，并且躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。如果克隆受到了足量伤害，或者超过一定时间都会碎裂，对附近450范围内敌人施加冰封禁制。克隆体也可以被水晶室女自身的技能摧毁。
lore_en: So convincing that some allies have spent minutes talking to the clone before they realized she wasn't speaking back.
lore_zh: 非常逼真，有些盟友和克隆体聊了几分钟才发现她没有回应。

description_en: Increases Slow Burn Damage to 80%
description_zh: 慢热的伤害提升至80%

description_en: Deals 50% damage to buildings.
description_zh: 对建筑造成50%伤害。

description_en: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for 6 seconds.
description_zh: 魅惑魔女缠绕一个敌方单位。目标附近所有敌方、友方和中立非英雄单位会攻击魅惑魔女选定的目标，并且具有攻击速度和移动速度加成，持续6秒。
lore_en: The laws of the forest may be oblique, but punishment for breaking them is swift and smiling.
lore_zh: 森林的法则可能有点模糊，但违反法则的惩罚会来得非常迅速，而且迷人。

special_values.name: root_per_target
special_values.heading_zh: 每个单位增加缠绕时间：

description_en: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a 500 AoE for 4 seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.
description_zh: 冥界亚龙冲向地面，释放幽冥剧毒并且500范围内所有敌人均被溅上持续4秒的腐蚀皮肤酸液。
lore_en: It was thought that Netherdrake wings touch ground only in death, but some surmise that those who've witnessed more intentional landings merely haven't survived to tell the tale.
lore_zh: 世人认为冥界亚龙的翅膀只有在死亡时才会碰到地面，不过也有揣测是有人见证了更为刻意的着陆，只是没能活着说出他的故事。

description_en: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.
description_zh: 巴拉森获得魔法抗性，并扭曲选定英雄附近的现实，使敌方英雄施放的任意指向性技能转向裂魂人。可以对友方和敌方英雄施放，但是只有裂魂人的敌人施放的技能才会转向。
lore_en: Barathrum's unyielding focus forms a pocket of planar convergence from which not even the most powerful arcane energies can escape.
lore_zh: 巴拉森顽强的专注力形成了位面汇聚点的空洞，就连最强大的奥术能量也无法逃逸。
notes_en: Planar Pocket's effect stops if Barathrum moves 900 units away from the target.
notes_zh: 如果裂魂人和目标之间的距离超过900，位面空洞效果会停止。

name_zh: 旋风飞斧无视减益免疫

description_en:
Primal Beast charges up and then runs in the chosen direction, knocking back enemies and allies alike. Enemy units are damaged and stunned on impact. The longer the charge duration, the farther Primal Beast's momentum will carry him.

Can be cancelled at any time with the Stop command.
description_zh:
獸积蓄力量再向选定方向冲去，将敌人和队友同时击退。敌方单位被撞时受到伤害，并且被眩晕。蓄力时间越长，獸冲的距离越远。

可以随时使用停止指令来中止。
lore_en: The Beast's single-minded focus on chosen prey leaves all other considerations scattered in his ruinous wake.
lore_zh: 獸对眼中猎物的专一让其他犹豫不决的人在他毁灭性的冲击下四散而逃。

description_en: Primal Beast stomps over everything. For every 140 units traveled, all enemies around the Beast receive damage. Deals base damage plus a multiplier of Primal Beast's attack damage. Primal Beast is disarmed for the duration of the ability.
description_zh: 獸践踏一切。每行进140距离就会对獸附近范围内所有敌人造成伤害。伤害量为基础伤害加上獸攻击力的一定系数。獸在技能期间被缴械。
lore_en: As the only member of his species to arrive on this world, locals can only speculate on the Beast's size relative to his kin. Such observation would prove easier of course if the subject didn't eat everything it sees and destroy most of what it doesn't.
lore_zh: 由于獸是他的种族中唯一一个来到这个世上，当地人只能通过他的亲戚来推测獸的尺寸。要不是观测的目标会吃掉看到的一切，又消灭了大部分看不到的，那这样的观测肯定会容易很多。

description_en:
The Beast's temper causes every instance of 50 hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar.

When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for 7 seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.
description_zh:
獸的脾性使獸每次受到的敌方英雄伤害超过50点后就会获得咤的叠加效果。

主动施放后，獸释放出咆哮声，减速附近敌人，并且獸根据咤的当前叠加层数获得额外攻击力和护甲，持续7秒。
lore_en: Already draped in a broken patchwork of barding and chains upon appearing in the mistwoods, the Beast tolerates no further attempts at subjugation.
lore_zh: 在永雾林渊现身时獸就已身披破碎的锁链，如今他不会容许任何征服的企图。
notes_en: Primal Beast cannot gain Uproar stacks from self damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
notes_zh: 獸对自身造成伤害无法获得咤的叠加效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
scepter_en: When Primal Beast activates Uproar, he releases 3 waves of 2 projectiles per stack of uproar each in a circle around him. Projectiles deal damage and Break enemies hit. After a short delay, each projectile splinters in two.
scepter_zh: 獸开启咤时，以自身为圆心施放出3波弹道，每波每层咤的叠加效果有2个弹道。弹道造成伤害并对击中的敌人施加破坏效果。经过短暂延迟后每个弹道会分裂成两个。

special_values.name: roared_bonus_armor
special_values.heading_zh: 每层叠加咆哮护甲加成：

description_en: CHANNELED - Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing the target enemy and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and mini-stunning any enemies caught in the AoE. Each consecutive hit deals bonus damage. Lasts 2.3 seconds.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 獸释放出他的怒火，抓起敌方目标，反复将其向地面捶击，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害和短暂眩晕。每次连续击中会造成额外伤害。持续2.3秒。
lore_en: Though none are certain whether his utterances have true meaning, most concede the Beast's powerful grip and tendency to smash his enemies into naught but pulp and pieces communicates his intent well enough.
lore_zh: 虽然没人能肯定獸的嘟哝声是否具有真正的含义，但大多数都会同意，獸强劲的握力还有将一切粉碎为肉酱的倾向充分表达了他的意图。

description_en: Applies a curse on all enemy heroes within 900 range, displaying them in fog, slowing them, and dealing damage over time based on the number of trees within 250 radius. Treants count as trees for this purpose.
description_zh: 对900范围内所有敌方英雄施加诅咒，使他们在迷雾中显形，根据250范围内树木的数量对他们造成减速和持续伤害。在此情况下树人也被视为树木。
lore_en: Though powerful, Nature's Prophet's gifts do not include all-sight, and he must rely heavily upon reconnaissance and aid from a long-standing network of stalwart friends.
lore_zh: 自然先知虽然天赋异禀，但是并非无所不见，他必须严重依赖忠实的朋友组成的天网为他提供侦查和援助。

description_en: Whenever the target takes damage, all enemies, including the target itself if it is an enemy, within 675 range of the target also receive a portion of that damage. Can target enemy and allied units. Effect is paused if the target is hidden by Disruption.
description_zh: 只要目标受到伤害，目标附近675范围内所有敌人，若目标为敌人那也包括目标自身，他们都将受到该伤害的一定百分比。可以对敌方或友方目标施放。敌人被崩裂禁锢隐藏时效果暂停。
lore_en: Friends and families share in the suffering when Shadow Demon finds a new victim.
lore_zh: 当暗影恶魔找到新的受害者，受害者的亲友也会遭受同样的痛苦。
notes_en: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

name_en: Greevil's Greed provides +3 Damage per stack
name_zh: 每层贪魔的贪婪+3 攻击力
-0.1秒 化学狂暴基础攻击间隔

description_en:
Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of 0.5s between hits after 20 attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase.

Using Primal Roar counts as 10 attacks.
description_zh:
兽王或周围他控制的单位攻击敌人都会使他敲下战鼓，对附近单位造成伤害，并且治疗自身和他控制的单位，数值为造成伤害的一定百分比。每次攻击都会降低敲鼓的间隔，20次攻击后降低至最短0.5秒敲击一次。如果没有发动攻击，敲鼓间隔会逐渐变长。

使用原始咆哮时自动增加10层敲鼓叠加效果。
lore_en: Nature's rage is timeless, and for those who know the secrets, it's easy to stir the echoes of ire that rejoiced in the downfall of Slom.
lore_zh: 自然的愤怒是永恒的，而知晓这个秘密的人就能非常轻松地重新激发在斯洛姆衰亡之际雀跃的怒火。

special_values.name: max_stacks
special_values.heading_zh: 最短间隔所需攻击次数：

description_en: Axes still must return to Beastmaster before they can be cast again.
description_zh: 双斧必须返回至兽王后才能再次施放。

name_en: Allies Receive Battle Trance Attack Speed
name_zh: 友军获得战斗专注攻击速度

description_en: +200 Attack Range when attacking an enemy affected by Poison Touch
description_zh: 攻击剧毒之触效果下敌人时+200 攻击距离

name_en: +14 All Attributes per hero hit with Reverse Polarity
name_zh: 两极反转每击中一名英雄+14 全属性
description_en: Bonus Stats last for 20s
description_zh: 属性加成持续20秒

name_en: 20% Hunter in the Night Status Resistance
name_zh: 暗夜猎影20% 状态抗性
+200 梦境缠绕初始/破碎伤害

name_en: Creates A Second Plasma Field Delayed By 0.8s
description_en: The second plasma field does 30% less damage
description_zh: 第二个等离子场造成的伤害减少30%

name_zh: 静电连接吸取攻击速度

description_en: Add a partial outer ring to Dissimilate
description_zh: 异化增加部分外圈

name_zh: 毁灭阴影施加攻击伤害
description_en: Does not apply attack modifiers.
description_zh: 不会施加攻击特效。

name_zh: +8/4% 钢毛后背背面/侧面减伤

description_en: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last 15s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.
description_zh: 造成等同于目标最大魔法值一定百分比的伤害，并燃烧部分魔法。另外还会根据过去15秒内目标受到来自司夜刺客的伤害再造成一定百分比的伤害。施加伤害前会重置累计伤害。
lore_en: Only those raised by the queen can use their minds to touch the world around them.
lore_zh: 只有虫后养育的才能使用他们的想法去触碰周围的世界。

description_en: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.
description_zh: 使一名敌人感染致命的瘟疫，施加时造成伤害，然后减速目标，并且基于目标的最大生命值造成持续伤害。不论负面状态以何种方式消失，瘟疫都会带着剧毒术士施加给初始目标的所有负面状态一起扩散到附近目标。第一次以外的额外扩散不会造成初始伤害。
lore_en: Deep in the heart of the jungles of Jidi, the seeds of extermination freely grow.
lore_zh: 在基迪岛丛林中心的深处，灭绝的种子自由地生长。
notes_en: Spread debuffs have fixed duration and are not modified by status resistance or debuff amplification.
notes_zh: 扩散的负面状态拥有固定的持续时间，不会受到状态抗性和负面状态增强的影响。
scepter_en: Decreases cooldown by 35 seconds. Infected units have decreased magic resistance. Additional spreads from hero targets deal full impact damage.
scepter_zh: 冷却时间减少35秒。感染的单位拥有的魔法抗性会降低。来自英雄目标的额外扩散会造成全额的击中伤害。

description_en:
Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a 600 radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains 40% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them.

When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals 50% more damage for each Meepo on top.
description_zh:
主米波将600范围内其他米波放到自己的肩膀上。在这个形态下，他会获得其他米波40%的属性，并且可以把他们扔向敌人，造成伤害和减速。

生效时地之束缚会产生额外的网，身上每只米波都会使忽悠造成额外50%伤害。
lore_en: Hi, Meepos!
lore_zh: 嘿，米波们！

description_en: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.
description_zh: 宙斯获得攻击速度加成，并且他的攻击会产生弧形闪电，造成一定百分比的伤害。可以关闭，使攻击不附带该效果。
lore_en: A helping hand from Aghanim lets the fallen Lord of Heaven tap into some of his old strengths.
lore_zh: 来自阿哈利姆的援手让跌落神坛的天界之王重新发挥出他昔日的部分力量。

description_en: Applies retroactively
description_zh: 具有追溯效果

description_en: Ogre Magi's max Intelligence is 0. He receives mana and mana regeneration from Strength.
description_zh: 食人魔魔法师的智力值上限为0。他通过力量来获得魔法和魔法恢复。

special_values.name: mana_per_str
special_values.heading_zh: 每点力量提供最大魔法：

special_values.name: mana_regen_per_str
special_values.heading_zh: 每点力量提供魔法恢复：

description_en:
Alchemist coats his weapons and empowers his spells with an acid that applies a stacking slow and base attack damage reduction to enemies hit.

Attacks apply 2 stacks. Unstable Concoction applies 1 stack per second of brew time.
description_zh:
炼金术士使他的武器浸满强酸，对击中的敌人施加可叠加的减速和基础攻击力降低效果。

每次攻击施加2层叠加效果。不稳定化合物每调制1秒施加1层叠加效果。
lore_en: A powerful solvent that turned out to work all too well.
lore_zh: 一种强大的溶剂，事实证明效果实在是太好了。

special_values.name: attack_dmg_per_stack
special_values.heading_en: BASE ATTACK DAMAGE REDUCTION PER STACK:
special_values.heading_zh: 每层叠加降低基础攻击力：

description_en:
Clinkz gains attack speed and has bonus attack range. Any current Skeleton Archers within a 1200 radius of Clinkz also gain bonus attack range and 40% of the attack speed bonus.

Casting Strafe does not break Skeleton Walk invisibility.
description_zh:
克林克兹获得攻击速度和攻击距离加成。克林克兹1200范围内现有的骷髅弓手也会获得攻击距离加成和40%攻击速度加成。

施放扫射不会脱离骨隐步的隐身状态。
lore_en: The closest Clinkz can come to peace is knowing that this was the last thing Maraxiform ever saw.
lore_zh: 克林克兹感到最接近平静的时刻，就是知道这一幕是莫拉格斯临终之所见。

description_en:
Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.

The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.
description_zh:
卓尔游侠在她脚下创造一片冰山，击退附近的敌人。站在山上的单位会获得飞行视野，而卓尔游侠和她的远程友军会获得攻击距离加成。卓尔游侠站在山上时攻击下方目标时获得额外伤害。

山的前面会阻挡视野，并且除了卓尔游侠外无法穿行。施放时不会打断数箭齐发。
lore_en: Traxex wasn't just adopted by the Drow, she was adopted by the lands they lived in.
lore_zh: 崔希丝不仅是被卓尔人收养，她还是被他们居住的大地所接纳。

name_zh: +350 新月之痕范围/最大距离

name_en: +150 Health / +25 Damage for Enchantress and her units
name_zh: 魅惑魔女及其单位+150 生命/+25 攻击力

description_en: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.
description_zh: 半人马战行者套上一辆便车。开启后半人马战行者获得当前等级奔袭冲撞的加成效果，而且可以对友方目标施放便车。
lore_en: It is a great honor to be offered a ride by Centaur Warrunner and a grave mistake to refuse it.
lore_zh: 能够得到半人马战行者的搭乘邀请是莫大的荣幸，而拒绝则是严重的错误。

description_en: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is 0.5s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.
description_zh: 对友军目标施加暗影步及其所有加成效果。友方单位的渐隐时间是0.5秒。施放时不会使赏金猎人脱离隐身状态。
lore_en: Useful for the rare instances when a contested bounty is actually wanted alive.
lore_zh: 在极少数情况下，当悬赏对象需要活捉的时候，这就派上了用场。

name_zh: 每次打击+15 风雷之击伤害
description_en: Every strike increases the damage of subsequent strikes until the debuff expires
description_zh: 每次打击都会增加后续打击的伤害，直到负面状态结束

name_zh: 脉冲新星触发闪电风暴
description_en: Lightning Storm hits a random enemy in Pulse Nova radius every 2s with a single bolt. Prioritizes heroes.
description_zh: 每2秒召唤单体的闪电风暴打击脉冲新星范围内一个随机敌人。以英雄优先。

name_zh: 无光之盾提供+8 生命恢复

description_en: Axe gains Strength based on 50% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within 700 distance from Axe. The effect fades over 3s after approaching an ally.
description_zh: 只要斧王附近700范围内没有友方英雄，他就会获得50%自身护甲值的力量加成。这个效果在接近一名友军后会在3秒内消失。

name_en: +5 Armor for Enchantress and her units
name_zh: 魅惑魔女及其单位+5 护甲

name_en: +2/0.01 Dumb Luck Mana/Mana Regen Per Strength
name_zh: +2/0.01 傻福力量提供魔法/魔法恢复

name_en: +3s Culling Blade Kill Buff Bonus Duration
name_zh: +3秒 淘汰之刃斩杀效果加成
剑刃风暴期间+45 移动速度

name_en: Wave Of Terror Steals 25% Of Reduced Damage And Armor
name_zh: 恐怖波动窃取25%降低的攻击力和护甲

description_en: Every time Bane kills an enemy hero or they die under the effect of Bane's debuff, they receive a Terror for the rest of the game that decreases their status resistance to Bane's subsequent debuffs.
description_zh: 每次祸乱之源击杀敌方英雄，或者他们在祸乱之源的负面效果下阵亡，他们都会在游戏的剩余时间内获得一层恐惧的效果，使敌人对祸乱之源施加的负面状态的状态抗性减少。

special_values.name: max_terrors
special_values.heading_zh: 每名英雄最高恐惧叠加层数：

special_values.name: status_resistance
special_values.heading_zh: 每层恐惧降低状态抗性：

description_en:
Bloodseeker restores some life when he kills a unit, equal to 30 health plus a percentage of the units max health.

Restores for half values if an ally kills a nearby enemy hero.
description_zh:
血魔每杀死一个单位都会回复部分生命，回复量为基础30点加上该单位最大生命值的一定百分比。

友军击杀了附近的敌方英雄时会回复半额数值。
notes_en: Creeps lifesteal is reduced by 40%.
notes_zh: 非英雄单位的吸血效果减少40%。

description_en: Grants Drow bonus agility based on Drow's current agility and level. Nearby ranged heroes received 50% of the bonus agility.
description_zh: 卓尔游侠根据她自身的当前敏捷和英雄等级获得敏捷加成。附近远程英雄获得50%敏捷加成。
lore_en: Traxex' time spent alone in the forests of her Drow home has allowed her to teach other archers how to improve their bow skills.
lore_zh: 崔希丝在卓尔族森林中独处的时光让她有时间教导其他弓箭手如何提高弓技。

description_en: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every 2s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after 2s upon taking any damage.
description_zh: 主宰未受到伤害时每2秒获得一层剑心的叠加层数。每层叠加效果提供基础敏捷和移动速度加成。叠加效果在受到任何伤害时会粘滞2秒后再消失。
notes_en: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

description_en: Turns Mirana and all allied heroes invisible and grants bonus movement speed. Mirana gains bonus outgoing damage during the duration. If a hero is revealed, invisibility will restore after the fade delay as long as Moonlight Shadow's duration has not expired.
description_zh: 让米拉娜和所有己方英雄进入隐身状态。米拉娜在持续时间内获得伤害输出加成。只要还在月光阴影的持续时间内，即使隐身被打破也会在短时间内重新淡入隐身。
lore_en: Her tenure with Selemene allows Mirana to eclipse the ground, wrapping her allies in a cloak of shadows.
lore_zh: 作为赛莉蒙妮的代言人，米拉娜能将月蚀之暗投向大地，将她和她的友军隐藏在阴影中。
notes_en: Units affected will not auto attack enemies.
notes_zh: 受到作用的单位会自动停止攻击敌人。

description_en:
Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for 8 seconds. For the duration of the effect, every 0.5s he collects souls from 2 enemies in a 600 radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for 8s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.

Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.
description_zh:
影魔获得移动速度和攻击速度加成，持续8秒。在持续时间内，每0.5秒他从600范围内的2个敌人身上收集灵魂。效果结束后，灵魂拥有者还存活的话，影魔会失去这些灵魂，否则可以保留8秒，在这之后，超过支配死灵最大叠加数量的灵魂也会失去。

从每个敌人身上只能收集一次灵魂。
lore_en: For Nevermore, there's as much delight in the harvest as there is in the feast.
lore_zh: 在奈文摩尔看来，收获和盛宴一样令人愉悦。

name_en: Feast of Souls Grants +30% Cast Speed
name_zh: 灵魂盛宴+30% 施法速度

description_en: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range, gaining increased movement speed and evasion.
description_zh: 对目标发动攻击后，幻影长矛手将快速向其冲去，获得移动速度和闪避提升。
lore_en: Azwraith knows that on the field of battle, speed can mean everything.
lore_zh: 阿兹瑞斯明白，瞬息万变的战场上，速度就是一切。
notes_en: If the attack order is cancelled, the movement speed bonus is lost.
Rush movement speed is 800.
notes_zh: 如果冲锋中途取消攻击指令，那么移动速度加成就会消失。
冲锋过程中移动速度为800。
scepter_en: Increases Range. Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them. Additionally, every 600 units rushed creates a Juxtapose illusion that rushes to the target alongside Phantom Lancer.
scepter_zh: 提升距离。每当幻影长矛手冲锋时穿过敌人，他就会制造并列幻象攻击他们。另外，每冲锋600距离还会在幻影长矛手身旁制造一个并列幻象，向目标冲去。

description_en: Whenever Puck disjoints an attack, it restores 3% of its max health and mana. Dodging a targeted spell projectile restores 3x that amount. Does not apply to attacks by Towers.
description_zh: 每当帕克躲避攻击时，它就会分别回复最大生命值和最大魔法值的3%。躲避指向性技能的弹道将回复3倍数值。防御塔的攻击不会对此生效。

description_en: Pudge's skin thickens permanently every time he kills an enemy Hero, gaining 2 bonus Strength for each stack.
description_zh: 每次帕吉击杀敌方英雄时，他的皮肤就会永久变厚，获得的每层叠加效果为2点额外力量。
notes_en: Enemy Heroes that die within 450 of Pudge grant a stack regardless of its killer.
notes_zh: 帕吉附近450范围内敌方英雄阵亡时他都会获得一层叠加效果，不论击杀者是谁。

description_en: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
description_zh: 被攻击时拥有几率、每次受到指向性技能时都会释放一道叉状闪电，击中目标和附近其他敌人，优先打击与目标类型相同的单位，造成伤害并减缓移动速度。
lore_en: Merely approaching the Lightning Revenant is rewarded with shock therapy.
lore_zh: 仅仅是靠近闪电幽魂就会体验免费的电击疗法。
notes_en: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
shard_en: While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is 2x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by 2s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius. Does not apply to the same enemy twice from a single instance.
shard_zh: 风暴之眼开启时，打击几率为2倍，打击冷却时间减少2秒，而且闪电会打击风暴之眼范围内所有敌人。单次伤害不会对同个敌人施加两次。

description_en: Sand King's attacks inject a venom that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die that does a flat amount of damage and an additional amount based on the dying units max health.
description_zh: 沙王的攻击对敌方单位注入毒液，使他们死亡时发生剧烈爆炸，造成固定数值的伤害加上基于阵亡单位最大生命值的额外伤害。
lore_en: An injection from Crixalis makes one brittle and as dry as the arid wastes, subject to implosive demise.
lore_zh: 克里瑟历斯的毒液让受害者变得脆弱并且干涸如干旱的荒地，最后爆炸而死。

description_en: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of 125 take 40% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.
description_zh: 沙王袭击一片区域，对范围内所有敌人发动一次攻击，对每个敌人造成额外伤害。最中心125范围内敌人将受到40%额外伤害。对所有击中的敌人施加腐尸毒和减速效果。
lore_en: Crixalis is certainly capable of mercy, but the soul of the sand finds few foes worth sparing.
lore_zh: 克里瑟历斯当然有怜悯之心，但是沙之魂并没有发现有多少敌人值得他的饶恕。

description_en: Storm Spirit gains a charge of 0.2 mana regeneration per kill, and a charge every 3 levels. Loses 2 charges per death. Additionally every time he gains a charge he also gains 0.1 Mana Regen permanently.
description_zh: 风暴之灵每次击杀都会获得一点提供0.2点/秒魔法恢复的能量，每3级也会获得一点能量。每次阵亡会损失2点能量。另外每次获得一点能量时他还会永久获得0.1点/秒魔法恢复。
notes_en: Break disables the gaining of new stacks from kills.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法通过击杀获得新的叠加效果。

description_en: Sven gains additional attack damage from Strength.
description_zh: 斯温从力量中获得额外攻击力。

description_en: Tiny gains Status and Slow Resistance from Strength. Slow Resistance also reduces the impact of Attack Speed slows.
description_zh: 小小从力量中获得状态和减速抗性。减速抗性还会降低攻击速度减少的影响。
notes_en: Insurmountable does not reduce the effect of Grow's Attack Speed Reduction.
notes_zh: 不可逾越不会减少长大的攻击速度降低效果。

special_values.name: str_to_slow_resist_pct
special_values.heading_zh: 减速抗性的力量值系数：

special_values.name: str_to_status_resist_pct
special_values.heading_zh: 状态抗性的力量值系数：

description_en:
Vengeful Spirit is considered both a ranged and a melee attacker to gain the respective bonuses.

When killed by an enemy hero, Vengeful Spirit deals 20% bonus damage to her killer until their next death. Only one debuff can exist at a time.
description_zh:
复仇之魂的攻击同时被视为远程和近战，可以获得相应加成。

只要敌方英雄击杀了复仇之魂，他们会获得一个负面效果，直到下次阵亡，期间复仇之魂会对他们造成20%额外伤害。同一时间只能存在一个负面效果。

description_en: Lina's abilities deal an additional 64% damage as burn damage over 4s.
description_zh: 莉娜的技能会在4秒内额外造成64%原伤害的烧灼伤害。

description_en:
Sacrifice an allied creep to convert its current health into mana for Lich and give Lich its experience bounty.

Begins the game on cooldown and with no charges.
description_zh:
牺牲一个友方非英雄单位，把它的当前生命值转化为巫妖的魔法，并且巫妖获得它的击杀经验。

游戏开始时处于冷却，没有能量点数。
notes_en: Cannot sacrifice ancients or creep-heroes.
Sacrificed creeps count as denies and can give experience to enemy heroes. Lich's experience bounty and enemy heroes' deny experience are independent.
notes_zh: 无法牺牲远古或类英雄单位。
被牺牲的非英雄单位记为反补，会对敌方英雄提供经验。巫妖获得的击杀经验和敌方英雄获得的反补经验为分开计算。

description_en:
Lion gains 20% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead.

Lion gains 20% spell amplification for 90s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.
description_zh: 击杀英雄或助攻会向莱恩提供20%负面效果持续时间，持续到该英雄复活。而莱恩复活时，他就会获得持续90秒的20%技能增强，直到他完成击杀或得到助攻。

description_en:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
description_zh:
受到致死伤害时，暗影萨满会获得强驱散效果，并且以1点生命的小鸡继续存活。受到的伤害将降为零，持续较短时间，并且额外产生若干只小鸡，迷惑敌人。冷却时间会在暗影萨满复活时重置。

驱散类型：强驱散
lore_en: Rhasta had to learn early on how to stay one step ahead of those who (rightfully or wrongfully) wished him harm.
lore_zh: 罗斯塔必须尽早学会如何能快人一步，抢到哪些想（正当或不正当地）伤害他的人前头。
notes_en: Lethal Damage from Axe's Culling Blade and Necrophos's Reaper's Scythe will not be prevented.
Incoming damage reduction buff will prevent certain sources of HP removal from killing Shadow Shaman.
notes_zh: 无法阻止斧王的淘汰之刃和瘟疫法师的死神镰刀的致死伤害。
受到的伤害减免效果会阻止生命移除类效果杀死暗影萨满。

description_en: Slardar gains bonus movement speed, health regeneration, attack damage, and armor while in a puddle, trail, or river.
description_zh: 斯拉达在水洼、水迹或河道中将获得移动速度、生命恢复、攻击力和护甲加成。
scepter_en: Provides additional HP Regen, Armor and Status Resistance while in a puddle, trail, or river. Increases puddle/trail radius by 75% and puddle/trail duration by 5s.
scepter_zh: 在水洼、水迹或河道中获得额外生命恢复、护甲，还有状态抗性。水洼/水迹的作用范围提升75%，水洼的持续时间提升5秒。

description_en:
Witch Doctor gets a Gris-Gris, an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. When the owner dies, 100% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. The value of the Gris-Gris is increased by 1 every 3s.

Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.
description_zh:
巫医获得了驱邪护符，这件物品无法丢弃或放在背包里。拥有者阵亡时，死亡损失金钱的100%会加入到该物品中，物品被消耗后将退回这些金钱。驱邪护符的价值每3秒会增加1金。

右键点击可以消耗这件物品，并将其永久移除。

description_en: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility.
description_zh: 力丸每次从背后攻击敌人时都会造成额外伤害，伤害量为自身敏捷的一定倍数。
notes_en: Works when denying friendly units at 30% effectiveness.
Illusions of Riki will play Backstab animations, but not deal any bonus damage.
notes_zh: 反补友方单位时具有30%效果。
力丸的幻象也会有背刺的动作，但是不会造成额外伤害。

special_values.name: bonus_xp_assist_other
special_values.heading_zh: 击杀守卫/信使奖励经验：

description_en: Units in a 600 radius moving away from Enigma have a movespeed penalty.
description_zh: 600范围内的单位远离谜团时会受到移速惩罚。

description_en: Tinker gains 1% item cooldown reduction per 3 Intelligence, up to a maximum of 60%.
description_zh: 修补匠的每3点智力提供1%物品冷却时间减少，最多为60%。

description_en: Sniper’s attacks deal bonus damage for every 100 units of distance Sniper is from the target.
description_zh: 狙击手和目标相距每100距离，他的攻击都会造成额外伤害。

description_en: Necrophos slips into the realm that separates the living from the dead. Unable to attack or be attacked, he emits an aura that slows enemies around him. He takes additional magic damage in this form, but his restorative powers are amplified.
description_zh: 瘟疫法师步入将生者与死者相隔的领域。散发出一片灵气，减缓周围敌人的移动速度。在这个形态下，瘟疫法师为虚无状态，无法攻击或被攻击，受到的魔法伤害增加，但是生命/魔法恢复效果加强。
lore_en: Rotund'jere uses the souls of his victims as bridge from life to afterlife.
lore_zh: 罗坦德吉利利用手中的亡者灵魂搭建出从生到死的桥梁。

description_en: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for 15 seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.
description_zh: 只要敌方单位在受到一个或多个术士的技能作用下阵亡，就会召唤出一个魔童，持续15秒，死亡时会爆炸。魔童会自动搜寻附近单位，优先选择致命连接下的英雄，到达猎物时就会爆炸。
shard_en: Increases the health and explosion damage of minor imps.
shard_zh: 提升小魔童的生命值和爆炸伤害。

description_en: All sources of Spell Lifesteal also apply to Pure Damage. Queen of Pain gains Spell Lifesteal that increases with proximity to her enemies. Lifesteal is at its maximum when the enemy is 150 units or closer to her and at its minimum when the enemy is 800 units or further from her.
description_zh: 所有来源的技能吸血也对纯粹伤害生效。痛苦女王获得技能吸血，与敌人的距离越近效果越强。敌人距离她不到150距离时达到最强效果，距离她超过800距离时为最弱效果。

name_en: +35 Attack Speed against Shadow Striked units
name_zh: 攻击暗影突袭下单位+35 攻速

description_en: Enemy Attack Projectiles targetting Faceless Void or allied heroes within a 1200 radius of him get slowed by 40%, when they get within 500 distance of their target.
description_zh: 虚空假面附近1200范围内以他或友方英雄为目标的敌方攻击弹道在进入目标500范围后会被减速40%。

description_en: Grants Wraith King Lifesteal. When slain Wraith King turns into a free pathing Wraith with Bonus Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration, delaying his death. Wraith King cannot reincarnate after being a Wraith.
description_zh: 冥魂大帝获得吸血效果。被击杀时冥魂大帝变为移动无视地形的冥魂，拥有额外攻击和移动速度，持续较短时间，自身死亡延后。冥魂大帝变为冥魂后无法重生。
notes_en: Credit for allies whose death was delayed will go to whoever struck the original killing blow.
Does not affect Reincarnate deaths.
Break only disables the passive lifesteal component.
Respawn timer is reduced by Wraith duration.
notes_zh: 对于死亡被延缓的友军，其成为冥魂前所受的最后一击来源即为击杀者。
触发绝冥再生时没有效果。
破坏只会使被动吸血失效。
复活时间会根据冥魂持续时间而减少。
scepter_en: Turns Vampiric Spirit into an aura, allowing allied heroes to turn into wraiths when slain. Extends wraith duration.
scepter_zh: 吸血灵魂变为光环，使友方英雄被击杀时也能变为冥魂。延长冥魂的持续时间。

description_en:
Phantom Assassin focuses inward, increasing her ability to evade enemy attacks.

Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.
description_zh:
幻影刺客专注一心，闪避敌人攻击的技艺得到提升。

与其他闪避效果为非线性叠加。

description_en:
Pugna can cast spells and use items while channeling.

Pugna receives 1.5% spell amplification per destroyed tower.
description_zh:
帕格纳可以在持续施法期间施放技能和使用物品。

每摧毁一座防御塔，帕格纳都会获得1.5%技能增强。

description_en: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.
description_zh: 戴泽的技能会对范围内友军和敌人同时施加编织，提升友军的护甲并减少敌人的护甲。本效果可以多次叠加。
lore_en: His ethereal journey into the Nothl realm has allowed Dazzle to mend together the powers of light and dark, creating shifting waves of enchantments.
lore_zh: 戴泽在虚无之境的以太之旅让他能将光与暗的力量融在一起，创造出有两种力量的魔力波动。
shard_en: Applying Weave to an ally heals them for 60 per stack of Weave.
shard_zh: 对友军施加编织时，每层编织效果治疗60点。

description_en:
Clockwerk's outgoing damage increases by 0.25% per point of armor.

Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +4 armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.
description_zh:
发条技师的每点护甲都会使伤害输出增加0.25%。

发条技师可以消耗锁子甲，永久获得+4点护甲。可以叠加。对自身施放后即可消耗。

description_en: Leshrac gains 0.7 Area of Effect Bonus per Intelligence.
description_zh: 拉席克的每点智力都会提供0.7作用范围加成。

description_en: Nature's Prophet gains 2% bonus damage for each nearby tree. Treants also provide this bonus with multiplied values regardless of proximity. Treants also possess this ability.
description_zh: 附近的每棵树都会让自然先知获得2%攻击力加成。每个树人也会让自然先知获得若干倍数的加成，不论相距多远。树人也拥有这个技能。
notes_en: Treants gain bonuses from trees and other treants around them.
Treant Protector does not provide any bonuses.
notes_zh: 树人会从周围的树木和其他树人获得加成效果。
树精卫士不提供任何加成。

description_en:
Huskar does not have mana. Mana costs of items are converted into health costs.

Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.
description_zh:
哈斯卡没有魔法值。物品的魔法消耗会转换为生命消耗。

哈斯卡的生命消耗为魔法伤害，可以被魔法抗性减少。

description_en: Whenever Broodmother kills a unit, she and all units under her control in a 600 radius receive a buff for 3s that heals them for a percentage of the victim's health every 0.5 seconds. Healing from creeps is reduced by 40%.
description_zh: 育母蜘蛛击杀一个单位后，她和600范围内她控制的所有单位都会获得持续3秒的状态效果，每0.5秒治疗一定生命，治疗量为遇害者生命值的一定百分比。非英雄单位提供的治疗量减少40%。

description_en: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed. The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a 1200 radius of each other.
description_zh: 向一个敌方单位掷出一枚致命的飞镖，对目标造成伤害，并且减缓目标的移动速度。只要目标周围1200范围内存在被追踪术标记的单位，飞镖就能向其弹射。
lore_en: While the shuriken may be small, Gondar's precise aim can cause critical damage.
lore_zh: 尽管飞镖很小，但刚铎精确的瞄准可以带来致命伤害。
scepter_en: Increases cast range and applies Jinada on hit.
scepter_zh: 提升施法距离并且击中时施加忍术。

description_en: Bounty Hunter receives 20% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game. An enemy hero is considered Big Game if they are one of the top 3 net worth heroes on the enemy team.
description_zh: 如果阵亡的敌人是重大目标，赏金猎人获得的击杀和助攻金钱提升20%。敌方英雄的财产总和在他们团队中排名为前三就被视为重大目标。

description_en: Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for 5 seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
description_zh: 杰奇洛的攻击使他的敌人受寒，减缓其移动速度，持续5秒，并且被杰奇洛的攻击和其他技能击中后承受额外伤害。这个效果对建筑无效。与液态火共用冷却时间。
lore_en: The right maw of Jakiro opens, punishing all with bitter frost.
lore_zh: 杰奇洛的右喉大开，用严霜惩治一切。
shard_en: Jakiro's Liquid Frost has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
shard_zh: 杰奇洛的液态冰没有魔法消耗，并且不再和液态火共用持续时间。

description_en: Jakiro's attacks launch an attack from each head, but deal less damage each.
description_zh: 杰奇洛攻击时两个头都会发动攻击，不过每个头造成的伤害减少。
notes_en: The second attack ignores Damage Block.
notes_zh: 第二次攻击无视伤害格挡。

description_en: Batrider's attacks apply a debuff that deals 20% of the attack damage every 1s for 2s.
description_zh: 蝙蝠骑士的攻击会施加一个负面效果，每1秒造成20%攻击伤害，持续2秒。

description_en: Doom's attacks curse enemy heroes. After 2.5s, the cursed hero bursts with a pillar of fire, damaging itself and all units in a 66 AoE for 10% of the damage taken from Doom during the curse. The damage and radius of the curse is 66% stronger if the enemy's level is a multiple of 6.
description_zh: 末日使者的攻击会诅咒敌方英雄。2.5秒后，被诅咒的英雄会爆发出一根火柱，对自身和66范围内所有敌方单位造成伤害，伤害量为诅咒期间内承受来自末日使者的10%伤害。如果被诅咒的英雄等级为6的倍数，诅咒的伤害和作用范围会提升66%。
notes_en: Also applies to all attacks when Doom is at max level.
notes_zh: 末日使者达到满级后也会生效。

description_en: Ursa gains bonus damage equal to a percentage of his Current HP.
description_zh: 熊战士获得攻击力加成，数值为当前生命值的一定百分比。

description_en: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes. With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold. If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next 40 seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total. Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.
description_zh: 炼金术士将敌人的尸体和赏金神符转化成额外的金币。炼金术士每杀死一个单位，就能获得基础额外金钱和附加额外金钱。如果炼金术士在接下来40秒内又杀死了一个单位，获得了黄金，那么他所获得的附加额外金钱将有一定幅度的增加。另外，赏金神符将提供成倍金钱。
lore_en: While it is not a mountain, Razzil has mastered the conversion of smaller compounds to line his pockets.
lore_zh: 尽管对付不了一座山，但拉泽尔还是掌握着技术，能转化一些较小的化合物来填满他的荷包。
scepter_en: Alchemist melts down Aghanim's Scepter to grant an allied hero all Aghanim's Scepter upgrades. Alchemist will gain bonus 15 damage and 3 additional base and max Greevil's Greed Extra Gold for each melted Scepter.
scepter_zh: 炼金术士熔铸阿哈利姆神杖并让一位友方英雄获得所有神杖升级效果。炼金术士每送出一把神杖都将获得15点攻击力加成，贪魔的贪婪的基础和最高金钱增加3。

description_en:
Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.

If an enemy Hero dies within 925 range of Silencer or was debuffed by Silencer at the time of death, Silencer permanently steals 1 Intelligence from them. If the victim was silenced, steal an extra 1 Intelligence.
description_zh:
沉默术士对被沉默的目标造成更多伤害，受到来自他们的伤害减少。

沉默术士无需完成击杀就能永久窃取1点智力，只要敌方英雄在沉默术士附近925范围内阵亡或者死亡时带有沉默术士的负面效果即可。如果阵亡时被沉默，将额外窃取1点智力。

description_en: Lycan and units he controls deal extra damage to neutral creeps.
description_zh: 狼人和他控制的单位对中立生物造成额外伤害。

description_en: Shadow Demon's Attacks apply a stacking debuff to the enemy for 8 seconds that increases their damage taken.
description_zh: 暗影恶魔的攻击会对敌人施加一个可叠加的负面状态，使他们受到的伤害增加，持续8秒。
notes_en: Break disables the application of new stacks.
Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法施加新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的状态失效。

description_en:
Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.

If the bear moves 1100 distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack. Lone Druid suffers 20% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies.
Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.
description_zh:
召唤一只可以装备物品的熊灵伙伴。

若熊灵与独行德鲁伊的距离超过1100，则不能攻击。如果熊灵死亡，独行德鲁伊会受到自身最大生命值的20%作为反冲伤害。
熊灵拥有粉碎击、回归、缠绕之爪、野蛮咆哮和灵魂链接技能。
lore_en: Sylla's lifelong companion is symbiotic with his spirit and heart, coming to aid him in any time of need.
lore_zh: 悉拉终生的伙伴与他的魂和心共生，在他需要时随时前来相助。
notes_en: Most spells interact with the Spirit Bear in the same way as they do with heroes.
Spirit Bear has 0 base attributes, 0 base armor, and 25% base magic resistance. Attributes from buffs or items fully affect the bear as they would for Universal heroes.
Spirit Bear cannot gain experience. The Spirit Bear levels up when Lone Druid levels up.
Spirit Bear has its own Aghanim's Scepter and Shard upgrades.
Spirit Bear receives a copy of Lone Druid's Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.
notes_zh: 熊灵受到的大多数技能效果与英雄相同。
熊灵的基础属性为0，基础护甲为0并拥有25%基础魔法抗性。熊灵装备的物品或享受的加成效果具有的属性对熊灵的加成效果与全才英雄类似。
熊灵无法获得经验。熊灵会跟随独行德鲁伊一起升级。
熊灵拥有自己的阿哈利姆神杖和魔晶升级效果。
熊灵会获得独行德鲁伊身上中立物品的复制品。这件复制品拥有独立的冷却时间。

name_zh: +12% 石化凝视额外物理伤害

description_en: When Undying dies he will instantly respawn in the fountain. Begins the game on cooldown. Cannot be refreshed.
description_zh: 不朽尸王阵亡时会立刻在泉水复活。比赛开始时处于冷却状态。无法被刷新。
lore_en: Only when the Dirge of the Dead God ceases will this soldier's march finally end.
lore_zh: 只有死亡之神的挽歌停息，这场死士的行军才会最终结束。

description_en: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.
description_zh: 在短暂的构造时间后，创造一面敌人无法通过的动能墙壁。
lore_en: For a brief moment, it's as if the wind itself had turned solid.
lore_zh: 有一瞬间，就好像风本身都凝固了。

description_en: Whenever Disruptor takes more than 250 damage from any source within 400 radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to 1.5x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a 400 distance away.
description_zh: 每当干扰者受到400范围内来自任意来源的250点伤害，附近所有敌人都会受到1.5倍干扰者智力值的伤害，并且被推开最多400距离。
lore_en: Safe harbor found inside the storm.
lore_zh: 风暴中找到的避风港。
notes_en: After 7s, the damage counter is reset.
notes_zh: 7秒后伤害计数会重置。

description_en: Naga Siren has bonus evasion, increased per every other Naga Siren within 900 radius.
description_zh: 娜迦海妖拥有闪避加成，900内每增加一个娜迦海妖都会提升。

description_en: Weakens an enemy's magical resistance, and applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves.
description_zh: 削弱一个敌人的魔法抗性，并施加减速效果，目标移动的距离越长，减速效果越大。
lore_en: Even a glimpse of the First Light is enough to rob enemies of their senses.
lore_zh: 就算只是瞥了一眼原初之光，敌人的理智也会被剥夺。
shard_en: Grants 2 charges.
shard_zh: 获得2点能量点数。

name_zh: +40% 秘术异蛇伤害/魔法获取

description_en:
Centaur Warrunner gains 40% of his strength as bonus movement speed.

This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.
description_zh:
半人马战行者获得移动速度加成，数值为40%自身力量值。

这个移动速度加成不与鞋类物品叠加。

description_en: Magnus has increased slow resistance and suffers less knockback from enemy's abilities and items.
description_zh: 马格纳斯的减速抗性得到提升，并且受到敌人技能和物品的击退效果减少。

description_en: Whenever Timbersaw destroys a tree, he gains mana.
description_zh: 伐木机只要摧毁一棵树就会获得魔法。

description_en: Tusk reaches out to tag an allied unit, pulling them closer. Once tagged, both Tusk and his tagged ally gain movement speed and armor.
description_zh: 巨牙海民伸出手来触碰友方单位，拉近彼此。触碰后巨牙海民和他的友军获得移动速度和护甲加成。
lore_en: The only thing better than finding a good drinking buddy is finding an equally good enemy the two of you can punch.
lore_zh: 比找到一个好酒友更好的只有唯一一件事，就是找到和你们俩势均力敌的劲敌。
notes_en: Doesn't pull Tusk or targeted ally if they are within 250 range of each other.
Cannot be used during Snowball.
notes_zh: 如果巨牙海民和目标友军相距在250距离以内，就不会拉动他们。
在雪球期间无法使用。

description_en: Passively slows the attack speed of all enemy heroes within a 350 unit radius.
description_zh: 被动降低350范围内所有敌方英雄的攻击速度。

description_en:
Elder Titan sends forth his Astral Spirit, damaging any units it passes through. When the spirit rejoins the Titan, it grants bonus damage and movement speed for each unit it passed through.

The Astral Spirit possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.
description_zh:
上古巨神放出他的灵体游魂，灵魂对任何经过的单位都会造成伤害。当它与巨神合体时，它每伤害过一个单位都会给予若干攻击力和移动速度加成。

灵体游魂拥有回音重踏，回归和自然秩序三个技能。
lore_en: Like the four fundamentals, Elder Titan exists across all planes at once and can draw other aspects of himself to assist in times of need.
lore_zh: 就像四大基本法则，上古巨神在所有位面同时存在，可以在需要协助的时候将其他位面的自己拖入。
scepter_en: Causes Elder Titan to become debuff immune and gain 50% magic resistance for 2 seconds per affected enemy Hero when the spirit returns.
scepter_zh: 游魂每碰到一名英雄就能使上古巨神在游魂回归后获得2秒减益免疫状态和50%魔法抗性提升。

description_en: Elder Titan gains armor equal to a percentage of his bonus movement speed.
description_zh: 上古巨神获得额外护甲，数值为移动速度加成的一定百分比。
notes_en: Bonus movement speed is any movement speed above his base movement speed.
Momentum does not reduce Elder Titan's Armor if he is slowed below his base movement speed.
notes_zh: 移动速度加成是指高于基础移动速度的部分。
上古巨神被减速到低于基础移动速度时动量不会降低上古巨神的护甲。

description_en:
Call a Stone Remnant to the target location. Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities. Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has 7 charges.

Earth Spirit passively gains 3% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional 7.5% bonus damage for 10s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).
description_zh:
在指定位置召唤一块残岩。残岩没有视野，为无敌状态，可以加强大地之灵的技能效果。召唤残岩需要消耗一点能量点数，能量点数会随时间恢复。残岩拥有7点能量点数。

每点未使用的残岩能量都会使大地之灵被动获得3%攻击力加成，并且技能用过残岩后会额外获得7.5%攻击力加成，持续10秒（无法叠加）。
lore_en: Earth Spirit calls forth a remnant of his stone army, long buried with him in the dark embrace of the Earth.
lore_zh: 大地之灵唤出的残岩源自与他一同在大地黑暗的怀抱下埋藏多年的兵马俑。

description_en: Nearby Illusions created by Terrorblade have bonus attack damage.
description_zh: 恐怖之刃控制的附近幻象拥有额外攻击伤害。
notes_en: Reflection Illusions are also affected.
notes_zh: 倒影的幻象也会受到作用。

description_en: Phoenix deals 3.5% of its missing health as magic damage to all enemies in a 400 radius every second.
description_zh: 凤凰每秒对400范围内所有敌人造成3.5%自身缺失生命值的魔法伤害。
notes_en: Dying Light deals damage while Phoenix is transformed during Supernova.
notes_zh: 消逝之光在凤凰变身为超新星期间也会造成伤害。

description_en: Oracle will predict and announce to allies, where the next power rune will spawn (top or bottom) as well as Roshan's exact respawn time.
description_zh: 神谕者将预测并对友军宣布，下个强化神符出现的地点（上路或下路），以及肉山的准确复活时间。

description_en: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +1.5 all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.
description_zh: 神符之力与本尊融合。天穹守望者或风暴双雄每次激活强化神符后天穹守望者都会永久获得+1.5 全属性。

description_en: Random item and ability effects of enemies near Pangolier have a reduced chance to affect him.
description_zh: 附近敌人攻击石鳞剑士时，他们触发物品和技能的随机类攻击特效的几率有所降低。
notes_en: Applies to hero abilities and items.
Effect is a relative reduction in chance for effects to happen.
notes_zh: 对英雄技能和物品有效。
效果是特效发生的几率相对降低。

description_en: Dark Willow gains 20% bonus Health and Mana Regeneration, increased to 100% while she is untargetable or invulnerable.
description_zh: 邪影芳灵获得额外20%生命恢复和魔法恢复，而她无法作为目标或无敌时将提升至100%。

description_en: Grimstroke's attacks and spells cause affected enemy heroes to leave a trail of Ink behind them and deal less damage to Grimstroke for 4s.
description_zh: 天涯墨客的攻击和技能会使受作用的敌方英雄在身后留下一道墨痕，对天涯墨客造成的伤害减少，持续4秒。
notes_en: Provides vision over affected heroes.
Grimstroke's illusions (including Dark Portrait) also have Ink Trail.
notes_zh: 获得作用下英雄的视野。
天涯墨客的幻象（包括暗绘）也拥有墨痕。

description_en: Mars gets more HP Regen the more he is outnumbered by enemy heroes in 900 radius.
description_zh: 900范围内敌方英雄数量更多时，玛尔斯就会获得生命恢复，敌人数量越多，生命恢复也越高。

special_values.name: health_regen_per_enemy
special_values.heading_zh: 每多一个敌人生命恢复：

description_en: After a short formation time, Mars summons an arena lined with the undead warriors of the Ash Legion, who block enemy attacks and movement. Enemy heroes near the inside edge of the arena will be attacked by spears, dealing damage and knocking them back.
description_zh: 经过短暂的列队时间，玛尔斯召唤出环绕着战士的竞技场，战士们将阻挡敌人的攻击和动向。竞技场内的敌方英雄靠近边缘时将被战矛攻击，受到伤害并被击退。
lore_en: The long-dead members of the Ash Legion, assembled from the finest warriors to ever test the might of Mars, still revel in the thrill of combat, gladly beholden to the hand that fell them for as long as he so commands.
lore_zh: 余烬军团死去已久的成员，从考验玛尔斯力量的顶尖战士中集结而来，他们还依然陶醉在战斗的刺激之中，只要他下达命令，他们就欣然应战。
scepter_en: Lowers cooldown by 10s and increases duration. If an enemy is killed in the Arena, Mars and all of his allies inside the Arena restore 35% of their max health and mana and get a 35% attack damage buff for 20s. This effect stacks.
scepter_zh: 冷却时间降低10秒，持续时间提升。如果敌人在竞技场内阵亡，玛尔斯和竞技场内所有友军都会回复35%最大生命和魔法，并且获得35%攻击力加成，持续20秒。这个效果可以叠加。

name_en: Arena Of Blood Grants Team +180 HP Regen
name_zh: 热血竞技场+180 生命恢复

description_en: Void Spirit gains 15% more attack damage per point of each attribute, and 30% more HP regen from Strength, attack speed from Agility, and mana regen from Intelligence.
description_zh: 虚无之灵从每点属性获得的攻击力提升15%，并且从力量中获得的生命恢复、敏捷中获得的攻击速度和智力中获得的魔法恢复提升30%。

description_en: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink. The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.
description_zh: 掷出一把沿弧线飞行的回旋镖。击中后会飞回至森海飞霞。回旋镖对沿途击中的敌人都会造成伤害，并且施加一个负面效果，使受到作用的敌人被减速，承受的技能伤害增加。
lore_en: A precious last vestige of Hoodwink's childhood, converted into deadly distraction.
lore_zh: 森海飞霞童年的宝贵残存变成了致命的消遣。

description_en: Hoodwink has a chance to redirect enemy attacks to a nearby tree.
description_zh: 森海飞霞有几率使敌人的攻击转向至附近的树木。
notes_en: Trees that take a redirected attack are destroyed.
notes_zh: 受到转向攻击的树木会被摧毁。

description_en: Whenever the sun comes out, Dawnbreaker gains bonus base damage and vision that decreases throughout the course of the day. If Dawnbreaker causes the day these bonuses are at full power for the entirety of that daytime.
description_zh: 只要太阳出来，破晓辰星就会获得基础攻击力加成和额外视野，加成效果会在整个白天内逐渐降低。如果是破晓辰星制造的白天，在整个白天时间内加成效果始终是最大值。
scepter_en: Break of Dawn provides healing amplification equal to the current damage increase.
scepter_zh: 辰星破晓提供治疗增强，数值等于当前攻击力提升。

description_en:
Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.

When cast on an ally, she provides them with 75% of her passive lifesteal and attack damage bonus. Additionally Marci creates a shared all damage barrier for herself and her partner. As Marci attacks heroes, 30% of the damage dealt restores the barrier.
description_zh:
被动使玛西获得吸血和攻击力加成。

对友军施放时，使其获得她的75%被动吸血和攻击力加成。另外马上还会给她和她的搭档制造共用的全伤害护盾。在玛西攻击英雄时，造成伤害的30%会补充护盾。
lore_en: Marci learned at a young age that the best asset in a scrap is a steady companion.
lore_zh: 玛西小时候就已经懂得，乱世之中最好的财富是可靠的伙伴。
notes_en: Marci cannot cast Bodyguard on herself.
Lifesteal effectiveness gets a 40% penalty against creeps.
The shared barrier is reduced by damage on either Marci or her partner.
notes_zh: 玛西无法对自身施放护卫术。
吸血效果对非英雄单位减少40%。
不论是玛西或她的搭档受到伤害都会使共用护盾的数值减少。

description_en:
Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.

Passively grants all allied couriers 3 bonus levels and 1 bonus health.
description_zh:
玛西吹起口哨，立刻把她的信使传送到她身边。如果信使起始于泉水，它会带上玛西储藏处内的物品。传送后会把这些物品移交给玛西，再返回泉水。

所有友方信使被动获得3级额外等级和1点额外生命。
lore_en: Professional courtesy, from one courier to another.
lore_zh: 从一个信使到另一个，都体现着专业的礼仪。
notes_en: Special Delivery whistle has a cast point of 1 second.
If the courier didn't transfer any items or still has items after casting, it will remain next to Marci.
notes_zh: 特快专递的口哨具有1秒施法前摇。
如果信使施放后没有移交任何物品，或还拥有物品，它都会停留在玛西身边。

name_en: Unleash Duration Extended By 6s On Kill

description_en: Primal Beast has 10% base Slow Resistance and gains 0.5% bonus Area of Effect and 1% Slow Resistance for every 100 Max Health.
description_zh: 獸拥有10%基础减速抗性，每拥有100点生命上限就获得+0.5%作用范围加成和+1%减速抗性。

description_en: Whenever an enemy hero dies within 925 units of Muerta, she gains a stack of 1% spell amplification. When Muerta dies she loses half the stacks, rounded down.
description_zh: 每当琼英碧灵附近925范围内有敌方英雄阵亡，她就会获得一层1%技能增强的叠加效果。琼英碧灵阵亡时，她会失去一半（向下取整）的叠加层数。

name_en: +3% Max HP Regen while inside The Calling
name_zh: 唤魂内+3% 最大生命值恢复
description_en: Only applies to Muerta.
description_zh: 只对琼英碧灵生效。

name_en: 150% Attack Crit On Targets Affected By Slow Burn
name_zh: 对慢热作用下目标+150% 暴击

description_en: Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at 60% mana, up to max slow at 0% mana. No effect if enemy is above 60% mana.
description_zh: 攻击会根据敌人缺失的魔法值造成减速。60%魔法时造成最低减速，0%魔法时造成最高减速。敌人高于60%魔法时没有效果。
notes_en: Full effect if caused by illusions.
notes_zh: 幻象造成全额效果。

description_en: Whenever an illusion of Phantom Lancer is created, its outgoing damage cannot go below a fixed value for 3 seconds.
description_zh: 幻影长矛手只要制造出幻象，该幻象的继承攻击力不会低于一定值，持续3秒。

description_en: Damage from enemy heroes, buildings, or Roshan that would reduce Kunkka below 65% threshold causes him to douse himself with The Admiral's Rum, receiving bonus movement speed and a delayed reaction to 18% of incoming damage for 5s.
description_zh: 如果昆卡受到来自敌方英雄、建筑或肉山的伤害会使他的生命低于65%临界值，那么他会浸在统帅朗姆酒中，获得移动速度加成，并且延后承受即将受到的18%伤害，持续5秒。
lore_en: Deleterious to landlubbers, no one holds their rum like a sailor.
lore_zh: 朗姆酒对于旱鸭子来说就是毒药，他们不像水手，喝两口就醉了。
notes_en: Damage dealt after Rum wears off is non-lethal and can never kill a hero.
notes_zh: 在朗姆酒效果消失后造成的伤害不能致死，而且不能杀死英雄。

description_en: Viper's attacks deal an additional instance of physical damage per missing health percentage of the target hero.
description_zh: 冥界亚龙的攻击会根据目标英雄缺失的生命百分比额外造成一次物理伤害。

description_en: Creates 4 glaives that rotate 225 radius around Luna. Any enemy unit that collides with a glaive will take a percentage of Luna's Attack Damage.
description_zh: 产生4个月刃在露娜身旁225范围内旋转。任何碰到月刃的敌方单位都会受到露娜攻击伤害的一定百分比。
lore_en: None may approach Selemene's chosen without favor from the goddess herself.
lore_zh: 没有赛莉蒙妮本人的青睐，谁也不能接近女神钦定之人。
shard_en: Increases damage reduction. While active, Luna gains 20% bonus movement speed.
shard_zh: 提升伤害降低效果。开启时，露娜获得20%移动速度加成。

description_en: Enchantress causes neutral creeps or any unit under her control to deal additional damage to enemy Heroes.
description_zh: 魅惑魔女使所有中立生物和魅惑魔女控制下的单位对敌方英雄造成额外伤害。
notes_en: Does not affect converted neutrals, Tormentor, or Roshan.
notes_zh: 不会影响劝化的中立生物、痛苦魔方和肉山。

name_zh: +2/+1秒 奥术诅咒基础/惩罚时间

description_en: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in 3 groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.
description_zh: 美杜莎沿着一条直线射出3组箭矢，每组的作用范围递增。齐射的箭矢击中的敌人会受到初始爆发伤害，然后被缠绕且无法转身，并对敌人可见，同时受到每秒伤害。
lore_en: The best predators don't even need to pounce.
lore_zh: 顶尖的掠食者根本不用扑上去。

description_en:
Troll Warlord swaps from using ranged to melee attacks. While melee, Troll Warlord's base attack time is improved to 1.4.

Troll Warlord gains 1 armor per 30 bonus attack speed.
description_zh:
巨魔战将从使用远程攻击切换为近战攻击。近战下巨魔战将的基础攻击间隔降低至1.4。

巨魔战将每拥有30攻击速度加成获得1点护甲。
lore_en: Jah'rakal has a variety of ways to get under an enemy's skin.
lore_zh: 杰拉考有很多办法激怒敌人。

description_en: Bristleback has bonus damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.
description_zh: 钢背兽攻击身后的敌方英雄时拥有额外伤害和负面效果持续时间增强。

special_values.name: amp_pct
special_values.heading_zh: 伤害和负面效果持续时间增强：

description_en: Damaging enemies applies the Withering Mist debuff for 5s. Affected enemies have their Health Restoration reduced by 29.5% if they are below 40% HP.
description_zh: 对敌人造成伤害时会施加凋零迷雾的负面效果，持续5秒。受作用敌人如果血量低于40%，那么生命回复会降低29.5%。

description_en: When Legion Commander or an allied Hero within 1200 range casts an ability, they gain bonus armor for 6s; allies gain 50% of the value. This bonus stacks independently.
description_zh: 如果军团指挥官或附近1200范围内的友方英雄施放技能，他们会获得6秒的护甲加成；其中友军获得的数值为50%。这个加成效果独立叠加。

description_en: Ember Spirit is continuously burning, dealing damage per second to all nearby enemies at all times.
description_zh: 灰烬之灵持续燃烧，时刻对周围所有敌人造成每秒伤害。
notes_en: Break does not disable Immolation for Fire Remnants when upgraded with Aghanim's Shard.
notes_zh: 破坏不会使阿哈利姆魔晶升级的残焰继承的献祭心失效。
shard_en: Grants Fire Remnants the current level of Immolation, and increases the damage per second and radius.
shard_zh: 使残焰获得献祭心，并且每秒伤害和作用范围提升。

description_en: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain Damage Reduction and Movement Speed. Allies receive 2x bonuses if teleporting via Fiend's Gate.
description_zh: 友方英雄传送后会临时获得承受伤害降低和移动速度加成。友军通过恶魔之扉传送后会获得2倍加成。

name_zh: 尖刀戏会穿过一个目标

name_en: +1s Impalement Arts Bleed and Slow Duration
name_zh: +1秒 尖刀戏流血和减速时间

description_en: Enemies killed with Enchant Totem or Earthshaker's other abilities are sent flying, dealing damage to enemies they hit.
description_zh: 利用强化图腾的攻击或撼地者的其他技能击杀敌人后都会把尸体击飞，对击中的敌人造成伤害。

special_values.name: projectile_body_damage_additional_percent_health
special_values.heading_en: FLYING ENEMY'S MAX HEALTH AS DAMAGE:
special_values.heading_zh: 击飞敌人的最大生命值伤害：

description_en:
Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.
description_zh:
凯可以在影武长刀和翔影双钗之间变换。

基于装备的武器，他会获得不同的攻击特性和技能。技能会一起升级，而且使用后，相对的武器技能也会进入冷却。

凯切换到长刀后第一次长刀攻击或技能会造成额外伤害，切换到双钗后会获得额外移动速度。
lore_en: As former followers of the Shodo, the leaders of the Kazurai Order can switch effortlessly between twin disciplines of martial mastery over sai and blade.
lore_zh: 影武团的领袖，曾经也是翔影教团的追随者，他的武技可以在长刀和双钗这两种流派之间自如地切换。
scepter_en:
Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within 3 seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown.

Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.
scepter_zh:
在使用流派变换后3秒内施放的第一个技能不会使相对的武器技能进入冷却，或者已进入冷却的技能会结束冷却。
