施放任何武器的技能都会重置流派变换的冷却时间。

special_values.name: katana_agility_bonus_base_damage
special_values.heading_zh: 长刀敏捷额外提供基础攻击力：

special_values.name: sai_swap_duration
special_values.heading_zh: 切换双钗加速持续时间：

description_en: Kez slashes forward in a 800 distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief 100% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
description_zh: 凯挥舞他的长刀向前沿一条直线斩击800距离，攻击区域内的敌人并施加短暂的100%减速。经过短暂延迟后，这个区域会被再次攻击。英雄会承受额外伤害。
lore_en: Kez and his master Kraw have worked tirelessly to train the Kazurai new ways to keep the flyers off balance by improving upon ancient techniques.
lore_zh: 凯和他的师父克洛孜孜不倦地训练影武团，改进古代的技艺让空中的敌人失去平衡。
notes_en: Destroys trees. Doesn't apply Cleave.
notes_zh: 会摧毁树木。不会继承分裂效果。

description_en: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree. When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.
description_zh: 凯向目标单位或者树木发射一枚抓钩并摆荡过去。抓钩碰到目标后，该单位会被减速。凯到达敌方目标时，落地会发动一次攻击。
lore_en: The Kazurai have the speed and reach to drag even the highest flyers from the skies.
lore_zh: 影武者拥有极快的速度和强大的力量，在空中飞得再高也会被拽下来。

description_en:
Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time.

Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.
description_zh:
长刀的攻击和技能会对敌人施加一个可叠加的持续伤害效果，持续时间内造成原攻击伤害一定百分比的额外伤害。

凯可以主动使用技能，刺中目标，阻止他们移动或转身。目标身上的影武长刀效果爆发，使部分叠加数值立刻造成伤害。
lore_en: To fight back against the reach of Imperia and her Queensguard, the Kazurai had to become skilled in the ways of attrition.
lore_zh: 为了反击英佩瑞雅和她的羽林卫，影武者必须熟练掌握消耗战的技巧。
shard_en: Kez lifesteals 100% from the impale. If the impale comes from behind the target, the target is stunned. Increases max burst stacks.
shard_zh: 刺中后凯能从当次攻击吸血100%。如果从背后刺中目标，目标会被眩晕。提升最大爆发叠加数值。

description_en:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for 1 second, becoming invulnerable for 0.2s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
description_zh:
凯进入不可控制的状态，持续1秒，0.2秒为无敌状态并获得一次弱驱散效果。

如果施法成功完成，凯会对周围发动致命的辐射状斩击，基于目标的最大生命值造成伤害，并且造成伤害的一定百分比会治疗凯。
lore_en: Unleash the inner fury of the Flightless to feast on the essence of your foes.
lore_zh: 陆行族内心的愤怒尽数释放，将敌人的精元吸收殆尽。
notes_en: Slash Lifesteal is reduced to 20% when slashing a creep or an illusion.
notes_zh: 斩击非英雄单位或幻象时吸血量减少至20%。

description_en: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks. While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
description_zh: 开启后凯可以向敌方目标冲去，发动的攻击会重复一次。在这个状态下，凯拥有相位移动状态和减速抗性。
lore_en: An ancient Shodo technique used to hunt faster aerial foes, stealing the advantage and delivering multiple attacks within a single flap of their prey's panicking wings.
lore_zh: 古老的翔影战技，用来猎杀空中速度更快的敌人，窃取他们的优势，并在猎物惊慌失措地扇动一次翅膀的时间内发动多次攻击。
notes_en: Does not work on buildings.
notes_zh: 不会对建筑生效。

description_en: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.
description_zh: 凯向目标单位掷出一把钗，施加一次固定伤害的攻击，并造成沉默。
lore_en: The Shodo learned to rely upon distance and disorientation to survive against much stronger opposition.
lore_zh: 翔影教团学会了依靠距离和分神来对抗更强大的对手。
notes_en: The fixed damage attack has True Strike.
notes_zh: 固定伤害的攻击具有克敌机先效果。

description_en:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for 1.5 seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for 0.4s and gains a Mark. When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
description_zh:
装备双钗时凯的攻击有几率对敌人造成致命一击。

凯可以主动开启技能，使自身被缴械，面朝方向被锁定，招架来自目标方向的攻击和攻击效果，持续1.5秒。如果有敌方英雄的攻击被招架，该英雄会被眩晕0.4秒并获得印记，拥有印记的目标被凯攻击时必定会造成致命一击，并且被眩晕。

子技能可以用于提前取消招架状态。
lore_en: The Shodo may have lost their way, but Kez and the Kazurai can still use Shodo knowledge for the good of the people.
lore_zh: 也许翔影教团已经迷失了方向，但是凯和影武团还是能利用翔影的知识造福人民。
shard_en: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.
shard_zh: 招架会产生更强的印记，造成额外眩晕和致命一击伤害。

description_en: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemies, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.
description_zh: 凯释放出一阵迷烟，对附近敌人施加标记，暂时削弱他们的视野。凯获得弱驱散效果、移动速度加成和隐身状态，直到他攻击或施法。
lore_en: Eying either threat or opportunity, Shodo masters slip instantly into shadow to reset the terms of any engagement in their own favor.
lore_zh: 不论是见到威胁还是机遇，翔影的大师都会立刻进入暗影，使作战的条件重新对自己有利。

special_values.name: blind_duration
special_values.heading_zh: 视野负面状态持续时间：

description_en: -0.6s Interval
description_zh: -0.6秒间隔

name_zh: 每缺失1%生命造成掠食伤害+0.35

name_en: +30 Attack Speed for Enchantress and her units
name_zh: 魅惑魔女及其单位+30 攻速
幽冥剧毒每0.5秒提升25范围

description_en: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
description_zh:
戴泽的灵魂离开身体，穿过虚无之境变成无敌的幽灵，可以施放技能、攻击和使用物品，他的身体还留在这个世界，和灵魂之间存在着可见的连接。在灵魂形态下，戴泽的基础技能都已强化：
剧毒之触带有妖术效果；
薄葬结束时会治疗；
暗影波的冷却时间变短。

效果可以提前结束，效果结束时戴泽的灵魂会返回身体。
lore_en: The allure of the Nothl Realm is intoxicating, but Dazzle never forgets his purpose for being there.
lore_zh: 虚无之境的魅力令人沉醉，但戴泽从没忘记过他前去的目的。
notes_en: When Dazzle's spirit is further than 1600 units from the body, the tether will begin to pull him back. The strength of the pull increases with distance.
Dazzle's Soul cannot attack buildings.
notes_zh: 戴泽的灵魂离开身体超过1600距离后会被拉向身体。戴泽的灵魂移动得越远，拉力就越大。
戴泽的灵魂不能攻击建筑。

description_en:
Dark Seer gains 1 Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

When Dark Seer levels up, he restores a percentage of his max health and mana.
description_zh:
黑暗贤者从每点智力获得1攻击速度。

黑暗贤者升级时会恢复最大生命值和魔法值的一定百分比。

description_en: Chaos Knight's Neutral Items get an additional random enchantment.
description_zh: 混沌骑士的中立物品额外获得一个随机附魔。
notes_en: The random enchantment can be any available enchantment in that tier except for enchantments with negative effects, including enchantments that are normally not available for Strength heroes.
The random enchantment cannot be the same as the chosen enchantment.
notes_zh: 随机附魔会从该级别的所有可选附魔中选取，包括一般不会对力量英雄开放的附魔，拥有负面效果的附魔除外。
随机附魔不会和选定附魔重复。

name_zh: +15% 巨角冲撞行进距离伤害

name_en: Exposure Therapy Heals for 12 HP Per Tree Destroyed
name_zh: 暴露疗法每摧毁一棵树木回复12点生命
一箭穿心蓄力期间提供视野
description_en: Also Grants True Sight. Does Not Reveal Wards.
description_zh: 还会提供真实视域。不会显示守卫。

description_en: Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a 1.5s, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead. While transformed, Monkey King is invulnerable, but cannot attack or cast spells
description_zh: 齐天大圣可以在猴子猴孙期间变成其中一个猴子猴孙，1.5秒内取代其位置，无法和其他猴子猴孙相区分，并且在原地留下一个猴子猴孙。变身后齐天大圣为无敌，但是无法攻击或施放技能。

description_en:
Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.

Killing or dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
description_zh:
朗戈用他的舌头舔舐目标单位，把它拉回一小段距离，施加弱驱散，如果是敌人还会造成伤害。

击杀目标或驱散目标的效果后都会使朗戈暂时获得生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散
lore_en: After generations spent living on the ancient isaloth Velu'Mar, the descendants of the Murkroot exiles have grown resilient, happily sampling toxins that would've struck their ancestors dead.
lore_zh: 在古老的岛屿泽鲁玛上生活了数个世代后，流亡暗根族的后代更具适应力，他们乐于尝试让他们祖先丧命的毒素。
notes_en: Can lick runes to pull them.
notes_zh: 可以舔舐神符，将其牵引。

description_en: Largo tosses froglings to an area. They stomp the ground every 1 second, dealing damage and ministuns, and enemies in the area have reduced movement speed.
description_zh: 朗戈把小青蛙扔到一片区域。他们每1秒都会践踏地面，造成伤害和短暂眩晕并且区域内敌人的移动速度会被减缓。
lore_en: Most Bard Monks spend decades mastering the musical arts, but even the top frog Largo has to admit that his young disciples have already grown shockingly good at counting a proper beat.
lore_zh: 乐手团的大多数用了数十年苦练音乐技艺，但就算是顶尖的朗戈也要承认，他的年轻弟子已经惊人地擅长数节拍了。

description_en:
Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following 5 seconds.

When an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by 0.5s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.
description_zh:
朗戈对一名友方英雄弹奏一首小调。英雄的技能和物品拥有的魔法消耗降低，并且造成伤害后会回响，接下来5秒内再次造成原本伤害的一定百分比。

只要作用下的英雄消耗了魔法，本增益的剩余持续时间都会减少0.5秒。朗戈身上的持续时间不会减少。
lore_en: Largo loves to help his friends find glory through the power of music, never missing a chance at a killer duet.
lore_zh: 朗戈喜欢通过音乐的力量帮助他的朋友找到荣耀，从未错过任何一次上演精彩二重唱的机会。
notes_en: Only applies to damage sources affected by spell amplification.
Only applies to damage where the source and target are within 2000 units of each other.
notes_zh: 只适用于可受到技能增强作用的伤害来源。
只会在来源和目标相距2000以内时施加伤害。

description_en:
Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.

Every time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.
description_zh:
朗戈准备好弹奏乐曲。他被缴械，而他的技能栏切换为3个乐曲技能，每个都有不同的效果。乐曲只有弹在节拍上才会生效。

每次成功弹奏他都会获得一层律动的叠加效果。每层叠加效果都会对他提供额外护甲，并且降低每首乐曲的魔法消耗，但是他只要错过一次节拍就会失去一层叠加效果。叠加效果在朗戈的乐曲结束后还会粘滞一小段时间。
lore_en: The very first Bard Monk played a song that summoned a living island and saved the Murkroot exiles from a salt-worn death.
lore_zh: 乐手团的第一人弹了一首歌，召唤出一座有生命的岛屿，在海水的侵袭下即将灭亡的流亡暗根族因此得救。
notes_en: Items can be used while in this mode.
notes_zh: 这个模式下可以使用物品。
scepter_en: Largo can play two songs per beat by strumming both at the same time.
scepter_zh: 朗戈在每次节拍时可以弹奏两首乐曲。

special_values.name: song_cost_reduction_per_stack_tooltip
special_values.heading_en: SONG MANA COST REDUCTION PER STACK:
special_values.heading_zh: 每层叠加乐曲魔耗降低：

description_en: Largo plays a song that deals 20 / 30 / 40 magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.
description_zh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲对附近敌人造成20 / 30 / 40点魔法伤害。乐曲还会使附近友方英雄的技能增强提升，并且他们的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。
lore_en: 'Hey, when a beach brawl breaks out, you gotta learn to throw your musical weight around or the party's over proper quick.'
lore_zh: “嘿，沙滩上突然有人打架的时候，你要学会用上你的音乐实力，不然派对很快就结束咯。”
scepter_en: Deals additional 6 / 10 / 14 magic damage per Groovin' stack when this song is used in double-strumming.
scepter_zh: 这首乐曲用于两首共弹时每层律动都会额外造成6 / 10 / 14点魔法伤害。

description_en: Largo plays a song that increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and grants a brief slow resistance.
description_zh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲会提升附近友方单位的移动速度，还有短时间的减速抗性。
lore_en: 'It's like that old story about the scary swamp witch. You better watch just where you're jumping when you're trying to do it lickety-split.'
lore_zh: “这就像那个沼泽女巫的吓人老故事。要是跳的时候想再快点，最好看清楚往哪跳。”

description_en: Largo plays a song that heals nearby friendly heroes.
description_zh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲会治疗附近友方英雄。
lore_en: 'If this song can heal an ageless isaloth, it can handle a few cuts and bruises on the lot of you.'
lore_zh: “假如这首歌能治愈永恒的孤岛，它就能处理你身上的擦伤和瘀青。”

description_en: Buffs that Largo applies to himself or his team have extended duration.
description_zh: 朗戈对自身或队友施加的增益效果会延长持续时间。
shard_en:
Whenever Largo applies a Unit Target buff to a friendly hero, he also gets the buff.

If Largo targets himself, the buff is also applied to the nearest allied hero within the cast range of the targeted ability.
shard_zh:
只要朗戈对友方英雄施加单位目标技能的增益效果，他也会获得该增益。

只要朗戈对自身施加，该增益也会施加给指向性技能的施法距离内最近的友方英雄。

name_en: 1% Croak of Genius Max Health DPS
name_zh: 1% 灵呱一闪每秒最大生命值伤害

name_en: +100 Catchy Lick Cast Range / +50 Pull Distance
name_zh: +100 动人之舐施法距离 / +50 拉回距离
2倍 蛙力千钧践踏次数/频率

description_en:
Clinkz and his skeletons apply a stacking debuff that causes their attacks to pierce up to 20% of the target's total physical armor (does not reduce their armor). Clinkz applies 3% per attack, and skeletons apply 1%.

Lasts 5 seconds.
description_zh:
克林克兹和他的骷髅弓手会施加一个可叠加的负面效果，使他们的攻击可以穿透最高目标20%总物理护甲（不会降低他们的护甲）。克林克兹每次攻击施加3%，骷髅弓手施加1%。

持续5秒。

description_en:
Sends an uncontrollable illusion at a target that follows and attacks the target.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
description_zh:
对目标制造一个无法控制的幻象，对其进行攻击。

子技能空降可以将本体传送至幻象，并将其摧毁。
lore_en: With great focus of will, Mercurial can sometimes limit the extent of her division.
lore_zh: 在强大的专注力下，墨丘利有时可以限制自己分裂的限度。

description_en: When Brewmaster drops below 50% Health he gains a Status Resistance buff and his movement speed alternates every 1s between being faster and being slower. The effect becomes stronger at lower health, scaling from 0 up to max values at 20% Health.
description_zh: 当酒仙的生命值低于50%，他就会获得状态抗性加成，而且他的移动速度每1秒都会在加速和减速之间改变。血量越低，效果越强，从0开始到20%生命值时达到最大数值。
shard_en:
Toss a strong drink to a teammate or drink it yourself, activating the maximum power effect of Liquid Courage and granting 3% Max HP Regen per second.

Lasts 5 seconds.
shard_zh:
向队友丢出一杯烈酒，或自己一饮而尽，获得壮胆酒的最大效果，并且还会获得每秒3%最大生命值的回复。

持续5秒。

description_en:
Allows Lone Druid to Entangle enemies once they gain 5 stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

When cast, applies 2 stacks to each enemy hero in the area and 5 stacks to enemy creeps. Also empowers Lone Druid for 10s, making him apply 1 stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.

Leveling this ability also levels Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws ability.
description_zh:
敌方英雄获得5层叠加效果后独行德鲁伊可以缠绕敌方英雄。被缠绕的英雄无法移动，并受到持续伤害。

施放时，对区域内每个敌方英雄施加2层叠加效果，对敌方非英雄单位施加5层。独行德鲁伊的攻击还会被强化10秒，每次攻击敌方英雄都会施加1层叠加效果。被缠绕的英雄无法获得叠加层数。

升级这个技能也会升级熊灵的缠绕之爪技能。
notes_en: Rooted units can't use Blink abilities and are revealed if they are invisible.
Lone Druid's Empowered Buff and enemy stack counter debuff cannot be dispelled.
Entangled debuff is dispellable.
Creeps can't gain stacks from either Lone Druid's or Spirit Bear's attacks, and are Entangled only on cast.
Roshan is affected as if he were a hero.
notes_zh: 被缠绕的单位将无法使用闪烁类技能，如果进入隐身状态也会显形。
独行德鲁伊的强化增益和敌人叠加计数减益无法被驱散。
缠绕的减益效果可以被驱散。
独行德鲁伊或者熊灵的攻击不会使非英雄单位获得叠加效果，只会在施放缠绕之根时使他们被缠绕。
对肉山的作用机制和英雄相同。
scepter_en: Entangle applies 5 stacks to enemy heroes in the area and has increased radius. Enemies no longer have protection from gaining stacks while Entangled.
scepter_zh: 缠绕之根会对区域内敌方英雄施加5层叠加效果，并且作用范围提升。触发缠绕的敌人不再受到保护，可以继续获得新的叠加层数。

description_en:
Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.

These effects stack independently.
description_zh:
斯拉克用他的海浪短刀划开目标，窃取目标一部分的移动速度、生命恢复和生命回复。

这个效果独立叠加。

description_en: Spirit Lances from illusions hit for a percentage of the normal damage amount
description_zh: 幻象投出的灵魂之矛会造成平常伤害的一定百分比

name_en: Kraken Shell Cleanse triggers Anchor Smash
name_zh: 海妖外壳净化触发锚击
description_en: Triggered attack has 50% damage and is reflected damage.
description_zh: 触发的攻击造成50%伤害，并且是反弹伤害。

name_en: 15% of Riki's Base damage added to Tricks of the Trade
name_zh: 绝杀秘技+15% 力丸攻击伤害

name_en: +7% Spin Web Move Speed and Ignore Speed Limit
name_zh: +7% 织网移动速度并突破移速上限
+0.5% 暴烈之爪生命值转为攻击力

name_en: +2/1s Drunken Brawler Brew Up / Extend Duration
name_zh: +2/1秒 醉拳浸酒/延长持续时间

description_en: Also applies to Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws Root
description_zh: 也会施加给熊灵的缠绕之爪的缠绕

name_en: 40 Bonus Attack Speed During Falcon Rush
name_zh: 40 天隼冲击期间额外攻击速度

description_en: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier.
description_zh: 水晶室女消耗在她技能上的一部分魔法会转化为物理护盾。

description_en: When a charge is available, Mirana's next attack will deal bonus magic damage.
description_zh: 有可用能量时，米拉娜的下次攻击会造成额外魔法伤害。
shard_en: Grants 3 temporary Charges while Leap's buff is active.
shard_zh: 跳跃的加成状态生效时获得3点临时能量。

description_en: Morphling receives bonus cast range and slow resistance based on his current Strength, and attack range and movement speed based on his current Agility. These bonuses persist if he is morphed into another hero.
description_zh: 变体精灵根据当前力量值获得额外施法距离和减速抗性，根据当前敏捷值获得攻击距离和移动速度。这些效果在他变形为其他英雄时仍然有效。
notes_en: Attack range bonuses during morph only apply when morphed into a Ranged hero.
notes_zh: 变形期间的攻击距离加成只有在变形为远程英雄时有效。

description_en:
Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.

Passively increases Windranger's max movement speed.
description_zh:
施放技能会召唤一阵顺风，向风行者提供短时间的移动速度爆发。移动速度加成在顺风持续时间的半途开始逐渐衰减。

被动提升风行者的移动速度上限。
scepter_en: Attacks grant Tailwind. Tailwind lasts longer and is undispellable.
scepter_zh: 攻击也会提供顺风效果。顺风的持续时间更长，并且不可驱散。

special_values.name: movespeed_bonus
special_values.heading_zh: 每层叠加移动速度加成：

description_en: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE and creating a Massive Serpent Ward that has 4x the base Serpent Ward damage and health there that lasts 15s.
description_zh: 向一个地点扔出一个蛇罐，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害，并产生一个巨蛇守卫，守卫的生命值和攻击力为平常群蛇守卫的4倍，持续15秒。

description_en: Deploys 3 uncontrollable turrets at the target location. Enemies hit by the impact take damage and are pushed away from the landing point. If Tinker is hit, he also gets pushed by the impact. Once deployed, the turret fires missiles in the direction of the nearest enemy hero.
description_zh: 在目标地点部署3个不可控的炮塔。被炮塔撞击的敌人受到伤害，并向远离落地点的方向推去。如果修补匠被撞击，他也会被推走。部署完毕后，炮塔开始向最近敌方英雄的方向发射导弹。
scepter_en: Turrets fire missiles 20% faster.
scepter_zh: 炮塔发射导弹的速度加快20%。

description_en:
Whenever an enemy hero is killed by Tidehunter or dies under his debuffs, a fish appears in their place; Tidehunter can eat the fish to permanently gain 3 Health, 2 Attack Range, and 1 Bonus Damage Block.

Tidehunter eats a free fish every time he reaches an even hero level.
description_zh:
每当敌方英雄被潮汐猎人击杀，或者阵亡时带着他的负面状态，他们原地都会出现一条鱼；潮汐猎人可以吃掉鱼，永久获得3点最大生命值，2攻击距离和1额外伤害格挡。

潮汐猎人每次升到偶数等级都会自动吃下一条鱼。
notes_en: Enemies can destroy the fish.
Bonus Damage Block only applies if another source of Damage Block will be affecting the incoming physical attack.
notes_zh: 敌人可以摧毁鱼。
额外伤害格挡只会在有伤害格挡来源施加给即将受到的物理攻击时才会施加

description_en: Venomancer summons a Spawn of Aktok to sink its fangs into a target, dealing magic damage and applying a toxin that does damage every second. When the target attacks while infected, they take the initial damage again.
description_zh: 剧毒术士召唤阿克特克的幼体，把它的毒牙刺入一个敌人，造成魔法伤害，并施加造成每秒伤害的剧毒。目标在感染时发动攻击，他就会再次受到初始伤害。

description_en: When remaining stationary and not taking damage for 0.2s, Templar Assassin begins meditating, gaining health and mana regeneration, reaching the maximum bonus after 1.85s of meditating.
description_zh: 原地不动超过0.2秒后，圣堂刺客开始冥想，获得生命恢复和魔法恢复加成，冥想1.85秒后达到最大加成。

special_values.name: time_until_max_bonus
special_values.heading_zh: 达到最大加成的冥想时间：

description_en: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.
description_zh: 神龙的生命之血提升了龙骑士的技能和物品，使其拥有作用范围加成，并且攻击会对敌方单位造成额外魔法伤害。
lore_en: Slyrak's blood still courses through Davion's veins, giving him twice the vitality of an ordinary knight.
lore_zh: 斯莱瑞克的血液流遍达维安的全身，他获得了寻常骑士身上双倍的活力。

description_en: Night Stalker heals himself when attacking enemy units. At night, the ability can be activated to instantly destroy a non-ancient creep and restore a percentage of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana.
description_zh: 暗夜魔王攻击敌方单位时治疗自身。在夜晚可以主动施放，秒杀一个非远古非英雄单位，并回复暗夜魔王的最大生命值和最大魔法值的一定百分比。
notes_en: Amount of health gained from attacking is affecting by Health Restoration and is decreased when attacking non-hero targets.
notes_zh: 攻击获得的生命值受到生命回复的影响，攻击非英雄目标时会减少。

description_en: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within 700 range of them for 1.5s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.
description_zh: 每当编织者的攻击或技能对敌方英雄造成伤害后，如果编织者在他们700范围内停留达到1.5秒，他就会织出命运之线，短暂减速敌人并把他们与编织者相连。每织出一条命运之线就会使编织者获得攻击力加成。

description_en:
Whenever Chen respawns, he is joined by a Zealot, a melee warrior creep with the ability to sacrifice itself to heal or deal damage to an enemy. The Zealot receives Holy Persuasion's benefits and scales up with other lane melee creeps as game time increases and gains extra base damage. The Zealot respawns next to Chen after 60s.

Zealot may be activated to teleport a unit under your control to Chen after a 6 second delay. If Chen is targeted, it will teleport all units you control. Taking damage from enemy heroes or their units will cancel the teleport.
description_zh:
陈复活时都会带着一个狂热者加入战斗，这是近战小兵战士，可以牺牲自己治疗友军，或者对敌人造成伤害。狂热者会获得神圣劝化的加成效果，并且和其他线上近战小兵一样随着游戏时间的增加提升属性，获得额外基础攻击力。狂热者会在陈复活60秒后在陈身边复活。

狂热者技能可以主动使用，在6秒延迟后把控制下的目标单位传送到陈的身边。如果陈是技能的目标，将传送控制的所有单位。受到来自敌方英雄及其单位的伤害会中止传送过程。

description_en: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy with his abilities, it is slowed for a short duration. If the target is a Hero, its Strength is also reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.
description_zh: 每当远古冰魄通过他的技能对敌人造成魔法伤害，敌人就会减速一段时间。如果目标是英雄，力量还会降低。多个本效果会叠加，并且持续时间相互独立。
scepter_en: Increases Base Strength Reduction by 0.8.
scepter_zh: 基础力量降低提升0.8。

description_en: Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy. Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations. Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.
description_zh: 裂魂人只要眩晕敌人就会获得移动速度加成。来自多个眩晕的效果会叠加，并且拥有独立的持续时间。暗影冲刺期间持续时间会暂停。
notes_en: Empowering Haste buff allows Spirit Breaker to go over the max movement speed limit.
notes_zh: 神行太保的加成状态使裂魂人能够突破移动速度上限。

description_en: Gyrocopter gains a Side Gunner that attacks enemy units in a 700 unit radius every 1.3s with his attack. Prioritizes furthest unit away within its range.
description_zh: 矮人直升机获得侧翼机枪，每1.3秒对矮人直升机附近700范围内的敌方单位发动攻击。优先攻击范围内最远的单位。
notes_en: Side Gunner can attack even while Gyrocopter is disabled.
notes_zh: 即使矮人直升机被控制，侧翼机枪也能攻击。

description_en: Gyrocopter gains movement speed for a short duration after damaging an enemy with his attacks or abilities.
description_zh: 矮人直升机通过攻击或技能对敌人造成伤害后，在短时间内获得移动速度提升。

description_en: Increases Outworld Destroyer's maximum mana. When cast, protects Outworld Destroyer with an all damage barrier equal to a flat amount and a percentage of his maximum mana.
description_zh: 提升殁境神蚀者的最大魔法值。施放后，殁境神蚀者获得全伤害护盾，数值为固定值 + 最大魔法值的一定百分比。
scepter_en: Increases max mana to barrier. Damage that would bring Outworld Destroyer below 20% health is prevented. When that happens, Outworld Destroyer receives a strong dispel and gains an undispellable instance of Objurgation. This effect cannot occur more than once every 80 seconds.
scepter_zh: 提升最大魔法值转为护盾的比例。阻止让殁境神蚀者的血量低于20%的伤害。阻止生效时，殁境神蚀者获得一次强驱散，和不可驱散的责难效果。这个效果每80秒只能触发一次。

description_en:
Meepo grants stacking bonuses to himself and his clones based on their terrain. Each Meepo grants his bonus to the other Meepos.

If there is a tree within 250 range, he receives 1 HP regen.

If he is standing on dirt, he receives 2% bonus movement speed.

If he is in the water, his attacks slow the target by 2% for 2 seconds.
description_zh:
米波会根据所在地形给予自身和克隆体可叠加的加成效果。每个米波都会给予其他米波自身的加成。

如果250范围内有树木，他会获得1点/秒生命恢复。

如果他站在土地上，他会获得2%移动速度加成。

如果他在水中，他的攻击会减缓目标2%移速，持续2秒。
notes_en: Dirt includes any terrain that is not water.
notes_zh: 土地包括所有水之外的地形。

description_en:
Rubick gains 1 stack of Curiosity per level that grants him 1 base damage, 0.3% Buff/Debuff Duration, and 2 AOE Bonus.

If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within 1200 distance of him, he gains 2 Curiosity for 20 seconds. If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last 3 seconds, he gains 1 Curiosity permanently.
description_zh:
拉比克现在每级获得1层奇心的叠加效果，每层奇心提供1点基础攻击力，0.3%增益/减益持续时间，和2作用范围加成。

如果拉比克看到1200范围内有敌方英雄施放技能，他就会获得2层奇心，持续20秒。如果当前提供临时奇心的敌人在受到来自拉比克的伤害后3秒内阵亡，他就会永久获得1层奇心。

description_en: Nyx Assassin's damage on enemies also burns mana as a percentage of the damage dealt.
description_zh: 司夜刺客对敌人造成伤害还会燃烧造成伤害一定百分比的魔法。

description_en:
Keeper of the Light gains 1 movement speed for every 3 Intelligence.

Whenever Keeper of the Light moves 300 distance, he leaves behind light that allows him to see 400 range for 3 seconds.
description_zh:
光之守卫每3点智力都会获得1移动速度。

只要光之守卫移动300距离，他就会留下一道光，可以看到400范围，持续3秒。

description_en: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.
description_zh: 艾欧获得伤害输出增强，血量越高，数值越高。同时，艾欧还获得生命回复和治疗增强，血量越低，数值越高。

name_en: +1% Dying Light Missing Health as Damage
name_zh: +1% 消逝之光缺失生命值伤害

description_en:
Techies gain a percentage of their mana pool as bonus mana regeneration.

When Techies die, they leave behind a barrel that explodes after 1.5s, damaging enemies in an area around it. Damage is based on Techies' max mana.
description_zh:
工程师获得相当于最大魔法值一定百分比的魔法恢复。

工程师阵亡时，他们会留下一个木桶，在1.5秒后爆炸，对范围内敌人造成伤害。伤害数值是根据工程师的最大魔法值。
shard_en: M.A.D. becomes an active ability. Increases max mana as damage amount. Techies plant an M.A.D. which can be detonated manually with a sub-ability. Only one M.A.D. from the active ability can be placed at a time.
shard_zh: 同归于尽变为主动技能。提升最大魔法值的伤害系数。工程师放置同归于尽木桶后，可以使用子技能手动引爆。同一时间主动技能只能放下一个同归于尽木桶。

description_en: Grants Winter Wyvern the item Eldwurm's Edda, which can be consumed to increase the current and maximum level of a basic ability by one and Winter Wyvern's base intelligence by 25% of its current value at the time of consumption.
description_zh: 寒冬飞龙获得物品“古龙诗集”，可以消耗，使一个基础技能的当前和最高等级均提升一级，另外寒冬飞龙的基础智力提升，数值为消耗时相应数值的25%。

description_en: Snapfire deals more damage to nearby enemies.
description_zh: 电炎绝手对附近的敌人造成更多伤害。

description_en: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for 3s - rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed and -20% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemies will not be knocked out of Muerta's attack range.
description_zh: 琼英碧灵对一个敌人射出一颗幽灵子弹，造成伤害，将其击退并将其变为虚无状态，持续3秒——使他们对物理伤害免疫，并且无法攻击。目标被减速，并且承受的魔法伤害增加-20%。敌人不会被击出琼英碧灵的攻击距离。

name_en: +20% Glacial Guard Mana Spent To Barrier
name_zh: +20% 冰川护体魔法转为护盾

name_en: +2 Feast of Souls Souls Collected Per Hero
name_zh: +2 灵魂盛宴每名英雄收集灵魂

name_en: -25% Storm Hammer Cooldown and Mana Cost

name_zh: +1秒 统帅朗姆酒持续时间

name_en: Maledict bursts deal 75% damage in a 800 AoE
name_zh: 巫蛊咒术爆发在800范围内造成75%伤害
description_en: Sends projectiles that deal 75% of the burst damage at all enemy units within 800 range
description_zh: 向800范围内所有敌方单位发射弹道，造成75%爆发伤害

name_en: +0.3 Reaper's Scythe Damage Per Missing HP
Deaths During Exorcism Extend Duration By +8s
name_zh: 驱使恶灵期间死亡延长+8秒持续时间

name_en: +1% Corrosive Weaponry Slow / Damage Reduction Per Stack
name_zh: +1% 腐蚀兵械每层叠加减速/降低攻击力

name_en: +7% Suffer In Silence Silenced Target Damage
name_zh: +7% 默默受苦被沉默目标伤害
+2秒 全领域静默持续时间
邪恶净化施加暗影剧毒
description_en: 1 Shadow Poison Stack is applied per second
description_zh: 每秒施加1层暗影剧毒

description_en: Strikes are 50% faster
description_zh: 打击加快50%

name_en: Ice Shards slow by 50% and deal 110 DPS
name_zh: 寒冰碎片减速50%并造成110每秒伤害
description_en: Applies to enemies trapped inside the Ice Shards
description_zh: 施加给困在寒冰碎片内的敌人

name_en: 20% of Bonus Movement Speed as Attack Speed
Duel Advances Cooldown by 30s On Victory
name_zh: 决斗胜利时减少30秒冷却

name_en: +25% Reactive Tazer Buff and Disarm Duration
name_zh: +25% 活性电击加成/缴械时间

name_en: Celestial Hammer Trail Grants Movement Speed to Allies
name_zh: 上界重锤路径向友军提供移速加成
description_en: Bonus movement speed is equal to the movement slow
description_zh: 移动速度加成等于减速数值

description_en: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.
description_zh: 每次攻击损毁目标魔法值，并造成相当于损毁魔法值一定百分比的伤害。
lore_en: A modified technique of the Turstarkuri monks' peaceful ways is to turn magical energies on their owner.
lore_zh: 一种格斗技巧，改良自星隐寺僧侣们的温和招式，可以让魔法能量反噬其拥有者。
notes_en: Mana Break has 25% mana burn effect if caused by illusions.
notes_zh: 幻象继承法力损毁的燃烧魔法为25%。
scepter_en: Increases Max Mana Burned per Hit.
scepter_zh: 提升每次攻击燃烧的最大魔法值。

special_values.name: mana_per_hit_pct
special_values.heading_zh: 每次攻击损毁最大魔法值：

description_en: Short distance teleportation that allows Anti-Mage to move in and out of combat.
description_zh: 短距离传送，能让敌法师自由出入战场。
lore_en: In his encounter with the Dead Gods, Anti-Mage learned the value of being elusive.
lore_zh: 在与死亡之神遭遇时，敌法师明白了让人捉摸不定是多么重要。
notes_en: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.
notes_zh: 闪烁可以躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。
scepter_en: After casting Blink, your next Mana Break within 5s burns an additional 20% max mana and prevents the target from regenerating or gaining mana for a short duration. This debuff is undispellable.
scepter_zh: 施放闪烁后，5秒内的法力损毁将额外燃烧20%最大魔法值，并且阻止目标在短时间内恢复或获得魔法。这个负面状态无法驱散。

description_en: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies. The main target is also mini-stunned.
description_zh: 根据目标损失的魔法值，对目标和其周围的敌人造成伤害。所有受到伤害的单位都会被短暂眩晕。
lore_en: After bringing enemies to their knees, Anti-Mage punishes them for their use of the arcane arts.
lore_zh: 敌人倒下之后，将因使用奥术而受到敌法师的惩戒。
notes_en: Damage is calculated based on the primary target's mana, but applied to all enemies within the area of effect.
notes_zh: 伤害的计算根据主目标失去的魔法，但是对作用范围内所有敌人均有效。

special_values.name: mana_void_damage_per_mana
special_values.heading_zh: 每点缺失魔法造成伤害：

description_en: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.
description_zh: 斧王嘲讽附近的敌方单位，强迫他们攻击自己，同时获得额外护甲。
lore_en: Mogul Khan's warcry taunts opponents into engaging in an unconquerable battle with the Axe.
lore_zh: 蒙哥可汗的狂吼嘲讽使敌人不得不与他作战。
shard_en: Berserker's Call applies Battle Hunger to affected units.
shard_zh: 狂战士之吼会对作用下单位施加战斗饥渴。

description_en: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.
description_zh: 激怒一个敌方单位，使他受到持续伤害，直到他杀死一个单位或者持续时间结束。敌人只要背朝斧王还将被减速。
lore_en: Ordinary heroes cannot withstand Mogul Khan's rage for battle, such that it injures them until it is satisfied.
lore_zh: 通常英雄都无法抵挡蒙哥可汗的战斗狂怒，他们会一直受伤，直到蒙哥可汗的狂怒平息。
notes_en: Destroying buildings will also remove the debuff.
notes_zh: 摧毁建筑也能移除该状态效果。
shard_en: Multiple instances of Battle Hunger can stack on a single target.
shard_zh: 多个战斗饥渴效果可以叠加在单个目标身上。

description_en: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.
description_zh: 受到一定次数攻击后，斧王就会做出螺旋反击，对附近所有敌方单位造成纯粹伤害。
lore_en: Axe is the only reinforcement this army needs.
lore_zh: 这支军队只要有斧王就不需要援军了。
notes_en: Counter Helix triggers when the attack hits.
Illusions' counters don't increase when they attack when you have a Scepter.
notes_zh: 反击螺旋会在斧王受到攻击时触发。
拥有神杖后自身幻象的攻击不会计入触发计数。
scepter_en: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.
scepter_zh: 反击螺旋现在对击中的敌人施加一个可叠加的负面效果，使其对斧王造成的攻击伤害减少。反击螺旋不再具有冷却时间，并且斧王的攻击也会计入触发记数。

description_en:
Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.

Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.
description_zh:
斧王洞察到弱点并出击，造成纯粹伤害。淘汰之刃击杀敌方英雄时将重置冷却时间，而附近所有友军单位获得移动速度和护甲加成。

每当斧王通过淘汰之刃击杀敌方英雄，他的战刃就会浸满鲜血，获得永久叠加效果，每层都会提供护甲加成。
lore_en: Mogul Khan is the embodiment of battle and fury, launching into a gruesome fatality against those who dare engage the Axe in combat.
lore_zh: 蒙哥可汗是战斗与狂怒的化身，胆敢与斧王为敌者只有死路一条。
notes_en: Culling Blade death cannot be prevented with other abilities like Shallow Grave.
notes_zh: 淘汰之刃的斩杀效果无法被薄葬等技能阻止。

description_en: Feasts on the vital energies of an enemy unit, healing Bane and dealing damage.
description_zh: 暴食一个敌方单位的生命能量，造成伤害并回复自身生命值。
lore_en: Atropos finds no greater pleasure than to harvest the fear he creates.
lore_zh: 阿特洛波斯认为收割被他亲自制造的恐惧弄崩溃的生命是至高的享受。
shard_en: Reduces cooldown by 3. Causes Brain Sap to become a 550 AoE spell. Secondary targets only heal for 30%.
shard_zh: 减少3秒冷却时间。蚀脑变成550作用范围的技能。次级目标只有30%治疗效果。

description_en: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.
description_zh: 每秒造成伤害，并且降低敌人的总攻击力和施法距离。
lore_en: Each tendril of fear that Atropos weaves increases the vulnerability of his victims to arcane and unknown arts.
lore_zh: 阿特洛波斯编织的每一丝恐惧都使他的受难者承受更多的奥术和未知技艺伤害。

description_en: CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every 0.5 seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 抓住一个敌方单位，使其失去行动能力并持续受到大量伤害，同时每0.5秒按目标最大魔法值一定比例吸取魔法。
lore_en: Victims of Atropos are frequently torn apart by vivid conjurations of their own nightmares.
lore_zh: 阿特洛波斯的受害者经常因为噩梦中逼真的幻象痛不欲生。
scepter_en: Reduces Fiend's Grip cooldown by 40s. Fiend's Grip now creates two uncontrollable illusions that are also channeling Fiend's Grip on the target. Illusions take 225% incoming damage and immediately die if they are interrupted. Damage does not stack.
scepter_zh: 魔爪的冷却时间减少40秒。魔爪将产生两个不可控制的幻象，幻象也将对目标持续施放魔爪。幻象承受225%伤害，并且被打断后立刻消失。伤害不会叠加。

description_en:
Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely.

Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.
description_zh:
让目标敌方或友方英雄进入沉睡。睡着的单位会向祸乱之源选定的方向走去，受到攻击便会醒来。目标被直接攻击时，噩梦将转移到攻击者身上。祸乱之源可以随意攻击噩梦中的目标或造成伤害，而且获得额外攻击速度。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让目标站立不动。
lore_en: A stolen prowess from the goddess Nyctasha is to put his prey into forever sleep.
lore_zh: 从夜之女神妮塔莎那里偷来的能力，让猎物一觉不醒。
notes_en: In the first second of Nightmare, the unit is invulnerable.
Bane can wake himself from Nightmare.
On cast, replaced with Nightmare End: Ends all ongoing Nightmares on any affected units.
notes_zh: 在噩梦的第一秒，作用单位是无敌状态。
祸乱之源可以把自己从噩梦中唤醒。
施放后将替换为结束噩梦：结束所有受作用单位身上的噩梦。

description_en: Drives Bloodseeker into a bloodthirsty rage which causes him to attack faster and deal more spell damage at the cost of a percentage of his health per second.
description_zh: 使血魔陷入渴望鲜血的狂怒中，以每秒流失一定百分比生命的代价获得攻击速度和技能增强加成。
lore_en: Strygwyr shares his animalistic thirst for bloodshed.
lore_zh: 史德利古尔与人分享他那野兽般的嗜血饥渴。
notes_en: Damage dealt to Bloodseeker is non-lethal.
notes_zh: 对血魔造成的伤害不致死。
shard_en: Bloodseeker's Bloodrage attacks now deal 1.5% of the target's max health as Pure damage.
shard_zh: 血怒下血魔的攻击现在造成1.5%目标最大生命值的纯粹伤害。

description_en: Bloodseeker baptizes an area in sacred blood. After 2.9 seconds the ritual completes, causing any enemies caught in the area to take damage and become silenced.
description_zh: 血魔用圣血为一片区域洗礼。2.9秒后祭祀完成，区域范围内所有敌人都会受到伤害，并被沉默。
lore_en: The Flayed Twins are ever willing to aid those who spill blood upon the field of battle.
lore_zh: 只要有人在战场上遍洒鲜血，那么剥皮双子就乐于向他施以援手。
notes_en: Total time is a 2.6 second delay plus a 0.3 second cast time.
notes_zh: 总时间为2.6秒的生效延迟，加上0.3秒的施法时间。

description_en: Bloodseeker is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below 100%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below 25%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.
description_zh: 血魔能够感知到敌人的伤口中涌出的鲜血，敌方英雄的生命值低于100%，他的移动速度就会提升，而且生命值越低，提升效果越大。如果生命值低于25%，他还将获得该英雄的视野和真实视域。焦渴的效果可以叠加。血魔可以突破最大速度限制。
lore_en: Strygwyr becomes frenzied when blood is spilled.
lore_zh: 史德利古尔闻到血腥味就会变得无比狂热。
notes_en: Not triggered by Illusions.
Max movement speed bonus occurs when an enemy's health is at or below 25%.
Effects linger for 4 seconds if a target dies.
notes_zh: 幻象不能触发该技能。
移动速度加成在敌人生命值低于25%时达到上限。
目标死亡后效果延续4秒。

special_values.name: active_movement_speed
special_values.heading_zh: 主动开启时移动速度加成：

description_en: Causes an enemy unit's skin to rupture, dealing initial damage based on its current health. If the unit moves, it takes damage based on the distance moved.
description_zh: 让一个敌方单位皮开肉绽，根据其当前生命值造成初始伤害。单位移动后会根据移动的距离受到伤害。
lore_en: When the Bloodseeker hunts you, injuries become fatalities.
lore_zh: 当血魔猎杀你时，受伤就意味着死亡。
scepter_en: Increases initial damage and grants 2 Rupture Charges.
scepter_zh: 提升初始伤害，并且提供2点割裂能量点数。

description_en: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage. Slow lasts 1.5 seconds.
description_zh: 卓尔游侠在箭矢中附上冰冻效果，减缓敌人的移动速度并造成额外伤害。持续1.5秒。
lore_en: Ice-encased arrows pierce the silence, chilling their victims to the core.
lore_zh: 覆盖着寒冰的箭矢破空而出，将敌人彻底冻结。
notes_en: The slow duration is refreshed on successive casts.
notes_zh: 减速的持续时间在下一支冰箭射中后刷新。
scepter_en: Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.
scepter_zh: 霜冻之箭现在对敌人施加低温的叠加效果，提升霜冻之箭的伤害，并且每层叠加效果都会降低生命回复。若敌人在低温效果下阵亡，他们将会爆炸，对范围内的敌人造成伤害和减速。

special_values.name: shard_regen_reduction_pct_per_stack
special_values.heading_zh: 每层叠加生命回复降低：

description_en: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within 300 range.
description_zh: 卓尔游侠的战斗经验使她有概率发出极其精准高效的箭矢。箭矢将穿透敌人的防御，无视他们的基础护甲。如果300范围内有敌方英雄，本技能没有效果。
lore_en: The Drow Ranger is the epitome of archery prowess.
lore_zh: 卓尔游侠是弓箭手登峰造极的典型。
notes_en: Marksmanship procs have true strike.
notes_zh: 射手天赋的触发效果拥有克敌机先。

description_en: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
description_zh: 用威武的图腾猛击地面，沿直线裂开地面，制造一条无法通过的岩脊，对沿途的敌方单位造成眩晕和伤害。
lore_en: The Nishian totem splits the world to its core with tectonic force.
lore_zh: 尼西埃图腾能以惊世之力使大地裂开。
notes_en: Creeps will wait for Fissure to disappear. They will not attempt to walk around it.
Fissure is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
notes_zh: 小兵将会等待沟壑消失，不会去尝试绕开它。
沟壑不会被林肯法球抵挡。
shard_en: Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.
shard_zh: 降低沟壑的冷却时间，并且撼地者每次施放其他技能时都会沿着沟壑释放余震，造成眩晕的时间有所降低。

description_en: Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have 100 bonus attack range on the next attack.
description_zh: 强化撼地者的图腾，使下次攻击拥有额外攻击力和100攻击距离加成。
lore_en: Raigor's gorilla strength can destroy mountains.
lore_zh: 瑞格勇猛的的蛮力能摧毁山脉。
notes_en: Bonus damage is based on base damage and that given by primary attribute.
notes_zh: 攻击力加成是基于基础攻击力和主属性数值。
scepter_en: Enchant Totem becomes a ground target ability, causing Earthshaker to jump in the air and land at the target spot, casting Enchant Totem there. Self-casting the ability will behave in the original form, without jumping. Grants Enchant Totem a cleaving attack.
scepter_zh: 强化图腾可以对地施放，施放后会跳至半空中再降落至目标地点，在目标地点施放强化图腾。双击技能会按原技能施放，不会跳跃。强化图腾拥有分裂效果。

description_en: Causes the earth to shake underfoot, adding additional damage and stuns to nearby enemy units when Earthshaker casts his abilities.
description_zh: 撼地者施放技能时会引起脚下的大地震动，眩晕附近的敌方单位并造成额外伤害。
lore_en: The earth trembles beneath the mighty footsteps of Raigor.
lore_zh: 大地在瑞格强有力的步伐下颤抖。
notes_en: Using items does not trigger Aftershock.
notes_zh: 使用物品不会触发余震。

description_en: Shockwaves travel through the ground, damaging enemy units. Each enemy hit causes an echo to damage nearby units. Real heroes cause two echoes.
description_zh: 穿过地面的冲击波，伤害敌方单位。每个受到攻击的敌人都会引起伤害附近单位的反射波。英雄本体将引起两次反射。
lore_en: Tectonic plates crack, mountains fold, and foes are crushed by the Echo Slam.
lore_zh: 地壳开裂，山岳折叠，敌人遭回音击尽数碾压。

description_en: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.
description_zh: 主宰有一定概率在攻击时触发致命一击。
lore_en: The last remnant of his heritage's commitment to bladework, Yurnero ensures that the style is remembered.
lore_zh: 作为他对剑技传承的最后承诺，尤涅若立誓将使此剑技为世人所铭记。

description_en: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with 80% magic resistance and dealing damage every 0.2s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.
description_zh: 舞起具有破坏性力量的剑刃风暴，使主宰获得减益免疫状态，魔法抗性提升80%，并且每0.2秒对主宰周围的敌方单位造成伤害。旋转结束时施加强驱散效果。
lore_en: Yurnero's renowned katana techniques are feared by warriors and sorcerors alike.
lore_zh: 无论是战士还是法师，都害怕尤涅若的武士刀剑技。
notes_en: You can use items during Blade Fury.
Juggernaut can still perform attacks while in Blade Fury. However, only units that are not affected by Blade Fury, such as wards or structures, will take damage from these attacks.
notes_zh: 剑刃风暴期间可以使用物品。
主宰在施放剑刃风暴的过程中依然可以进行物理攻击。但是只有不受剑刃风暴伤害的单位，如守卫和建筑才会受到这些物理伤害。

description_en: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health. The Healing Ward moves at 325 movement speed after being summoned. Lasts 18 / 20 / 22 / 24 seconds.
description_zh: 召唤一个治疗守卫，按周围友军单位最大生命值的一定比例治疗他们。治疗守卫可以移动，移动速度为325。持续18 / 20 / 22 / 24秒。
lore_en: Of the rituals learned at the Isle of Masks, tending wounds with a bit of voodoo magic has proven to be quite useful.
lore_zh: 在遮面之岛习得的仪式之一，治疗伤口时加上一点巫毒法术往往会很有效。
notes_en: The Healing Ward can be controlled.
Multiple Healing Wards do not stack.
notes_zh: 可以控制治疗守卫。
多个治疗守卫的效果不会叠加。
shard_en: Increases ward healing and health.
shard_zh: 提升守卫的治疗量和生命值。

description_en:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
description_zh:
主宰挥剑跃向敌方目标单位，随后再以更短的攻击频率斩击该单位和附近的其它敌方单位。主宰在无敌斩期间无敌。

驱散类型：弱驱散
lore_en: 'The fruits of discipline; with practice comes strength.'
lore_zh: “自律已有成果；勤练带来力量。”
notes_en: You can use items during Omnislash.
notes_zh: 无敌斩期间可以使用物品。

description_en: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
description_zh: 召唤喷涌的洪流，短暂延迟后，将敌人冲上天，造成伤害、眩晕和减速。
lore_en: An ancestral rush of water explodes from the center of the world, called upon by the Admiral.
lore_zh: 世界中心喷涌出的上古之洪流，应舰队统帅的召唤而来。
notes_en: The initial bubble effect is only visible to allies and provides vision in fog of war.
Units tossed in the air will be stunned and still able to be attacked.
notes_zh: 初始泡泡效果仅对队友可见，并且提供战争迷雾中的视野。
飞到半空的单位将会被眩晕并且可以被攻击。

description_en: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.
description_zh: 昆卡的传奇之剑使他的下一次攻击附加额外的攻击力并在前方造成大范围的分裂攻击伤害。
lore_en: A lost Claddish soul inhabits Kunkka's trusty Tidebringer, empowering it to destroy demons of the Cataract.
lore_zh: 迷失的铁帆海军灵魂依附在昆卡信赖的宝剑——潮汐使者之中，助它消灭洪流恶魔。

description_en: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds. Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.
description_zh: 对友方或敌方英雄使用，用 X 标记他们当前位置，数秒后将他们送回 X 标记处。在技能持续时间内，昆卡可以手动触发送回。对友方英雄使用后持续时间加倍。
lore_en: The Admiral's set of arcane abilities includes some that can be used for battle as well as entertainment.
lore_zh: 舰队统帅诸多神秘能力中的一种，能用于战斗或娱乐。

description_en:
Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.

Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a 2x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.
description_zh:
召唤一艘幽灵船驶过战场，直到撞成粉碎，残骸周围的敌人将会因撞击受到伤害并眩晕。

被幽灵船碰到的友军会获得2倍效果的统帅朗姆酒。
lore_en: The final ship of the Claddish Navy is nothing but a phantom, but it is all too real to the enemies of the Admiral.
lore_zh: 铁帆舰队最后的战舰虽然只是个幻影，但它给昆卡的敌人带来的死亡却是完全真实的。
notes_en: Actual area of effect of ship's collision is larger than the boat itself.
The boat has a movement speed of 650.
notes_zh: 幽灵船实际的碰撞范围比船本身大。
幽灵船的移动速度为650。
scepter_en: Ghostship creates a fleet of 2 ships at the target point on a 2.5 second interval. Each ship now also fires 3 waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side that deal 40% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.
scepter_zh: 幽灵船在目标地点以2.5秒的间隔产生2艘船组成的舰队。每艘船现在还会从左舷和右舷发射3波炮弹，穿过敌人时造成40%幽灵船伤害。

description_en: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.
description_zh: 莉娜引导龙的吐息，放出一波火焰，烧焦所有波及的敌人。
lore_en: In the scorched barren of Misrule, Lina learned to manipulate the fiery breath of the Desert Wyrm as a form of entertainment.
lore_zh: 在纷争之国的荒焦之地，为了娱乐，莉娜学会了操纵沙漠飞龙的火焰吐息。
notes_en: Dragon Slave can hit units up to 1225 units away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 龙破斩最远能伤害1225距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

description_en: Summons a column of flames that damages and stuns enemies.
description_zh: 召唤柱状火焰伤害并眩晕敌人。
lore_en: Lina's essence allows her to focus the sun's energies, causing air to combust at will.
lore_zh: 莉娜的精华让她能够集中太阳的能量，随时让空气燃烧。
notes_en: Light Strike Array will destroy trees in its area of effect.
notes_zh: 光击阵将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

description_en: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time Lina hits an enemy with a spell. Stacks with itself. Lasts 18 seconds.
description_zh: 莉娜每次利用技能击中一个敌人都会使她获得攻击和移动速度加成。可以叠加。持续18秒。
lore_en: Dancing flames embody Lina's playful nature, bringing out her true blazing self.
lore_zh: 舞动的火焰体现了莉娜爱玩的天性，展示了她真实炙热的自我。
notes_en: Duration refreshes each time an opponent is hit with a spell.
Using items does not trigger Fiery Soul.
notes_zh: 每次技能击中敌人时都会刷新持续时间。
使用物品不会触发炽魂。

description_en: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage.
description_zh: 对单个敌方单位射出闪电，造成大量伤害。
lore_en: The air around Lina becomes so intensely torrid that it scorches a foe that comes too close with white-hot lightning.
lore_zh: 莉娜身边的空气变得极度炙热，产生白热的闪电来灼烧过于接近的敌人。
notes_en: Laguna Blade has a 0.25 delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
notes_zh: 神灭斩在技能施放到伤害生效有0.25秒延迟，因此有若干技能可以躲避该伤害。
shard_en: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.
shard_zh: 施放神灭斩会暂时让莉娜的能量达到顶峰，给予炽魂的叠加效果。

description_en: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.
description_zh: 岩石尖刺在地上沿一条直线穿刺而出。敌方单位被抛向空中，落地时被眩晕并受到伤害。
lore_en: The Demon Witch exercises his demonic covenant, opening a fissure from hell.
lore_zh: 恶魔巫师使用他的恶魔契约，打开一条来自地狱的裂缝。
notes_en: The spikes move at 2800 units per second.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 尖刺的移动速度是每秒2800码。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

description_en: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless beast, with all special abilities disabled.
description_zh: 将一个敌方单位变成人畜无害的动物，受害者无法使用所有特殊能力。
lore_en: Lion is compelled to share his transfiguration, twisting the essence of those who oppose him.
lore_zh: 莱恩被迫分享他的变形术，让反抗他的人扭曲了他们的精华。
notes_en: Instantly destroys illusions.
The target will have a base movement speed of 120, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.
notes_zh: 即刻摧毁幻象。
目标的基础移动速度为120，但是如果目标有满速状态则移速不受影响。

description_en:
CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by 15%.

Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a 50% rate.
description_zh:
持续施法 - 引导魔法能量，持续吸取魔法并减缓敌人的移动速度。如果敌人没有魔法剩余，减速效果提升15%。

可以对友军施放，给予他们50%魔法和移动速度。
lore_en: Lesser magi are nothing more than a source of magical restoration for the Demon Witch.
lore_zh: 对恶魔巫师来说，较为弱小的法师只不过是他回复魔力的来源。
notes_en: Prevents heroes from going invisible.
notes_zh: 阻止英雄进入隐身状态。
shard_en: Causes Mana Drain to affect up to 2 additional enemies and increases break distance. Lion becomes Debuff Immune with 60% magic resistance while channeling.
shard_zh: 法力吸取可以作用最多2个额外敌人，并且断裂距离增加。持续施法期间莱恩为减益免疫状态，并且获得60%魔法抗性。

description_en:
Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out, dealing massive damage to the target.

After using Finger of Death, Lion's hand becomes empowered, allowing him to use a cleaving melee attack with 250 range with bonus movement speed.

Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills.

The melee attack may be disabled by setting the ability to Alt Cast.
description_zh:
撕裂一个敌方单位，将其折磨得死去活来，并造成巨大伤害。

使用死亡之指后，莱恩的手臂增强了力量，使他可以发动带有分裂效果的近战攻击，攻击距离为250，并拥有移动速度加成。

每次技能或重拳击杀英雄后都会分别使技能和重拳永久获得额外伤害和攻击力。

技能设为（右键点击技能栏图标）后可以禁用近战攻击。
lore_en: Lion's disfigured hand is also the source of his greatest power, capable of flooding victims with malefic force.
lore_zh: 莱恩丑陋的手正是他最强大力量的来源，能够用恶魔的力量让受害者完全崩溃。
notes_en: Finger of Death has a 0.25 delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
Finger of Death only gains damage if the enemy hero dies within 3 seconds of being affected by Finger of Death.
notes_zh: 死亡一指在技能施放到伤害生效有0.25秒延迟，因此有若干技能可以躲避该伤害。
只有在敌方英雄受到死亡之指作用后3秒内死亡才会使死亡之指额外提升伤害。
scepter_en: Finger of Death gains area of effect damage on the initial cast, and increases duration and cleave damage on its subsequent melee attacks.
scepter_zh: 死亡之指的初始施法获得范围型伤害，并且后续的近战攻击提升持续时间和分裂伤害。

description_en: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from 0.01 to 2.6 / 3.4 / 4.2 / 5 seconds, with bonus damage up to 180 added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
description_zh: 射出一支绝对精准的箭矢，对第一个击中的敌人造成伤害并眩晕目标。目标距离越远，眩晕时间越长，最短0.01秒，最长可达2.6 / 3.4 / 4.2 / 5秒。根据箭矢飞行的距离还将对目标额外造成最多180点伤害。若击中的是非远古的普通单位，将直接秒杀。
lore_en: Lunar energies make the Princess of the Moon's arrows more deadly than most.
lore_zh: 明月的能量让月之公主的箭矢变得愈发致命。
notes_en: For every 150 distance the arrow travels, the stun duration upon impact increases by 0.5 seconds, and the bonus damage added increases by 14.
Sacred Arrow can hit invisible units.
Starstruck does not apply to the second Starstorm from Aghanim's Scepter.
notes_zh: 神箭每飞行150码，中箭后眩晕的持续时间将提高0.5秒，额外伤害增加14点。
月神之箭可以射中隐身单位。
流星赶月不会对阿哈利姆神杖升级群星风暴的第二次流星生效。
scepter_en: Causes Sacred Arrow to release a Starstorm on enemies along the travel path of the primary arrow, releasing a second Starstorm that deals less damage to the impacted unit.
scepter_zh: 月神之箭在主神箭行进途中对敌人释放群星风暴。对击中的单位施放第二个群星风暴，造成的伤害有所降低。

special_values.name: scepter_starstorm_target_pct
special_values.heading_zh: 主箭击中群星风暴伤害：

description_en: Mirana leaps forward into battle, empowering herself with a ferocious roar that grants bonus attack and movement speed. Speed bonus lasts 5 seconds.
description_zh: 米拉娜的坐骑向前跳跃加入战斗，发出一声凶狠的咆哮鼓舞它的主人，提升攻击和移动速度。速度加成持续5秒。
lore_en: None can fail to recognize Mirana's iconic white beast in the heat of battle.
lore_zh: 在战斗最激烈的时候，没人会注意不到米拉娜标志性的白色野兽。
shard_en: Grants +1 Leap charge.
shard_zh: 获得+1跳跃能量点数。

description_en: Calls down a wave of meteors to damage nearby enemy units. The closest enemy unit to Mirana in a 675 radius will be struck a second time.
description_zh: 召唤一波流星砸向附近的敌方单位。675范围内最近的敌方单位将会再受到一次冲击。
lore_en: The Goddess breaks the strata to empower her Princess in the time of need.
lore_zh: 月之女神打破月亮的一部分地表，让她的公主在需要之时获得力量。
notes_en: Starstorm is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
Starstorm cannot hit invisible units.
Starstorm will choose a new target for the second meteor if the first died before impact.
notes_zh: 群星风暴不会被林肯法球抵挡。
群星风暴不能伤害隐身单位。
如果原本要打击的目标死亡，群星风暴的第二次星落会重新选择一个目标。

description_en: Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path. Morphling is invulnerable during Waveform.
description_zh: 变体精灵化为波浪向前涌进，对路径上的敌人造成伤害。变体精灵在波浪形态中是无敌的。
lore_en: A torrential flood takes enemies by force.
lore_zh: 轻松卷走敌人的滔滔洪水。

description_en:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier. If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
description_zh:
用猛烈的水波打击一个敌方单位，将其击退并眩晕，同时造成伤害，伤害量为基础伤害加上变体精灵自身敏捷值乘以伤害系数的额外伤害。如果变体精灵的敏捷比力量高50%，将采用最高伤害系数。

击退距离和眩晕时间是根据变体精灵的力量值。如果变体精灵的力量比敏捷高50%，将造成最大击退和眩晕。
lore_en: The Morphling calls upon his elements to crush his opponents with waves.
lore_zh: 变体精灵唤出自身的元素，构成波浪碾碎对手。
notes_en: Projectile moves at 1150 speed.
notes_zh: 弹道移动速度为1150。

description_en: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Strength and pouring them into Agility at a rate of 4 / 8 / 12 / 16. The process is reversible.
description_zh: 变体精灵改变它的形态，将一些力量以4 / 8 / 12 / 16点/秒的速率转化成敏捷。该过程可逆。
lore_en: Shifting water makes it difficult to discern the nature of Morphling.
lore_zh: 不断变化的流水让变体精灵的本质很难被辨别。
notes_en: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Agility Gain will also level up Strength Gain.
notes_zh: 属性变换不能转化物品提供的属性加成。
升级敏捷获取时也会升级力量获取。
shard_en: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.
shard_zh: 变体精灵在眩晕状态下可以变换属性。降低魔法消耗。

description_en: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Agility and pouring them into Strength at a rate of 4 / 8 / 12 / 16. The process is reversible.
description_zh: 变体精灵改变它的形态，将一些敏捷以4 / 8 / 12 / 16点/秒的速率转化成力量。该过程可逆。
lore_en: Shifting water makes it difficult to discern the nature of Morphling.
lore_zh: 不断变化的流水让变体精灵的本质很难被辨别。
notes_en: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Strength Gain will also level up Agility Gain.
notes_zh: 属性变换不能转换物品提供的属性加成。
升级力量获取时也会升级敏捷获取。
shard_en: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.
shard_zh: 变体精灵在眩晕状态下可以变换属性。降低魔法消耗。

description_en: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities and changing his primary attribute based on his target. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.
description_zh: 使自身向敌方目标改变，获得其基础技能，并且基于目标改变自己的主属性。技能持续时间内可以来回切换。
lore_en: Staring into Morphling produces a reflection that mimics the beholder.
lore_zh: 凝视变体精灵会映出一个能够模仿本体的倒影。
notes_en: You can't target yourself with Morph.
Morph won't copy Shard/Scepter abilities unless Morphling owns the respective item.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
notes_zh: 变体精灵自身及其控制的单位不能作为变形的目标。
变形不会复制魔晶/神杖类技能，除非变体精灵自身也拥有相应物品。
不会触发法术反弹。
scepter_en: Adds an alt-cast to Morph. When enabled, a strong illusion is created of the target hero that can cast all of the hero's basic abilities. If the illusion is alive when Morphling toggles the ability, he will take the place of the illusion, destroying it.
scepter_zh: 变形增加多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）。开启后会产生目标英雄的强幻象，可以施放英雄的所有基础技能。如果变体精灵切换变形时幻象还存活，他就会摧毁该幻象，并取而代之。

description_en: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
description_zh: 影魔对其正前方区域释放毁灭能量，对该区域中的敌人造成伤害，并且根据当前支配死灵的灵魂数量造成额外伤害。在目标身上施加一个连中效果，持续时间内再被毁灭阴影击中将受到额外伤害。
lore_en: Nevermore's trademark for harvesting souls.
lore_zh: 奈文摩尔标志性的灵魂收割手段。
notes_en: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.
notes_zh: 连中效果的持续时间在每次连中时刷新。
shard_en: Cooldown reduced by 2s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking 12% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.
shard_zh: 每击中一名敌方英雄后冷却时间减少2秒。对击中的敌人施加可叠加的12%移动速度减缓的负面效果。

description_en: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining 1.35 bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant 4 souls. On death, he releases 30% of them from bondage.
description_zh: 影魔每杀死一个单位都会窃取其灵魂，每个灵魂获得1.35点额外攻击力。击杀英雄会获得4个灵魂。影魔死亡时30%的灵魂将逃离他的束缚。
lore_en: Harvested souls swirl in and out of the Abysm, empowering the Shadow Fiend to increase the size of his collection.
lore_zh: 被收割的亡魂在魂渊内外盘旋，增加了影魔的力量，也方便他扩大自己的灵魂收藏。
notes_en: Denies and neutral creeps also provide bonus damage through Necromastery.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
notes_zh: 反补、杀死中立生物也能收集到灵魂。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

description_en: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies.
description_zh: 影魔的出现使得周围的敌人护甲降低。
lore_en: Even being near Nevermore eats away at one's soul.
lore_zh: 即使只是在影魔周围游荡，灵魂也会被侵蚀。
notes_en: Stacks fully with other armor reduction abilities and aura.
notes_zh: 与其他降低护甲的技能和光环完全叠加。

description_en:
Shadow Fiend gathers up to 20 of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for 0.6 seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of 2.15. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.

Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
description_zh:
影魔将捕获的灵魂中最多20个进行聚集，以多道魔能的形式释放。若距离影魔过近将受到数道魔能的伤害。每道魔能对敌方单位造成伤害的同时，还将造成恐惧和减速效果，并且降低魔法抗性，持续0.6秒，最高可达2.15秒。通过支配死灵收集的每个灵魂会为魂之挽歌创造一道魔能。

死亡时会自动释放魂之挽歌，不占用主动大招的冷却时间。
lore_en: The captured souls of those past slain are released to ravage their former allies.
lore_zh: 那些死者的灵魂被捕获后尽数释放，毁灭他们生前的盟友。
notes_en: One line is generated from Shadow Fiend for every 1 soul in his possession.
Fear and movement slow do not apply if the Requiem was released on death.
notes_zh: 影魔收集的灵魂中，每1个会产生一道伤害波。
死亡时释放的魂之挽歌不会施加恐惧和减速效果。
scepter_en: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.
scepter_zh: 降低冷却时间，并且魂之挽歌可以回归影魔。影魔会回复与回归伤害值相等的生命。

description_en: Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit that damages and slows, while summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.
description_zh: 对敌方目标单位投出一支有魔力的灵魂之矛，造成伤害并减速，同时召唤一个幻象攻击该单位。
lore_en: Azwraith's proficiency at spearing his family's meal of fish is proving quite useful in the battlefield.
lore_zh: 阿兹瑞斯对于用长矛捕鱼养家的精通被证明在战场上非常有用。
notes_en: Illusions within 675 range of Phantom Lancer will mimic the cast animation.
notes_zh: 幻影长矛手附近675范围内的幻象也会模仿施法动作。

description_en:
Phantom Lancer briefly vanishes from the battlefield. After 1 second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Extends duration of all illusions. The two added doppelgangers have different properties: one takes normal damage and deals none, while the other takes 500% bonus damage and deals -80% less damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
description_zh:
幻影长矛手暂时从战场上消失。经过1秒，幻影长矛手和附近的所有幻象都会出现在目标地点的随机位置，并产生两个新的幻象。施放技能后延长所有幻象的持续时间。新加的两个幻象拥有不同的特性：一个承受正常百分比的伤害，不具有攻击力，另一个额外承受500%伤害，继承的攻击力相比本体减少-80%。

驱散类型：弱驱散
lore_en: Dread Magus Vorn's death imbued the Phantom Lancer with the ability to bend and fracture all spectrums of light.
lore_zh: 恐怖巫师沃恩的死亡让幻影长矛手获得了将自身在所有光线之中弯折破碎的能力。
notes_en: This ability can be used to dodge projectiles, and dispel debuffs.
Trees near a reappearing unit will be destroyed.
Phantom Lancer and his allies can see which illusion is the 100% damage illusion.
notes_zh: 这个技能可以躲避攻击和技能弹道，并且驱散负面效果。
重新现身的单位附近的树木将会被摧毁。
幻影长矛手和他的队友可以分辨出哪个幻象承受100%伤害。

description_en: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for 8 seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last 4 seconds.
description_zh: 幻影长矛手的攻击有一定几率使自己的存在破碎，产生自身的幻象。幻象也有几率进一步破碎，再产生幻象。幻影长矛手产生的幻象持续8秒，幻象产生的幻象则持续4秒。
lore_en: Each of Azwraith's lance attacks feels like two from a normal warrior; or three; or four...
lore_zh: 阿兹瑞斯的每次刺击感觉就像一个普通战士的两次，或三次，或四次……
shard_en: Adds an active ability to Juxtapose. Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for up to 8 seconds while generating a duplicate image to confuse enemies. His movement speed is increased by 15% during this invisibility.
shard_zh: 并列增加主动技能。使幻影长矛手进入隐身，最多持续8秒，同时产生一个复制幻象来迷惑敌人。隐身期间自身移动速度提升15%。

description_en:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional 3% of its impact damage every 0.5s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed.

At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt.

Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.
description_zh:
以矢量为目标。帕克向路线方向发出一个魔法球，对经过路径上的敌人造成伤害。法球每0.5秒会在作用范围内额外造成3%击中伤害，但超过最大施法距离后法球会被摧毁。

在幻象法球飞行过程中，帕克可以使用灵动之翼来传送到法球所在的位置。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让法球的路线为向前的直线。
lore_en: The playful Faerie Dragon delights in confusing others, vanishing and reappearing where unexpected.
lore_zh: 顽皮的仙女龙很喜欢捉弄他人，突然消失再意想不到地重现。
notes_en: The Illusory Orb grants unobstructed vision around its location while it travels.
Jaunting to the Orb will disjoint projectiles.
notes_zh: 幻象法球在飞行途中提供顺畅视野。
将自己传送到幻象法球可以躲避攻击和技能弹道。

description_en: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.
description_zh: 帕克传送至目标地点洒出它神秘的仙女粉尘，对周围的敌人造成伤害和沉默。
lore_en: With a mischievous grin, Puck spreads its enchanted powder which disrupts magical flow.
lore_zh: 帕克淘气地一笑，洒出中断魔法流动的附魔粉尘。

description_en: CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 帕克暂时将自己转移到另一个位面，从而免疫伤害。
lore_en: With a quip and flash, Puck returns to the alien dimension from whence it came.
lore_zh: 带着嘲笑，帕克瞬间回到了她的异维度故乡。
notes_en: Puck retains collision size while under the effects of Phase Shift.
Issuing any action will cancel Phase Shift.
Puck is invulnerable during Phase Shift.
notes_zh: 帕克在相位转移状态下依然具有碰撞体积。
进行任何动作都会中止相位转移。
帕克在相位转移状态下无敌。
shard_en: Puck's attacks deal bonus magic damage. Puck attacks all enemies within its attack range every time it phase shifts.
shard_zh: 帕克的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。帕克每次施放相位转移时对攻击距离内所有敌人发动一次攻击。

description_en: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them. If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
description_zh: 创造一个变化无常的的魔法梦境来困住敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害和束缚。如果被困住的敌方英雄试图挣脱缠绕走出梦境，将因为梦境破碎而受到眩晕和额外伤害。
lore_en: The Faerie Dragon sows confusion by forcing its enemies to vividly dream about their own mortality.
lore_zh: 仙女龙散播混乱，让敌人陷入鲜活的梦境，见证自己死亡的命运。
scepter_en: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to 90% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.
scepter_zh: 梦境缠绕作用下的所有敌人都会被帕克攻击，攻击频率基于帕克攻击频率的90%。即使目标挣脱梦境，被眩晕时攻击也会继续。

description_en: Pudge covers himself with a layer of flesh that blocks damage of any type taken from any source.
description_zh: 帕吉用一层血肉包裹自己，可以格挡所有来源的所有类型伤害。
lore_en: The Butcher gives new meaning to the words 'meat shield.'
lore_zh: 屠夫赋予“肉盾”这个词新的含义。

description_en: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.
description_zh: 向一个单位或方向射出血腥的肉钩。勾住第一个遭遇的单位，并将它拖到帕吉身边，如果是非远古单位会被秒杀，其他敌方单位则是受到伤害。
lore_en: The Butcher's hook is a symbolic nightmare, its curved blade a frightening reminder of his slaughterous intent.
lore_zh: 屠夫的肉钩是噩梦的象征，锋利的倒钩暗示了他嗜血的本性。
notes_en: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
Meat Hook hits invisible units.
Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.
Meat Hook can hit and drag runes to Pudge, refunding the Hook's mana cost.
notes_zh: 钩中敌人后将打断持续施法类技能。
肉钩能击中隐身单位。
肉钩可以穿过树木、地形、建筑、远古生物和肉山。
肉钩可以拖拽友方单位，不过他们不会受到伤害。
肉钩可以将神符拖拽至帕吉身旁，并返还肉钩的魔法消耗。
shard_en:
When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.

When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by 50%.
shard_zh:
肉钩击中敌人时会根据牵引距离造成额外伤害。

肉钩击中友军时，肉钩的冷却时间会减少50%。

description_en: A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.
description_zh: 能够造成持续伤害并减缓敌人移动速度的毒性云雾——同时对敌军和自身造成伤害。
lore_en: A foul odor precedes a toxic, choking gas, emanating from the Butcher's putrid, ever-swelling mass.
lore_zh: 有毒的气体从屠夫腐烂肿胀的肉体中放出，味道恶心得令人窒息。
notes_en: Using Rot doesn't interrupt channeling.
Rot hits invisible units.
If Pudge is silenced, he can't deactivate Rot if it's activated.
Rot self-damage is non-lethal.
notes_zh: 使用腐烂不会打断持续施法。
腐烂能伤害隐身单位。
即使帕吉在开启腐烂后被沉默，腐烂也不会关闭。
腐烂的对己伤害不致死。
scepter_en: Increases Rot radius by 200, damage by 90, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by 20%.
scepter_zh: 腐烂的作用范围提升200，伤害提升90点，并且可以降低敌人的20%生命回复。

description_en: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of 75 units, up to a minimum of 125 range.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 帕吉撕咬一个敌方单位，使其失去行动能力并受到持续伤害。伤害量为基础伤害加上帕吉力量值的一定百分比，帕吉将回复与伤害量相等的生命。帕吉会将该单位以每秒75的速度向自身牵引，最多牵引125距离。
lore_en: 'When I'm through with these vermin, they'll be fit for a pie!'
lore_zh: “等我干掉这些蠢货以后，就可以把它们做成肉饼了！”
notes_en: If a unit becomes invisible while Dismembered, it will still be under the effects of Dismember.
notes_zh: 即使肢解的目标在受到作用的过程中隐身，还是不会脱离肢解的作用。

description_en: Creates a cone of ethereal energy that strikes multiple enemy units.
description_zh: 利用虚空能量制造出分叉的闪电，打击多个敌方单位。
lore_en: Originally used to open shows with the travelling con-man, Rhasta's lightning display shocks adversaries in more ways than one.
lore_zh: 最初是给流浪艺人作开场秀用的，罗斯塔的闪电之炫能分成数叉来震击不止一个对手。
notes_en: Can hit secondary targets up to 1000 distance away.
notes_zh: 最远可以伤害1000距离外的次级单位。

description_en: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.
description_zh: 将一个敌方单位变成人畜无害的动物，使其无法攻击和使用技能。
lore_en: Rhasta often ended performances by turning himself into a chicken - now, the humiliation is shared.
lore_zh: 罗斯塔通常将自己变成一个小鸡来结束表演——现在他把这个屈辱分享给别人了。
notes_en: Instantly destroys illusions.
The target will have a base movement speed of 100, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.
notes_zh: 立即摧毁幻象。
目标的基础移动速度为100，但是如果目标有满速状态则移速不受影响。

description_en: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 使用魔法绑住一个敌方单位，使其无法攻击和移动，同时持续吸取他们的生命能量。
lore_en: A self-defense incantation, Rhasta developed shackles after his master was slain in the Bleeding Hills.
lore_zh: 一个用于自卫的咒语，是罗斯塔的师傅在流血丘陵罹难后，他所开发的枷锁咒。
scepter_en: Increase cast range. Every 0.9 seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within 600 of the target for 100% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within 2000 units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.
scepter_zh: 提升施法距离。被绑住的单位每0.9秒会释放一次辐射状的苍穹震击，作用于600范围内其他所有单位，造成伤害的数值为100%苍穹震击普通伤害。另外还能使枷锁可以对暗影萨满附近2000范围内的友军和群蛇守卫施放。友方单位不会被控制。

description_en: Summons 10 Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps deal half damage to the Serpent Ward.
description_zh: 召唤10个群蛇守卫攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫免疫魔法。非英雄单位对毒蛇守卫造成半额伤害。
lore_en: Snake charming was a big part of the Shadow Shaman's act; now Rhasta can empower the snakes to do his bidding.
lore_zh: 耍蛇曾是演艺中的重头戏；现在罗斯塔可以授予蛇力量，以服从他自己的吩咐。

description_en: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. Damage and slow increases with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once each direction.
description_zh: 释放一波威力随扩张程度提升的等离子能量场，收缩时也会对经过的敌人造成伤害和减速。距离雷泽越远，伤害和减速越高。等离子场对每个单位造成两次伤害。
lore_en: The Lightning Revenant rules the Underscape with plasmatic power.
lore_zh: 闪电幽魂用等离子的力量统治着永劫之墟。

description_en: Creates a charged link between Razor and an enemy Hero, stealing damage from the target and giving it to Razor. Allows Razor to attack while moving with the link active.
description_zh: 在雷泽和敌方英雄之间创造静电连接，偷取目标的攻击力并转移给雷泽。雷泽在连接生效时可以边移动边攻击。
lore_en: Razor's polarity channels electricity into his being, draining the power of his opposition.
lore_zh: 雷泽的极性吸引电流通向自身，以汲取他对手的力量。
notes_en: The link is broken when either unit dies or the distance between them becomes 250 units greater than Static Link's cast range.
notes_zh: 链接在一方单位死亡或双方距离超过250后断裂。

description_en: Passively increases Razor's movement speed.
description_zh: 被动提升雷泽的移动速度。

description_en: A powerful lightning storm strikes out at the enemy unit with the lowest health, dealing damage and reducing armor.
description_zh: 强大的闪电风暴，打击生命值最低的敌方单位，造成伤害并削弱护甲。
lore_en: Ride the lightning.
lore_zh: 掌控闪电。
notes_en: Each blast targets the lowest health enemy unit within range.
Eye of the Storm will prioritize striking static linked heroes.
Successive casts of Eye of the Storm will stack.
notes_zh: 每次打击都会以范围内血量最低的敌方单位为目标。
风暴之眼优先打击受到静电连接作用的英雄。
连续施放的风暴之眼可以叠加。
scepter_en: Causes Eye of the Storm to strike two different units instead of one and can damage structures. When striking buildings, it will only target towers, barracks, and the Ancient.
scepter_zh: 风暴之眼可以同时打击两个目标，并且能对建筑造成伤害。打击建筑时，只会以防御塔、兵营和遗迹作为目标。

description_en: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.
description_zh: 冥魂大帝向一个敌方单位发射冥魂火球，造成即时伤害和眩晕，并持续对目标造成伤害和减速。
lore_en: Ostarion calls on his damned lineage, laying waste to his opponents.
lore_zh: 奥斯塔里昂激活他的冥魂怒意，毁灭他的敌人。

description_en: Gains a Charge for every 2 creeps killed and 2 charges per hero killed. Activate to spend all charges, summoning skeletons that respawn once when killed. Skeletons benefit from Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal.
description_zh: 击杀2个非英雄单位可获得1点能量，击杀1名英雄可获得2点能量。可以主动使用，消耗所有能量点数召唤可以复活一次的骷髅兵。骷髅兵享受吸血灵魂的吸血效果。
lore_en: Wraith King's blade drains his enemy's essence to feed his aura.
lore_zh: 冥魂大帝的剑刃汲取敌人的精华，填补自身的元气。
notes_en: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Casting Wraithfire Blast on an enemy causes the skeletons to attack that enemy.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
对敌人施放冥火爆击会导致骷髅兵攻击该敌人。

special_values.name: skeleton_building_damage_reduction
special_values.heading_zh: 骷髅兵对建筑伤害降低：

special_values.name: skeleton_bonus_hero_damage
special_values.heading_zh: 骷髅兵对英雄额外伤害：

description_en: Wraith King passively deals bonus damage on an attack with a cooldown.
description_zh: 冥魂大帝被动地在攻击时造成额外伤害，本技能具有冷却时间。
lore_en: One blow to crush a foe.
lore_zh: 单凭一击，斩敌无匹。
shard_en: Mortal Strike hits curse their target, causing them to take 75% of the initial attack damage again as Pure damage after a 3 second delay. Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal applies to the curse damage.
shard_zh: 本命一击会诅咒目标，使其在3秒延迟后再次受到75%原攻击伤害的纯粹伤害。吸血灵魂的吸血效果对诅咒伤害有效。

description_en: Wraith King's form regroups after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle. Upon death, enemy units in a 600 radius are slowed. Skeletons spawn and attack each nearby enemy hero. Can be self-cast to kill Wraith King instantly.
description_zh: 冥魂大帝倒下后，他飞散的冥魂会重组，使他复活。死亡时附近600范围内的敌人会被减速，会产生骷髅兵攻击附近每个敌方英雄。可以对自身施放，使冥魂大帝立刻阵亡。
lore_en: Conspirators against the Wraith King wonder why he never stays dead.
lore_zh: 冥魂大帝的对头们一直很疑惑，为什么他就是不会死透。
notes_en: Wraith King won't revive if he doesn't have enough mana.
If Wraith King has an Aegis and Reincarnation off cooldown, Reincarnation will trigger first.
Revives with full HP and Mana.
notes_zh: 如果魔法不足冥魂大帝将不会重生。
如果冥魂大帝拥有不朽之守护，同时绝冥再生不处于冷却状态，死亡后将首先触发绝冥再生。
重生后生命值和魔法值全满。
scepter_en: Reduces cooldown.
scepter_zh: 减少冷却时间。

special_values.name: shard_skeleton_count
special_values.heading_zh: 每个英雄产生骷髅兵数量：

description_en: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.
description_zh: 召唤一群食腐虫在死亡先知面前的敌人中肆虐。
lore_en: Krobelus' many trips to the grave gather a flock of the damned.
lore_zh: 克萝贝露丝在鬼门关的来来回回聚集了一大群被诅咒的生物。
notes_en: Can hit units up to 1110 range away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 最远能伤害1110距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

description_en: Fires a projectile that prevents enemy units in a target area from casting spells.
description_zh: 放出一个弹道，阻止目标区域内的敌人施放魔法。
lore_en: Peering into the veil of her opponent's demise, Krobelus sees a silent future.
lore_zh: 透过她敌人的命运之纱，克萝贝露丝看到的是沉默的未来。
notes_en: Doesn't prevent usage of items.
notes_zh: 不能阻止使用物品。

description_en: Death Prophet's occult knowledge deepens with experience, gaining movement speed and spell cooldown reduction.
description_zh: 死亡先知的神秘学识随着经验积累而加深，获得移动速度和技能冷却时间减少。

description_en: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts 40 seconds.
description_zh: 释放恶灵偷走敌方单位和建筑的生命。恶灵需要回到她身上才能再次攻击。持续时间结束后，死亡先知根据造成的伤害量，获得一定比例的治疗。对建筑造成50%伤害。持续40秒。
lore_en: Over time, the banshee remnants of her previous lives return to haunt the present.
lore_zh: 伴随着无数次的死亡，她前世死亡幻化出的女妖们总是萦绕于现世。
notes_en: Radius represents the area in which the spirits will acquire targets around Death Prophet.
Spirit damage isn't reduced by damage block abilities.
notes_zh: 作用范围代表死亡先知周围的恶灵寻找目标的范围。
伤害格挡类技能不能减少恶灵伤害。
scepter_en: Whenever an enemy is affected by Death Prophet's spells or when she attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy for an increased bonus of its usual damage then return to her with life.
scepter_zh: 敌人受到死亡先知的技能作用，或被死亡先知攻击时，会有一只恶灵飞出攻击敌人，造成高于平常的伤害，再返回使自身回复生命。

description_en: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.
description_zh: 斯温用他充满魔力的手套对目标周围内所有敌人造成伤害和眩晕。
lore_en: The Rogue Knight's iron gauntlet, taken from the school of his father, strikes his foes to their core.
lore_zh: 流浪剑客从他父亲的学校里取得的精铁护手能对敌人造成致命打击。
scepter_en: Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional 180 damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.
scepter_zh: 提升施法距离，并且对目标施加弱驱散效果。可以影响无敌目标。设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，额外造成180点伤害并且斯温会跟随风暴之拳行进。

description_en: Sven strikes with great force, cleaving all nearby enemy units with his attack.
description_zh: 斯温以巨力攻击，并对所有附近的敌方单位造成分裂攻击伤害。
lore_en: The Vigil Knights still seek to reclaim the stolen Outcast Blade from Sven, a weapon capable of cutting wide swaths through lesser warriors.
lore_zh: 守夜骑士团仍然在试图从斯温那里取回被偷走的弃誓之刃，一把能在低阶战士中杀出条大路的利剑。

description_en: Sven's Warcry heartens his allied heroes for battle, increasing their armor and movement speed. Lasts 8 seconds.
description_zh: 斯温的战吼激励着同伴作战，提升他们的护甲和移动速度。持续8秒。
lore_en: Calling a few lines from the Vigil Codex fortifies Sven's obedience to his rogue code. So poetic!
lore_zh: 吟诵守夜人法典的句子能够强化斯温对其流浪法则的遵从。太有诗意了！
shard_en: Increases radius and bonus movement speed. Warcry is now undispellable and provides a 300 physical damage barrier.
shard_zh: 提升作用范围和移动速度加成。现在战吼不可驱散，并提供300点物理伤害护盾。

description_en: Sven channels his rogue strength, granting bonus damage and slow resistance for 30 seconds.
description_zh: 斯温爆发出他流浪剑客的力量，获得攻击力加成和减速抗性，持续30秒。
lore_en: With the strength that shattered the Sacred Helm, the Rogue Knight stands unopposed in melee combat.
lore_zh: 凭借能够击碎神圣之盔的力量，流浪剑客在近身肉搏中未尝一败。
notes_en: The bonus damage is based on base damage and the primary attribute of Sven.
notes_zh: 额外攻击力是基于斯温的基础攻击力和主属性数值。

description_en: Creates an explosively charged image of Storm Spirit that walks to the target position and lasts for 12 seconds. Will detonate and deal damage if an enemy unit comes near it.
description_zh: 风暴之灵制造一个充满爆炸性能量的自身残影，会向目标地点走去，持续12秒。如果有人接近就会引爆造成伤害，残影持续12秒。
lore_en: Raijin Thunderkeg's duality allows him to admire himself in shocking fashion.
lore_zh: 雷神·风暴烈酒的二象性让他可以欣赏自己被电时的百态。
notes_en: Remnants take 0.75 second to materialize after the spell is cast.
Remnants grant unobstructed vision for their duration.
The explosion actually hits units in a 300 radius, but will only be triggered in 235.
Can be self-cast to cast in place.
notes_zh: 残影在技能施放0.75秒后才能实体化。
残影在持续时间内拥有顺畅视野。
残影爆炸将伤害300码作用范围内的单位，但是触发范围是235码。
可以对自身施放，这样会原地施放。

description_en: A vortex that pulls an enemy unit to Storm Spirit's location.
description_zh: 将一个敌人拖到风暴之灵所在位置的涡流。
lore_en: Raijin's thunderous, boisterous energy often draws others into an electrifying situation.
lore_zh: 雷神狂暴的雷霆力量总是让其他人为之一电。
scepter_en: Electric Vortex affects all enemies within a radius around Storm Spirit.
scepter_zh: 电子涡流变成范围型技能，可以作用于风暴之灵周围所有敌人。

description_en: Casting a spell creates an electrical charge, which is released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.
description_zh: 施法时会产生电荷，在风暴之灵下次攻击时被释放，对附近敌人造成伤害并减速。
lore_en: Pow! Zip! Zap!
lore_zh: 啪！嘶！咝！
notes_en: Using items doesn't trigger Overload.
Overload charges do not stack.
notes_zh: 使用物品不会触发超负荷。
超负荷效果不会叠加。
shard_en: Can be activated to grant Storm Spirit and nearby allied heroes 3 Overload charges. Provides bonus Attack Speed. Lasts up to 12 seconds or until the charges are depleted.
shard_zh: 施放后风暴之灵和附近友方英雄获得3次超负荷效果。提供额外攻击速度。持续最多12秒，或效果用尽。

description_en: Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield until he depletes his mana or reaches his target. The activation mana cost is 25+7.5% of his total mana pool, and the cost per 100 units traveled is 10+0.65% of his total mana pool. Damage is expressed in damage per 100 units traveled.
description_zh: 风暴之灵变成不稳定的电流在战场上横冲直撞，直到他的魔法耗尽或到达目标才停下。施法消耗为25+总魔法量的7.5%，每移动100距离消耗10+总魔法量的0.65%，本技能造成的伤害每飞行100距离就会递增。
lore_en: The Storm is coming in.
lore_zh: 风暴来袭。
notes_en: Abilities and items can be used while traveling.
This ability will destroy trees.
Storm Spirit is invulnerable during Ball Lightning.
notes_zh: 行进过程中可以使用技能和物品。
该技能可以摧毁树木。
风暴之灵在球状闪电期间是无敌状态。

description_en:
Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit
