Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.
description_zh:
沙王钻入地面挖掘隧道前进，穿出地面时伤害并眩晕上方的敌方单位。对击中的英雄施加腐尸毒。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），直接朝指定方向立刻施放，不需要走向目标地点。
lore_en: Crixalis often lies in wait, burrowing under the surface to ambush his adversaries.
lore_zh: 克里瑟历斯经常钻入地下埋伏，等待伏击敌人。
notes_en: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

description_en: Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.
description_zh: 沙王制造一起可怕的沙尘暴，对敌方单位造成伤害，同时沙王身处其中时获得隐身效果。沙王离开该区域后效果结束。
lore_en: Some say Crixalis is a mirage; his carapace appearing then vanishing between the whirling sands of the Scintillant Waste.
lore_zh: 有人认为克里瑟历斯只是传说中的幻影，因为他的甲壳在闪烁荒原的沙尘中总是若隐若现。
notes_en: Sand Storm can be used to dodge projectiles.
Sand King briefly becomes visible upon attacking or using spells while in Sand Storm. Sand King will become invisible again in 0.7 seconds.
notes_zh: 沙尘暴可以用来躲避攻击和技能弹道。
沙王在沙尘暴中攻击或使用技能会暂时显形。0.7秒后将再次隐形。

description_en: After a cast point of 2 seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.
description_zh: 经过2秒施法前摇后，沙王向地中发送扰动，引起大地剧烈震动。所有范围内的敌人会受到伤害并被减速。每次后续震波都会提高伤害传播半径。
lore_en: Many an explorer was lost to the quicksands of the Scintillant Waste.
lore_zh: 许多探险家丧生于闪烁荒原的流沙。
notes_en: The pulses are centered on Sand King, not where he first cast the spell.
notes_zh: 地震波将以沙王为中心，而不是他施放技能的地点。
scepter_en: When the pulses start, 3 Stinger attack areas are created every 0.5s at random locations, each measuring 35% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply 40% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause 1 attack(s).
scepter_zh: 地震的脉冲开始时每0.5秒会在随机地点产生3片尾刺的攻击区域，每片区域为地震当前范围的35%，对击中的敌人造成40%尾刺伤害。魔晶的地震波会产生1次攻击。
shard_en: Increases Epicenter damage per pulse. Every 3s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.
shard_zh: 提升地震波伤害，每3秒都会在沙王身上产生一道较小的地震波。

description_en: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.
description_zh: 用岩石轰炸一块区域，对敌方单位造成短间隔的伤害并眩晕。
lore_en: Inanimate rock becomes animate when called by the Stone Giant.
lore_zh: 当受到山岭巨人召唤时，毫无生气的石头也会很有杀伤力。

description_en: Grabs the nearest unit in a 300 radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.
description_zh: 抓起小小身旁300范围内最近的单位，不论敌友，扔向目标单位或神符，落地时将造成伤害。
lore_en: Tiny's gargantuan stature allows him to catapult even the sturdiest of warriors.
lore_zh: 小小那巨大的身形让他能够随意抛起最强壮的勇士。
notes_en: You can toss allies, but they don't take damage.
Toss deals 33% of its damage to buildings.
Debuff Immune units can be targeted but cannot be tossed.
Flight time is 1.1s.
notes_zh: 你可以投掷队友，但他们不会受到伤害。
投掷对建筑物造成33%的伤害。
可以对减益免疫单位施放，但是不能将他们扔起，或对他们造成伤害。
飞行时间是1.1秒。

description_en: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks. The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.
description_zh: 抓起一棵树，使小小在有限次数的攻击里获得攻击距离加成、攻击力加成和溅射攻击。可以将树木扔出，对远距离的敌人造成攻击伤害。
lore_en: Sticks and stones break all the bones, with structures sure to follow.
lore_zh: 木棍和石头就能让骨头散架，而建筑也将马上步其后尘。
notes_en: The cooldown begins when the tree is thrown.
notes_zh: 树木扔出后技能进入冷却。

description_en: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, movement speed and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.
description_zh: 小小崎岖的身体不断成长，提升了攻击力、移动速度、护甲和投掷的威力，但攻击速度降低。
lore_en: Watching a hill become a mountain is awe-inspiring - especially if the mountain begins laying waste to adversaries.
lore_zh: 亲眼看着丘陵变成山峦是震撼的——特别是这座山将他的敌人毁灭的时候。
shard_en: Units tossed by Toss or trees tossed by Tree Throw or Tree Volley now deal additional damage and slow in a larger area of effect at their landing location.
shard_zh: 现在投掷扔出的单位，扔树和树木连掷扔出的树木都会在落地点的更大范围内造成额外伤害和减速效果。

description_en: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.
description_zh: 释放一道会跳跃穿越附近敌人的闪电，并造成伤害。
lore_en: Arc Lightning is Zeus' favorite spell to use against puny mortals.
lore_zh: 弧形闪电是宙斯在对付渺小的凡人时最喜欢用的法术。

description_en: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a 600 radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in 325 range.
description_zh: 召唤一道闪电打击一个敌方单位，造成伤害及短暂眩晕。施放后，雷击在目标周围600范围内提供空中视野和真实视域。本技能可以对地施放，将会自动作用于325范围内最近的敌方英雄上。
lore_en: A shocking punishment for rebellious heathen.
lore_zh: 对那些反叛的异教徒最震慑的天罚。
notes_en: You can interrupt channeling spells and items with this ability.
notes_zh: 该技能可以打断持续施法类技能和物品。

description_en: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit by his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
description_zh: 宙斯攻击或通过技能击中敌人都会电击他们，造成他们当前生命值一定百分比的伤害。
lore_en: The air crackles with static when the Thundergod walks the world.
lore_zh: 当天神行于世间，空气中满是静电爆裂。

description_en: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be. Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck.
description_zh: 用闪电打击所有敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害，无论他们身在何处。在打击前提供每个英雄的真实视域。
lore_en: The Lord of Heaven smites all who oppose him, near or far.
lore_zh: 神王毁灭一切胆敢反抗他的敌人，他们无所遁形。

description_en: Slardar slithers ahead, moving significantly faster and passing through units. Slardar has 100% slow resistance for the first 2.5s. The slow resistance gradually fades over the remaining sprint duration.
description_zh: 斯拉达向前蜿行，移动速度得到显著提升，并且可以穿越单位。在最初2.5内斯拉达获得100%减速抗性。减速抗性会在剩余的冲刺时间内逐渐衰减。
lore_en: As Slardar has made the transition from the Deeps, it has been necessary to use his powerful tail for sprinting instead of swimming.
lore_zh: 斯拉达从深海来到陆地后，发现有必要用强有力的尾巴冲刺来代替游泳。
notes_en: Activating this skill doesn't interrupt channeling abilities.
notes_zh: 开启此技能不会打断持续施法。

description_en: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. After the stun, the affected units are slowed.
description_zh: 猛击地面，留下一片水洼，对附近敌方单位造成伤害并眩晕。眩晕结束后还会受到减速。
lore_en: A swift crush of might and water breaks even the toughest of defenses.
lore_zh: 强力的快速碎击，溅起的水浪打破最坚固的防御。
shard_en: Slithereen Crush now applies Corrosive Haze for a short time to units affected.
shard_zh: 鱼人碎击会对受到作用的单位施加短时间的侵蚀雾霭。

description_en: After 3 attacks, your next attack will bash the target.
description_zh: 3次攻击后，下次攻击会重击目标。
lore_en: Thieves of the wealth of the Deep Ones meet the brutality of the Slithereen Guard in melee combat.
lore_zh: 偷窃深海一族宝藏的盗贼在近身战斗中遇到了鱼人守卫的残暴之力。
notes_en: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
notes_zh: 不能与碎颅锤叠加。

description_en: Reduces enemy armor to amplify physical damage and provides True Sight and vision of the targeted unit, revealing invisibility. The enemy unit leaves a trail of water behind it.
description_zh: 削弱敌人的护甲，加深他受到的物理伤害，同时提供目标的真实视域，显示隐身单位。敌方单位将在身后留下水迹。
lore_en: Even the strongest armor counts for little when left to the brine of the sea.
lore_zh: 即使是最坚硬的铠甲，一旦遇到海水也是不堪一击。

description_en: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.
description_zh: 召唤一股巨浪攻击一个敌方单位，减速并削弱护甲。
lore_en: During his championship of the Sunken Isles, Leviathan gained mastery over the open sea.
lore_zh: 在沉没之岛的竞赛中，利维坦赢得了对公海的统治。
scepter_en: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line. Decreases cooldown.
scepter_zh: 巨浪变成点地施放的波形技能，可以作用于直线上的单位。降低冷却时间。

description_en:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of 40% movement speed. Lasts 4s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
description_zh:
加厚潮汐猎人的外皮，可以被动格挡物理伤害。对非英雄单位的格挡伤害有所减少。潮汐猎人的外皮在他受到的伤害超过临界值后还将移除负面的状态效果。

可以主动开启，以40%移动速度的代价使伤害格挡量加倍。持续4秒。

驱散类型：强驱散
lore_en: Claddish navymen tell tales of a mighty sea-faring beast that suffered spear and sword but continued to lay waste to the fleet.
lore_zh: 铁帆海军里有一个传言，说是有只强大的海兽，明明被矛刺中被剑砍伤依然能践踏舰队。

special_values.name: bonus_reduction_per_kill
special_values.heading_zh: 每次击杀提升伤害格挡：

description_en: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus 225 units.
description_zh: 潮汐猎人挥动他巨大的锚攻击附近的敌人，攻击时获得攻击力加成，同时降低敌人的攻击力。锚击的作用范围为潮汐猎人的攻击距离 + 225。
lore_en: Stolen from one of Admiral Kunkka's flagships, Leviathan's heavy anchor proves useful as a melee weapon.
lore_zh: 从舰队统帅昆卡的一艘旗舰上偷来的重锚，被利维坦用作有效的近战武器。
notes_en: Anchor Smash works on all Ancient creeps except for Roshan.
Damage done by Anchor Smashes triggered by Kraken Shell Cleanse is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 锚击对远古生物同样有效，不过对肉山无效。
海妖外壳净化触发的锚击造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

description_en: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.
description_zh: 猛击地面，触手向各个方向穿出，伤害并眩晕附近所有敌方单位。
lore_en: Calling to the abyssal god Maelrawn has resulted in entire armadas being lost at sea.
lore_zh: 呼唤深海之神麦尔朗恩的举动导致了整支武装舰队在海上失踪。
notes_en: Ravage will hit invisible units.
Ravage waves move outwards at a speed of 725.
notes_zh: 毁灭能伤害隐身单位。
毁灭以725的速度向外扩散。

description_en: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.
description_zh: 向一个敌方单位射出魔法箭，眩晕并造成伤害。
lore_en: A simple Skywrath technique, the magic missile is Shendel's primary tool for vengeance.
lore_zh: 魔法箭是天怒一族的简朴战技，现在也是仙德尔莎主要的复仇工具。
shard_en: Bounces once on an enemy, prioritizing heroes, within 75% of Magic Missile's current cast range from the first target.
shard_zh: 可以对敌人弹射一次，以英雄优先，弹射距离为主目标的75%魔法箭施法距离内。

description_en: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes. Vengeful Spirit herself receives 25% extra bonus.
description_zh: 复仇之魂的存在提升了附近友方英雄的攻击力。复仇之魂自身获得25%额外加成。
lore_en: Although they may not share her undying passion for revenge, allies do draw on her fanaticism in combat.
lore_zh: 尽管盟友可能不会理解她对于复仇那无休止的热爱，但作战时他们还是会利用她的狂热。
notes_en: Break disables the damage aura.
notes_zh: 破坏会使攻击力光环失效。
scepter_en:
Increases self multiplier. Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals full damage, and can cast all of her spells.

If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawn, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her. Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.
scepter_zh:
提升自身加成系数。死亡时产生一个复仇之魂的强幻象，继承全额攻击力，可以施放自己的所有技能。

复仇之魂复活时若幻象依然存在，则自身会直接将其取代。幻象获得的经验将给予英雄。强幻象不会被相关技能秒杀。

description_en: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.
description_zh: 复仇之魂放出邪恶的嚎叫，削弱敌人的总攻击力和护甲，并打开前方经过路径的视野。
lore_en: Shendel's haunting voice hints at her approaching vindication.
lore_zh: 仙德尔莎那挥之不去的低语暗示着她的裁决将至。

description_en: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.
description_zh: 与一个目标英雄瞬间交换位置，不论敌我。移形换位会打断目标的持续施法。敌方英雄被交换后受到伤害。复仇之魂和被交换的友方英雄都会获得等同于造成伤害的护盾。
lore_en: Martyrdom is a small price to pay for vengeance.
lore_zh: 牺牲只是为了复仇付出的小小代价。
notes_en: Works on Spell Immune units.
Trees near Vengeful Spirit and the target will be destroyed when the spell is cast.
Channeling spells are interrupted by Nether Swap.
notes_zh: 对减益免疫单位有效。
技能施放后复仇之魂和目标附近的树木将会被摧毁。
移形换位能够打断持续施法。

description_en: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area.
description_zh: 召唤具有破坏性的冰爆，降低目标区域内的敌人的移动速度。
lore_en: The air temperature around Rylai drops rapidly, chilling all around her to the core.
lore_zh: 莉莱周围的温度急剧下降，让附近的一切被急速冻结。
notes_en: Crystal Nova provides vision in the targeted area for the duration.
notes_zh: 冰霜新星在持续时间内提供目标区域的视野。

description_en: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time. Deals 4x damage to non-ancient creeps.
description_zh: 操控冰霜包围一个敌方单位，禁止移动和攻击，并持续造成伤害。对非远古的普通单位施放将造成4倍伤害。
lore_en: Rylai channels winds from the Blueheart Glacier, imprisoning attackers in thick blocks of ice.
lore_zh: 莉莱引来蓝心冰川的寒风，将动手的敌人封锁在冰块里。
notes_en: Frostbite is considered a root.
notes_zh: 冰封禁制为捆缚效果。

description_en:
Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map. Allies within a 1200 radius of Crystal Maiden receive more mana regeneration.

Crystal Maiden passively gains mana regen amplification.
description_zh:
地图上所有友方单位获得额外魔法恢复。水晶室女附近1200范围内友军获得更高的魔法恢复。

水晶室女被动获得魔法恢复增强。
lore_en: Cold temperatures promote the essence of magic, causing Rylai's presence to allow spell usage in abundance.
lore_zh: 低温提升了魔法精华，莉莱的出现能够让盟友更频繁的使用魔法而不必担心消耗。

description_en: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with 100 random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts 10 seconds.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 以水晶室女为中心召唤100次随机冰爆轰炸敌人，将其减速并造成大量伤害。持续10秒。
lore_en: Once the place of her exile, Icewrack has become an anchor for Rylai's frigid onslaught.
lore_zh: 冰川残骸，莉莱曾经的流放之地，早已变成她修炼寒冰魔法的场所。
notes_en: The slow is applied on all enemies in the radius, even if they aren't hit by an explosion (lasts 1 second).
Explosions occur every 0.1 seconds.
notes_zh: 减速效果对作用范围内所有敌人有效，即使他们没有受到冰爆的伤害（效果持续1秒）。
每0.1秒产生一次爆炸。
scepter_en: Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move 75% slower during this. Increases total number of explosions by 20%. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over 3s.
scepter_zh: 使自身在极寒领域期间可以移动、施法和攻击。仍然可以被敌人打断。在此期间移动速度降低75%。冰爆总数提升20%。对极寒领域内停留超过3秒的所有单位都会施加冰封禁制。

description_en: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it. If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to 0.6.
description_zh: 将目标束缚在正对其后的一个敌方单位或树上。若目标后面没有其它敌方单位或树木，则眩晕时间减少至0.6秒。
lore_en: Windranger's variety of bow skills includes an arrow with thick ropes attached to encumber any escaping target.
lore_zh: 风行者的诸多弓技中，有一种用密集的绳索来束缚目标，让其难以逃脱的箭矢。
notes_en: This spell can shackle two enemies together, stunning them both.
Can shackle the target to an enemy unit or tree at most 575 behind the target.
Shackleshot can be disjointed.
notes_zh: 该技能可以将两个敌人一起束缚，使他们同时眩晕。
束缚击能将目标束缚在身后最多575距离的敌方单位或树木。
束缚击可以被躲避。

special_values.name: bonus_damage_per_hero
special_values.heading_zh: 每个英雄的攻击力加成：

description_en: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to 1 second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 风行者为她的弓蓄力，射出一支强力的箭矢，最长可蓄力1秒，其间可以打断蓄力，蓄力时间越长，箭矢伤害越高。这支箭会对穿过的所有敌方单位造成伤害和减速效果，并破坏树木。每伤害一个单位，箭矢的伤害和减速效果都会降低。
lore_en: During her early years of training, Lyralei learned to fire powerful arrows that cleaved even trees to reach their targets.
lore_zh: 在早年的训练生涯，莱瑞蕾学会了射出足以破开树木击中目标的强力箭矢。
notes_en: Powershot will destroy trees in its area of effect.
notes_zh: 强力击将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

description_en: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.
description_zh: 提升移动速度，并闪避一切物理攻击。
lore_en: Lyralei enchants gusts of winds to fight incoming attacks.
lore_zh: 莱瑞蕾运用疾风之力抵御来临的攻击。

description_en: Windranger channels the wind to gain 350 / 425 / 500 additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage. Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
description_zh: 风行者受风的引领，攻击敌方单位或建筑的攻击速度增加350 / 425 / 500，但是攻击力降低。不过次级物品效果的额外伤害不会降低。
lore_en: Lyralei's ability to bombard opponents with a flurry of arrows is unparalleled - even at the expense of accuracy.
lore_zh: 莱瑞蕾具备狂风般地向敌人轰射出无数箭矢的无双本领——尽管牺牲了不少威力。
notes_en: Issuing a Hold Position command will pause Windranger's attacks.
Windranger can move while attacking.
notes_zh: 下达停在原地的指令会暂停风行者的攻击。
风行者在攻击时可以移动。

description_en: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for 4 seconds. The primary target receives both base and area damage.
description_zh: 破坏性的寒霜在目标敌方单位身上爆发，造成范围伤害并降低范围内敌人的移动和攻击速度，持续4秒。主要目标所受伤害最高。
lore_en: Frost-mage Ethreain has not forgotten even the simplest of ice manipulation.
lore_zh: 冰霜法师艾斯瑞安从没忘记哪怕最简单的冰系操控咒。

description_en: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every 1 seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.
description_zh: 施加一个冰霜魔盾环绕目标，减少受到的普通攻击伤害。魔盾生效时，每1秒都会对附近的敌方单位放出冰霜魔法，造成少量伤害和减速。
lore_en: First conceived of to protect him in his mortal years, the frost magic that Ethreain weaves around himself has only grown colder with time.
lore_zh: 在人世的那些年最初学会的护身法术，而艾斯瑞安现在编织在周围的冰霜魔法随着时间愈发冰冷。
notes_en: Spell-immune enemies are not affected by the damage or slow.
Frost Shield can be cast on buildings.
notes_zh: 免疫技能的敌人不会受到伤害或减速。
冰霜魔盾可以对友方建筑施放。

description_en: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to 10 times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
description_zh: 释放一个在敌人间弹跳至多10次的霜冻之球，每次击中敌人后都会造成伤害和减速效果。每次弹跳后会提升后续的伤害。连环霜冻无法弹跳时会停留在上个目标身上，如果出现新目标可以再次弹跳。
lore_en: Almost universally considered the ultimate in frost magic, Ethreain's orb of frozen death strikes fear into those who dare stand against him.
lore_zh: 几乎所有人都认为是冰霜法术中的终极咒语，艾斯瑞安的霜死之珠能用恐惧击打那些胆敢站出来反对他的人们。
notes_en: Chain Frost cannot be disjointed.
Chain Frost has a movement speed of 850.
Chain Frost doesn't bounce to Zombies.
notes_zh: 连环霜冻无法被躲避。
连环霜冻的移动速度为850。
连环霜冻不会弹跳到墓碑召唤的僵尸身上。

description_en: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.
description_zh: 抛出一个装满麻痹粉末的药剂，在敌方单位之间弹跳，眩晕击中的敌人并造成伤害。每次弹跳都会提升伤害。
lore_en: The Witch Doctor recycles the bones of fallen friends and foes, using the powder as part of his arsenal of charms and alchemy.
lore_zh: 巫医回收倒下的友军和敌人的尸骨，磨成粉末用作他的符咒和炼丹术的材料。
notes_en: Targets can be hit multiple times, as long as another unit is struck in between the bounces.
notes_zh: 目标可以受到多次作用，只要附近有其他单位可以进行弹跳。

description_en: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.
description_zh: 巫医集中魔力治疗附近的友军单位，开启巫毒疗法后会持续消耗巫医的魔法。
lore_en: Zharvakko's hocus pocus is not limited only to hexxing his opponents and is quite adept at curing ailments.
lore_zh: 扎瓦克的药酒不仅可以用来戏弄对手，用来治疗小伤也不错。
notes_en: Healing is done in 0.33 second intervals.
Can heal Spell Immune units.
notes_zh: 治疗间隔为0.33秒。
对减益免疫单位有效。

description_en: Curses all enemy Heroes and player-controlled targets in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.
description_zh: 对一个较小区域内所有敌方英雄和玩家控制的目标施放诅咒，他们将每秒受到固定伤害，并且从诅咒开始每4秒根据失去的血量再受到爆发伤害。
lore_en: Certain voodoo magics can make an enemy regret engaging the Witch Doctor.
lore_zh: 用对了巫毒法术会让敌人后悔招惹巫医。
notes_en: If an affected hero's health has increased above the amount they had when Maledict was cast, the burst damage will be 0.
notes_zh: 受到作用的英雄如果在结算时当前血量高于原血量，则额外伤害为0。

description_en: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of 8 seconds. Death Ward has 50% bonus accuracy.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 召唤一个死亡守卫，会优先攻击其攻击距离内的敌方英雄。最多持续8秒。死亡守卫拥有50%额外必中率。
lore_en: Witch Doctor performs a ritualistic dance, one that haunts the dreams of those who live to recount it.
lore_zh: 巫医跳起他的传统巫毒舞蹈，在生者的梦中作祟。
notes_en: The Death Ward is invulnerable, and is only destroyed if Witch Doctor is interrupted or its duration expires.
The Death Ward can be controlled, and made to attack a specific target.
Death Ward attacks once every 0.22 seconds.
notes_zh: 死亡守卫是无敌的，只有在巫医被打断或持续时间结束后才会被摧毁。
死亡守卫可以受到控制，选择攻击特定目标。
死亡守卫每0.22秒攻击一次。
scepter_en: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.
scepter_zh: 死亡守卫的攻击会向附近英雄弹射。

description_en: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
description_zh: 丢下一个烟雾弹，沉默其中的敌人，同时使他们的攻击落空。
lore_en: Since his escape during the night of his betrayal, Riki has valued the use of a simple smoke screen to confuse his opponents.
lore_zh: 自从力丸在背叛之夜逃脱后，他就很看重利用朴素的烟幕来迷惑对手。
notes_en: Can be cast during Tricks of the Trade.
Doesn't prevent the use of active items.
notes_zh: 可以在绝杀秘技期间施放。
不能阻止使用物品。
shard_en: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by 5 and cannot be targeted by their allies.
shard_zh: 烟幕中的敌人护甲降低5点，而且无法成为他们友军的目标。

description_en: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by 100% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.
description_zh: 传送到目标背后，如果是敌人对其造成100%短暂减速，并发动一次拥有额外伤害的攻击。
lore_en: The Stealth Assassin's agile movement makes him impossible to escape.
lore_zh: 隐形刺客迅捷的动作让他的目标几乎不可能逃脱。

description_en: Riki fades into the shadows, becoming invisible until he attacks. Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.
description_zh: 力丸遁入阴影，变为隐身状态，主动攻击敌人后力丸将会显形。击杀英雄和助攻会提供额外经验。
lore_en: Riki comes for you.
lore_zh: 力丸来找你了。

description_en: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes 2 random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 力丸转移出现实位面，每隔一段时间从背后随机攻击附近的2个随机敌方单位。期间他的攻击伤害为固定值。
lore_en: The Stealth Assassin is not afraid to fight dirty, and specializes in attacking his opponents from behind.
lore_zh: 隐形刺客从不忌讳使用肮脏的战斗手法，尤其擅长从对手的背后发动攻击。
scepter_en: Increases Cast Range to 500. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have 15% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts 1s longer and does an additional 2 attacks.
scepter_zh: 提升施法距离至500。可以对友方单位施放，持续时间内藏在他们体内。藏在友方单位体内时，他会拥有15%移动速度加成，同时绝杀秘技的持续时间提升1秒，并且额外发动2次攻击。

description_en: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances. An instance strikes every 2 seconds.
description_zh: 将谜团的力量集中于一个目标，使它受到多次伤害并反复被眩晕。每2秒眩晕一次。
lore_en: Strange gravities pull at the core of those who would oppose you, holding them in place.
lore_zh: 奇特的重力将敌人的重心进行拖拽，让他们动弹不得。
shard_en: Increases Malefice stun duration by 0.3s and creates an Eidolon next to the target every instance of Malefice stun. These Eidolons will not multiply further.
shard_zh: 憎恶的眩晕时间增加0.3秒，并且每次眩晕都会在目标身旁产生一个虚灵体。这些虚灵体不会再次分裂。

description_en: Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health. The eidolons health is increased by 3% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply. When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.
description_zh: 以生命为代价召唤三个谜团自身的碎片。虚灵的生命值会有所增加，数值为谜团当前生命值的3%。这些虚灵都由谜团控制，在反复经过几次成功的攻击后，虚灵会再次分裂，并完全回复生命值。
lore_en: Enigma is capable of drawing aspects of himself from other dimensions - the result is a trio of dark eidolons that hunt the corporeal plane.
lore_zh: 谜团具备将自身的形体吸入另一个维度的能力——随之产生的就是三个追猎肉体位面的暗黑虚灵。

description_en: Steeps an area in dark resonance, dealing 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 + a percentage of the enemies current HP as damage.
description_zh: 使一块区域浸入暗共振中，对敌方单位造成5 / 10 / 15 / 20 + 基于敌人当前生命值的伤害。
lore_en: A section of the world slowly descends into the void.
lore_zh: 世界的一部分缓缓跌入虚空。
notes_en: This ability destroys trees in its area.
Multiple instances of Midnight Pulse do not stack.
notes_zh: 此技能将摧毁范围内的树木。
多个午夜凋零的效果不会叠加。

description_en: CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units. Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 召唤一个强引力漩涡吸住敌方单位。被黑洞影响的单位不能移动、攻击或施法。
lore_en: The ground trembles as Enigma channels his ultimate vortex of destruction, a singularity with the power to end worlds.
lore_zh: 谜团将毁灭的终极漩涡，具有毁天灭地力量的奇点进行引导，大地因此颤抖。
scepter_en: Black Hole deals additional damage equivalent to 4% of the unit's Max Health per second and does a non-interrupting pull towards it in a 1000 AoE. Pulls at a rate of 175.
scepter_zh: 黑洞额外造成等同于单位4%最大生命值的每秒伤害，并且产生一个1000范围，没有打断效果的牵引效果。牵引速度为175。

description_en: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.
description_zh: 发射强烈的能量光束，对目标造成伤害和致盲。被致盲的单位，所有物理攻击都会落空。
lore_en: Boush perfected this rock cutting laser in his subterranean laboratory, never considering its combat utility.
lore_zh: 鲍什在他的地下实验室完善了这把激光岩石切割器，但并未考虑到它的作战效用。
scepter_en: Upgrades Tinker's Laser into a Shrink Ray, reducing the main target's size, current health, and maximum health by 13% (stacking). Does not pierce debuff immunity.
scepter_zh: 修补匠的激光升级成缩小射线，使主目标的模型大小、当前生命值和最大生命值减少13%（可以叠加）。

description_en: Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.
description_zh: 征募一支机器人军队，摧毁修补匠周围的敌方单位。
lore_en: Even though the laboratory has since been sealed off, the ability to radio in robotic drones is still in working order.
lore_zh: 就算实验室最后被封锁了，呼叫机械无人机的无线电还是畅通的。
notes_en: Robots spawn at a rate of 24 per second.
notes_zh: 机器人的产生速率是每秒24个。
scepter_en: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.
scepter_zh: 机械行军在穿过友方英雄时会施加不可叠加的持续治疗效果。

description_en: CHANNELED - Resets the cooldown on Tinker's abilities.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 重置修补匠技能的冷却时间。
lore_en: A new battery here, another set of rockets there, Boush continually improves on existing technology.
lore_zh: 这儿换块新电池，那儿塞几枚火箭弹，鲍什不断改进现有的技术。

description_en: Consumes a charge to launch a ball of shrapnel that showers the target area in explosive pellets. Enemies are subject to damage and slowed movement. Reveals the targeted area. Shrapnel charges restore every 35 seconds.
description_zh: 消耗一点能量射出一发带有爆炸弹片的榴霰弹，在目标区域降下弹雨。区域内的敌军受到伤害并被减速。榴霰弹将给予目标区域的视野。榴霰弹的能量每过35秒恢复1点。
lore_en: Kardel's modular rifle also fires incendiary rounds, useful for assaulting entrenched locations.
lore_zh: 卡德尔的模块化步枪还能发射燃烧弹，对攻击战壕中的敌人很有用。
notes_en: Damage is dealt 11 times, immediately at spell effect then every second.
Does not damage buildings.
Provides vision in the targeted area.
notes_zh: 总共造成11次伤害，第一次在技能生效时，接下来每秒造成一次伤害。
不会对建筑造成伤害。
将拥有目标区域的视野。

description_en: Sniper increases his accuracy, giving him a chance to deal 20 / 50 / 80 / 110 extra damage and knock back his enemies. Knockback distance increases based on how close the enemy is to Sniper. Headshots briefly slow enemy movement and attack speed by -100%.
description_zh: 狙击手提高他的精确度，有一定概率造成20 / 50 / 80 / 110点额外伤害并击退敌人。敌人距离狙击手越近，击退距离越远。爆头会短暂地降低敌人-100%移动和攻击速度。
lore_en: Taking potshots at steepstalkers in his childhood has been thoroughly refined into perfect leads on enemy combatants.
lore_zh: 童年时对潜行兽的胡乱射击现在被练就成攻击敌人的技术。

description_en:
Passively increases Sniper's attack range by 160 / 240 / 320 / 400.

On cast, Sniper gains increased vision, Headshot chance, and attack range. Slows you by 65% for the duration and restricts your vision to a frontal cone.
description_zh:
被动提升狙击手160 / 240 / 320 / 400攻击距离。

主动开启后，狙击手的视野距离、爆头几率和攻击距离提升。自身在持续时间内减速65%，并且视野限制在前方的锥形区域内。
lore_en: Kardel always takes it upon himself to stay as far from harm as he can while still performing his role - taking perfect aim.
lore_zh: 卡德尔总是保持自己待在远处的安全距离，同时他仍然可以作为狙击手进行完美的射击。

special_values.name: active_attack_range_bonus
special_values.heading_zh: 主动效果攻击距离加成：

description_en: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage plus bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.
description_zh: 狙击手锁定一个目标敌方单位，经过短时间瞄准后射出一发毁灭性的子弹，从远距离对目标造成狙击手的攻击伤害 + 额外伤害，并且短暂眩晕目标。每当狙击手击杀敌方英雄，暗杀的冷却时间就会重置。
lore_en: In order to fulfill the prophecy and return to his home town, Kardel must make another shot as perfect as the one on the day of his ancient test.
lore_zh: 为了完成预言然后返回家乡，卡德尔必须和参加古老考验那天一样，做出完美的射击。
notes_en: Crosshair effect is only visible to allies.
Invisibility doesn't disjoint the projectile.
notes_zh: 准星效果只对队友可见。
隐身不能躲避该技能弹道。
scepter_en: Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.
scepter_zh: 暗杀释放得更快，并且敌方目标的眩晕时间更久。

description_en: Necrophos releases a wave of death around him, dealing damage to enemy units and healing allied units.
description_zh: 瘟疫法师向他的周围释放死亡波纹，伤害敌方单位并治疗友军单位。
lore_en: Poor souls who succumb to Rotund'jere's plagues are recycled for future use.
lore_zh: 可怜的灵魂们，屈从于罗坦德吉利的瘟疫后遭到回收，沦为他用。
notes_en: Death Pulse can't be disjointed.
notes_zh: 死亡脉冲不能被躲避。

description_en: Necrophos stills the hearts of his opponents, causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time.
description_zh: 瘟疫法师让敌人的心脏停跳，使附近敌方单位按最大生命值一定百分比持续流失生命。
lore_en: Those who come within a short distance of Necrophos can feel pestilence and plague in the air.
lore_zh: 接近瘟疫法师就会感受到在他周围的空气中存在的瘟疫和灾祸。
notes_en: Damage won't disable items like Blink Dagger.
Does not affect ancient creeps.
notes_zh: 伤害不会禁用像闪烁匕首等物品。
不能作用于远古生物。
scepter_en: Heartstopper Aura's Health Decay is increased by 50% of Necrophos's current health regeneration.
scepter_zh: 竭心光环的生命流失伤害提升，数值为瘟疫法师当前生命恢复的50%。

description_en: Necrophos gains stacking regen for 8 seconds for each unit he kills. Hero kills multiply the effect.
description_zh: 瘟疫法师每次击杀单位都将获得可叠加的恢复效果，持续8秒。击杀英雄后获得数倍的效果。
notes_en: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

description_en: Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing. If Necrophos kills an enemy this way, he'll permanently gain Health and Mana Regen. Any kill under this effect is credited to Necrophos.
description_zh: 眩晕目标敌方英雄，然后造成基于他当前损失生命值的伤害。瘟疫法师击杀敌人后将永久获得生命和魔法恢复。如果目标在死神镰刀效果下死亡，击杀者为瘟疫法师。
lore_en: The amount of death and suffering in the air increases the power of Necrophos's plague magic.
lore_zh: 空气中充斥的死亡和苦难增强了瘟疫法师的瘟疫魔法。
notes_en: Damage is dealt at the end of the stun.
notes_zh: 伤害在眩晕结束后结算。

special_values.name: damage_per_health
special_values.heading_zh: 每点损失生命值造成伤害：

description_en: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.
description_zh: 将数个可见的敌方单位连接在一起，其中一人所受伤害的一定百分比会被其他所有人感受到。
lore_en: An ancient incantation that links the vital energies of multiple lifeforms into one collective body.
lore_zh: 一个远古咒语，能将多个生命体的生命能量连接成一个集合体。
notes_en: The shared damage type is the same as the type of damage inflicted.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 共享伤害的类型与原伤害相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

description_en: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.
description_zh: 术士低声说出一个咒语，对一个单位施展法术，使周围的敌方单位受到伤害，周围的友方单位被治疗。目标单位也会被治疗或受到伤害，取决于他是友军还是敌人。
lore_en: Demnok's arcane arts have a myriad of uses, allowing them to be powerful friendly enchantments or damaging curses.
lore_zh: 戴蒙的奥术有无穷的用途，可以用来强化友军也可以用作诅咒伤害敌人。

description_en: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to 10 / 12 / 14 / 16 seconds. Enemies are slowed for 1 second after leaving the area or the spell ends.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 随施法时间增强的减速气流，还会造成伤害。持续最多10 / 12 / 14 / 16秒。在魔法结束或目标离开生效区域后，敌人仍会被减速1秒。
lore_en: Demnok manipulates space-time, impairing entire armies.
lore_zh: 戴蒙操纵时空，削弱所有敌军。
notes_en: The slow increase is based on length of the channel, not the duration an enemy was standing in the area.
notes_zh: 减速效果的增加是根据持续施法的时长，而不是敌人在区内停留的持续时间。
shard_en: While channeling, Warlock spawns a minor imp every 2 seconds that lasts for 15 seconds and explodes dealing damage to all enemies around them upon death.
shard_zh: 持续施法时每2秒术士会召唤一个魔童，持续15秒，魔童死亡时会爆炸，对周围所有敌人造成伤害。

description_en: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for 0.8 seconds. The Golem lives 60 seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.
description_zh: 从深渊召唤一个地狱火，眩晕敌人0.8秒。地狱火持续60秒，能够减免部分技能的伤害，具有较高的减速抗性，拥有永久献祭和烈焰之拳技能。
lore_en: Demnok unleashes the captive spirit in his Dreadwood staff, causing destruction in enemy ranks.
lore_zh: 戴蒙释放被他关在恐惧之木法杖中的异界灵魂，在敌阵中引发毁灭。
notes_en: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.
notes_zh: 该技能将摧毁作用范围内的树木。
scepter_en: Calls 2 Golems.
scepter_zh: 召唤2个地狱火。

description_en: Beastmaster sends his axes flying and calls them home again, slicing through enemy units and trees along their path. Each axe can hit an enemy once, and amplifies subsequent damage from Beastmaster and his units.
description_zh: 兽王投出他的斧头然后召回它们，切开飞过的敌人和树木。每把飞斧对同一个敌人只能击中一次，并且加深来自兽王和其单位的伤害。
lore_en: While learning to maneuver in nature alone, the Beastmaster also mastered the use of a pair of tomahawks, adept at cutting down trees as well as adversaries.
lore_zh: 在独自学习野外生存时，兽王也掌握了飞斧的运用技巧，使他能够熟练地砍下树木，或者敌人的脑袋。
notes_en: This ability destroys trees.
notes_zh: 此技能将摧毁树木。
shard_en: Beastmaster's attacks on enemy heroes also apply the Wild Axes debuff of its corresponding level.
shard_zh: 兽王对敌方英雄的攻击还会施加相应等级的野性之斧负面状态。

description_en: Untaps the inner fury of Beastmaster and units he controls, passively increasing their attack speed.
description_zh: 唤起兽王和他控制单位的内心狂怒，被动提高他们的攻击速度。
lore_en: Beastmaster's ability to incite the innate strength of animals was seen in the mauling of the king of Slom.
lore_zh: 兽王激起野兽先天力量的能力，在他袭击斯洛姆国王时得到了展现。
notes_en: Break disables the passive attack speed bonus.
notes_zh: 破坏会使被动攻击速度加成失效。

description_en: Hurls a poisoned dagger which deals large initial damage, and then deals damage over time. The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for 16 seconds. An instance of damage is dealt every 3 seconds.
description_zh: 投出一把淬毒匕首，造成大量初始伤害，并持续造成后续伤害。中毒的单位移动速度被减缓，持续16秒。每3秒会再造成一次伤害。
lore_en: Akasha's envenomed dagger allows her to delight in the drawn out suffering of her victims.
lore_zh: 阿卡莎的淬毒匕首让她从受害者的痛苦中得到愉悦。
notes_en: The affected unit slowly regains its original movement speed every second during the duration.
Units afflicted by Shadow Strike can be denied by their allies when their HP drops below 25% of their maximum health.
notes_zh: 受到作用的单位在持续时间内将逐秒缓慢地恢复至初始移动速度。
受到暗影突袭作用的单位在生命值低于最大值25%时可以被队友反补。
scepter_en: Causes Shadow Strike to become a 300 AoE Spell. When Shadow Strike ends or is re-applied to an enemy Hero, the target emits a Scream of Pain, hitting any nearby enemies.
scepter_zh: 暗影突袭变为300范围型技能。暗影突袭效果结束后或重新施加给敌方英雄时，目标将放出痛苦尖叫，伤害附近所有敌人。

description_en: Short distance teleportation that allows Queen of Pain to move in and out of combat.
description_zh: 短距离传送，能让痛苦女王自由出入战场。
lore_en: The Secret Queen lives up to her title, making her pain impossible to escape.
lore_zh: 秘密中的女王名副其实，你无法从她的痛苦逃脱。
notes_en: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.
notes_zh: 闪烁可以躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。
shard_en: Releases a sonic boom when Queen of Pain blinks, at both her starting and ending locations. Deals 125 damage in a 300 AoE and silences the target for 1.75 seconds.
shard_zh: 在痛苦女王的闪烁起点和落地点各释放一次音爆。在300范围内造成125点伤害，并沉默1.75秒。

description_en:
The Queen of Pain lets loose a piercing scream around her, damaging nearby enemies.

25% of the damage dealt to heroes is reflected back to her.
description_zh:
痛苦女王发出刺耳的尖叫，对周围敌人造成伤害。

造成伤害的25%会反弹回她身上。
lore_en: The sultry voice of Akasha beckons her opponents while stealing their souls.
lore_zh: 阿卡莎那魅惑的声音吸引着敌人的同时也在偷取他们的灵魂。
notes_en: Scream Of Pain will hit invisible units.
Scream Of Pain cannot be disjointed.
Damage to illusions is not reflected. Damage reflected is before reduction and non-lethal.
Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 痛苦尖叫能作用隐身单位。
痛苦尖叫无法被躲避。
对幻象造成的伤害不会反弹。反弹的伤害为减免前的，而且不致死。
反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

description_en: Creates a gigantic wave of sound in front of Queen of Pain, dealing heavy damage to all enemy units in its wake and pushing them back.
description_zh: 痛苦女王在她面前制造出强大的声波，对其轨迹上的所有敌人造成大量伤害，并将他们击退。
lore_en: Her most exquisite of all of torments, Akasha's Sonic Wave puts her poor foes out of their misery.
lore_zh: 阿卡莎最为精致的折磨，她的音波让可怜的敌人从痛苦中得到解脱。
notes_en: Sonic Wave can hit units up to 1150 units away.
notes_zh: 超声冲击波最远能伤害1150距离外的单位。

description_en: Beastmaster lets loose a deafening roar that stuns, and shoves open a path to its target. All units in the path of the roar are damaged, while units shoved aside by the roar have their movement and attack speed slowed. Additionally, Beastmaster and his units gain 40% movement speed for 2 seconds.
description_zh: 兽王发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，使目标敌方单位受到伤害并眩晕，同时在兽王和他的猎物之间清出一条通道。通道上的所有单位都被震开，也受到伤害并被降低移动和攻击速度。另外，兽王和他的单位获得40%移动速度提升，持续2秒。
lore_en: The Beastmaster has learned to channel his primal instincts into an animalistic roar, causing devastation in the ranks of enemies.
lore_zh: 兽王学会将他的原始本能凝聚为猛兽般的怒吼，在敌阵之中引发巨大的破坏。

description_en: Launches a ball of venom in a line, poisoning enemy units so that they take both initial damage and damage over time, as well as suffering slowed movement. Venomous Gale deals damage every 3 seconds over its duration.
description_zh: 沿直线射出一个毒液球，碰到的敌人受到初始伤害和持续伤害，并受到减速效果影响。瘴气在持续时间内每3秒造成一次持续伤害。
lore_en: A concoction of various stings, poisons, and toxins gathered from the jungles of Jidi Isle, victims surviving it are rare.
lore_zh: 一种由基迪岛丛林里搜集的各种毒针、毒液和毒素混合而成的药剂，几乎没有人能在沾到它后存活下来。
notes_en: Venomous Gale can be lethal.
Duration damage is dealt every 3 seconds.
Slow starts at -35 / -40 / -45 / -50%, and decreases as time passes.
notes_zh: 瘴气可以致死。
技能持续时间内每3秒造成一次伤害。
初始减速效果为-35 / -40 / -45 / -50%，减速效果将逐渐降低。
shard_en: Increases cast range and projectile speed by 25%. When Venomous Gale impacts enemy heroes, 2 Plague Wards are created around them.
shard_zh: 施法距离和弹道速度提升25%。瘴气只要击中每个敌方英雄就会在他们周围制造2个瘟疫守卫。

description_en: Venomancer's attacks slow enemies and deal damage over time.
description_zh: 剧毒的攻击会持续减速敌人并造成伤害。
lore_en: The paralytic sting of the creature which caused his transformation now belongs to the Venomancer.
lore_zh: 造成他变异的生物身上的麻痹毒刺，现在属于剧毒术士了。
notes_en: Poison Sting damage can be lethal.
Damage from Poison Sting does not interrupt healing from items, nor does it activate the cooldown on Blink Dagger.
notes_zh: 毒刺的伤害可以致死。
毒刺造成的持续性伤害不会打断物品的回复效果，也不能使闪烁匕首进行冷却状态。

description_en: Summons a plague ward to attack enemy units and structures. The ward is immune to magic. Wards gain the Poison Sting level from Venomancer, dealing 50% of the full damage.
description_zh: 召唤一个瘟疫守卫来攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫对魔法免疫。守卫拥有毒刺攻击，效果与毒刺技能的当前等级相同，造成50%的原技能伤害。
lore_en: A mixture of his old herbalist talents and newfound toxic mastery creates a living embodiment of plague.
lore_zh: 他通过将早先的草药学天赋，和后天获得的毒素专精混合起来，创造出一个活体化瘟疫。

description_en: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last 2 seconds.
description_zh: 冲到目标位置，并取消最近2秒内受到的任何伤害。
lore_en: Darkterror tears a hole in time, passing through Claszureme, and appearing back in an instant.
lore_zh: 暗惧者将时间撕裂，穿过超维视界并瞬间重现。
notes_en: Faceless Void is invulnerable while using Time Walk.
notes_zh: 虚空假面在时间漫游过程中为无敌状态。
scepter_en: Applies a Time Lock to all units at the landing destination.
scepter_zh: 在落地点对所有单位施加一次时间锁定。

description_en: Adds the chance for an attack to lock an enemy unit in time while attacking it a second time.
description_zh: 攻击有一定概率将一个敌方目标锁定在时间中，再次发动攻击。
lore_en: The strike of the Faceless Void lands with dimension shifting force.
lore_zh: 虚空假面的突袭伴随着维度转移之力。
notes_en: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
notes_zh: 不与碎颅锤叠加。

description_en: Creates a blister in spacetime, trapping all units caught in its sphere of influence and causes you to move very quickly inside it. Only Faceless Void and any units he controls are unaffected. Invisible enemies in the sphere will be revealed.
description_zh: 在时空中创造一个泡状遮罩，将所有位于其中的单位定住，并使虚空假面在其内部来去自如。只有虚空假面和他控制的单位不受影响。在其中的隐形敌人会显形。
lore_en: When a rift opens to Claszureme, all poor souls caught within will likely never return.
lore_zh: 当超维视界的裂隙突现之时，所有被其困住的可怜灵魂都将万劫不复。
notes_en: Pauses all units and buildings, friendly or enemy, except those owned by Faceless Void.
Faceless Void is never affected by Chronospheres with any owner.
notes_zh: 能够定住所有单位和建筑，不论敌我。除了虚空假面控制的单位。
虚空假面不受任何时间结界的影响。

description_en: An exploding pulse deals damage to enemies and structures in the area. Deals 65% damage to structures.
description_zh: 一个爆炸性脉冲，对敌方单位造成伤害。对建筑物造成65%伤害。
lore_en: The Arts of Oblivion include a deafening blast of emerald flames from the Nether Reaches.
lore_zh: 湮灭术中有一招是来自三途川的碧绿轰击。
notes_en: Damage is delayed by 0.8 seconds.
notes_zh: 伤害生效延迟为0.8秒。

description_en: A powerful banishing spell that slows a unit and renders it unable to attack or be attacked. Healing on affected allies is increased, while afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.
description_zh: 一个强大的驱逐咒语，能使一个单位进入虚无状态，无法攻击或受到攻击。受作用的友军提升了治疗效果，而受作用的敌军会被减速，并且承受额外魔法伤害。
lore_en: A now-mastered relic from his childhood, Pugna delights in banishing others into the Nether Realm, whether for good, evil, or simple enjoyment.
lore_zh: 作为童年时期遗留下来的癖好，现在帕格纳精通于把人放逐到幽冥之境，而不管那人是善还是恶，或者仅仅是他的一时兴起。
notes_en: Only magical and pure damage can affect a unit under the effects of Decrepify.
Doesn't slow allied units.
Can be used on your Nether Ward.
notes_zh: 只有魔法伤害和纯粹伤害可以作用于处于衰老状态的单位。
不会对友方单位造成减速。
可以对幽冥守卫施放。

description_en: Pugna places a Nether Ward at the target location. The ward will fire at any enemy hero who casts a spell dealing base damage plus the damage multiplier of the mana spent by the enemy hero.
description_zh: 帕格纳在目标地点放置一个幽冥守卫。守卫将对任何施法的敌方英雄发射魔力闪光。幽冥守卫造成的伤害为基础伤害加上敌方英雄施法时消耗魔法值的数倍。
lore_en: While at the lamasery for the Arts of Oblivion, Pugna learned to dominate his classmates with a simple ward charged with Nether magic.
lore_zh: 还在喇嘛寺里时，帕格纳就学会了操控富有幽冥魔力的守卫来支配他的同学。
notes_en: Nether Ward deals damage before the actual spell is cast, so if the caster dies the spell will have no effect.
Nether Ward can be decrepified.
Illusions and creeps deal 25% damage to Nether Ward.
notes_zh: 技能施放后幽冥守卫先造成伤害，技能才会生效，所以如果施法者因此阵亡，施放的技能将没有效果。
幽冥守卫可以受到衰老的作用。
幻象和非英雄单位对幽冥守卫造成25%的伤害。
shard_en: Increases cast range to 375.
shard_zh: 施法距离提升至375。

description_en:
CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target.

When cast on an ally, Pugna will drain his own health into his ally.
description_zh:
持续施法 - 使用生命汲取时，帕格纳吸取目标敌方单位的生命值，并获得其视野。

向队友施放可以将自己的生命值转移给队友。
lore_en: Pugna has truly become more powerful than even the grandmaster of Oblivion.
lore_zh: 帕格纳的力量甚至已经超越湮灭术前任的上师。
scepter_en: Reduces cooldown by 50s. When targeting an enemy hero, Pugna reduces their outgoing spell damage by 8% per second up to a maximum of 75% and increases his own, up to a maximum of 100%. When draining through a Nether Ward using Shard, the rate of increase/decrease is 4% instead. Debuff lasts 8 seconds.
scepter_zh: 冷却时间减少50秒。以敌方英雄为目标时，帕格纳每秒降低他们8%技能伤害输出，最高可达到75%，并且自身的技能伤害输出提升，最高可达到100%。魔晶升级下对幽冥守卫施放时降低和提升的速率为4%。负面效果持续8秒。
shard_en: Life Drain can target your Nether Ward, causing life drain to refract to all enemy heroes within 700 units of the ward for 75% of its normal value. The effect is interrupted if the ward is destroyed.
shard_zh: 生命汲取可以对幽冥守卫施放，使生命汲取可以折射至守卫附近700范围内所有敌方英雄，造成75%效果。守卫被摧毁后效果将会中断。

description_en: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing 65 / 70 / 75 / 80+30 / 45 / 60 / 75% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage and applying attack effects from items and abilities.
description_zh: 对敌方单位掷出一把匕首，减缓其移动速度，并造成物理伤害，数值为65 / 70 / 75 / 80+幻影刺客攻击伤害的30 / 45 / 60 / 75%，同时继承物品和技能的攻击效果。
lore_en: The first skill learned by the Sisters of the Veil often signals an incoming hit.
lore_zh: 魅影之纱成员学习到的第一个技能，中招就意味着下一次攻击要来了。
notes_en: If an attack effect is chance-based, the chance of its application will be the same as its chance to occur.
Spell-immune enemies are not affected by Stifling Dagger's slow.
Stifling Dagger grants vision around its location while it travels and upon impact.
notes_zh: 如果攻击效果为几率触发，匕首的触发几率与原几率相同。
减益免疫下的敌人不会受到窒碍短匕的减速影响。
窒碍短匕在行进途中和击中目标时都会提供附近的视野。

description_en: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy, and grants bonus attack speed while attacking if it's an enemy unit.
description_zh: 传送到一个单位身旁，敌我皆可，如果目标是敌方单位将进行攻击并获得攻速加成。
lore_en: Mortred's silken veil is the last thing her unfortunate target sees.
lore_zh: 茉崔蒂的真丝面纱是她倒霉的目标临终所见之物。

description_en: Phantom Assassin blurs her body, disjointing incoming projectiles, increasing her movement speed, causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.
description_zh: 幻影刺客模糊自己的身形，躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道，提升她的移动速度，使她无法被看到，直到她靠近敌方英雄或防御塔。
lore_en: Meditation allows a Veiled Sister to carefully anticipate her opponents in combat.
lore_zh: 长期的冥想使得魅影之纱的成员能够谨慎地预知到敌人的到来。
notes_en: Attacking Roshan with a regular attack will dispel Blur.
notes_zh: 通过普通攻击攻击肉山会驱散魅影无形。
shard_en: Decreases Cooldown by 10s. Any time Phantom Assassin gets a hero kill, her ability cooldowns advance 60% of their max cooldown values.
shard_zh: 冷却时间减少10秒。只要幻影刺客击杀英雄，她的技能冷却时间都会加快60%最高冷却时间。

description_en: Phantom Assassin refines her combat abilities, acquiring a chance of gaining Deadly Focus with each attack. When attacking with Deadly Focus, Phantom Assassin will consume the buff and guarantee a critical hit. Stifling Dagger has a bonus chance to cause Deadly Focus.
description_zh: 幻影刺客的战斗技能得到精进，每次攻击时有几率获得致命专注。攻击时若带有致命专注，幻影刺客会消耗该效果，并且必定产生一次致命一击。窒碍短匕拥有额外几率获得致命专注。
lore_en: A divine strike, Mortred honors her opponent by choosing them for death.
lore_zh: 神圣的一击，茉崔蒂通过赐予对手死亡来向他们致以敬意。

description_en: Templar Assassin becomes highly elusive, gaining a small barrier and bonus to her damage. The damage and avoidance effects are separate, and have a limited number of instances. If a barrier is consumed, a new one is created as long as there are charges left. If an instance of damage would deal more damage than the remaining barrier, all of the damage is absorbed.
description_zh: 圣堂刺客变得高度难以捉摸，获得一个小型护盾，同时获得攻击力加成。攻击力加成和护盾效果相互独立，并且都是有限次数的效果。如果护盾被摧毁，只要还有能量点数就会再产生一个新的。如果单次伤害超过了剩余的护盾，该次的全部伤害都会被吸收。
lore_en: Manipulating her psionic veil, Lanaya bends nature's law to her will.
lore_zh: 通过操控她的灵能面纱，拉娜娅让自然法则为她所用。
notes_en: Damage as HP Removal bypasses Refraction (it won't reduce the charges).
notes_zh: 生命移除类伤害将无视折光（也不会减少折光次数）。
shard_en: Increases bonus damage. Refraction can be cast while disabled.
shard_zh: 攻击力加成提升。被控制时可以施放折光。

description_en: Templar Assassin conceals herself, becoming invisible as long as she remains still. If Meld's invisibility is broken by attacking an enemy, Lanaya's attack will deal bonus damage to the enemy and reduce their armor for 6 seconds. Bonus damage and debuffs from Meld are applied to all enemies in the Psi Blades split range.
description_zh: 圣堂刺客将自己隐藏起来，只要静止不动将一直处于隐身状态。只要在隐匿状态下攻击敌人打破隐身，拉娜娅的攻击将对敌人造成额外伤害，并降低其护甲，持续6秒。额外伤害和隐匿的负面效果会施加给灵能之刃飞溅距离内所有敌人。
lore_en: Lanaya is as elusive as her covenant with the Hidden Temple.
lore_zh: 拉娜娅本人就和她与隐之圣堂的契约一样神秘。
notes_en: Meld is broken by any action other than staying in position or channeling Psionic Projection.
Meld's armor reduction does not work against towers.
notes_zh: 除了停留在原地或持续施放灵能投射，其他任何动作都会打破隐匿效果。
隐匿的护甲降低作用对防御塔无效。

description_en: Templar Assassin's psi blades slice through the attacked unit, splitting and damaging enemy units directly behind it, while gaining bonus attack range. For each unit it damages, the split damage is reduced by a percentage.
description_zh: 圣堂刺客锋利的灵能之刃可以穿透敌人，对其正后方的敌方单位造成伤害，并且攻击距离得到提升。每对一个单位造成伤害后，飞溅伤害都会减少一定百分比。
lore_en: Her blades pierce the skin as much as the mind, furthering her understanding of the mystery that is reality.
lore_zh: 她的灵刃刺进了他人的皮肤，也刺进了他们的心智，使她对现实这一奥秘有了更深的理解。
notes_en: Split damage hits invisible units.
Attack effects like Bash will only be applied to the main target.
notes_zh: 飞溅伤害可以伤害隐身单位。
重击等攻击特效只对主目标有效。

description_en: Templar Assassin places mystical traps that invisibly monitor enemy movement. When sprung at her command, they exert a slowing influence of 20% in a 400 radius. Trap movement slow charges up to 50% after 3.5 seconds. Deals damage after 3.5s.
description_zh: 圣堂刺客放下一个隐形的神秘陷阱监视敌人的动向。引爆后将减缓400范围内敌人的移动速度，陷阱放置时间越久，引爆后减速效果越强，最低为20%，放置3.5秒后引爆将达到最大减速效果，为50%，并且还能造成额外伤害。
lore_en: Calling upon the reach of the Hidden Temple, none escape the eye of the Templar.
lore_zh: 召来隐之圣堂的力量后，无人能逃脱圣堂刺客的追杀。
notes_en: Traps last indefinitely.
They have invisibility that fades in over 2 seconds and spell immunity. They take 2 hits to kill by ranged heroes, 1 by melee heroes, and 4 by creeps.
Traps have 250/250 vision range and don't prevent neutral camps from spawning.
notes_zh: 陷阱没有时间限制。
他们拥有隐形效果，渐隐时间为2秒，还拥有技能免疫状态。他们可以承受2次远程英雄的攻击，1次近战英雄的攻击，或4次非英雄单位的攻击。
陷阱的视野是250/250，不能阻止中立生物刷新。
scepter_en: When activated, traps now silence affected enemies.
scepter_zh: 现在陷阱引爆后还会沉默受到作用的敌人。

description_en: Intensifies Viper's venom, adding an effect to his normal attack that applies a stacking movement speed slow and magic resistance deduction while dealing damage over time. Stacks up to 6 times.
description_zh: 蝮蛇的毒液得到强化，使他的普通攻击附带效果，可以降低目标的移动速度和魔法抗性，并持续造成伤害。效果可以叠加，最多叠加6次。
lore_en: The Netherdrake's inborn toxic breath quickly drains the vitality of its afflicted.
lore_zh: 冥界亚龙天生带有剧毒的吐息能迅速抽干敌人的生命力。
shard_en: Increases max stacks, and causes Poison Attack to lower armor per stack and to affect buildings for reduced damage.
shard_zh: 提升最大叠加次数，毒性攻击可以降低护甲，并且可以作用于建筑，造成的伤害有所降低。

description_en: Viper releases a Nethertoxin at the targeted area. Units in that area take an increasing damage over time based on how long they remain in it. Units in it have their attack speed slowed.
description_zh: 蝮蛇向目标区域释放幽冥剧毒。范围内的单位持续受到伤害，在区域内停留的时间越长，受到的伤害也越高。同时他们的攻击速度会被降低。
lore_en: Poison from the Nether Reaches turns wounds into fatalities, and fatigue into death.
lore_zh: 三途川的剧毒让小伤也能致死，而疲乏可以送命。
notes_en: Multiple Nethertoxins do not stack.
notes_zh: 多个幽冥剧毒不会叠加。

special_values.name: max_duration
special_values.heading_zh: 最高每秒伤害所需时间：

description_en: Viper exudes an infectious toxin that damages and slows the attack speed of any enemy that damages it in a 1200 radius. The acid exudate also increases Viper's resistance to magic.
description_zh: 蝮蛇分泌出感染性的毒素，1200范围内任何伤害它的敌人都将受到伤害，同时攻击速度也被降低。这种酸性分泌物还能提高蝮蛇的魔法抗性。
lore_en: It is not unusual for sword and shield alike to corrode in the very hands of those who attack the Netherdrake.
lore_zh: 对冥界亚龙出击后，手中的刀剑和盾牌会遭到腐蚀并不稀奇。
notes_en: Stacks multiplicatively with other magic damage resistance sources.
Break prevents the application of Corrosive Skin. Does not disable Corrosive Skin application from Nosedive.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 与其他提升魔法抗性的物品和技能叠加。
破坏会使腐蚀皮肤不再施加效果。极恶俯冲还是会施加腐蚀皮肤。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
scepter_en: Corrosive Skin applies 4x the attack speed slow to enemies that are within 500 distance of Viper. Viper's Corrosive Skin Magic Resistance and Damage per Second are gradually increased while he is in Nethertoxin, up to 50% increased effect after 4s.
scepter_zh: 腐蚀皮肤会对距离冥界亚龙500范围内的敌人施加4倍攻击速度降低效果。当冥界亚龙处于幽冥剧毒中，腐蚀皮肤的魔法抗性和每秒伤害会逐渐提升，在4秒后，达到最高的50%提升。

description_en: Viper slows the targeted enemy unit's movement and attack speed while also disabling their passives and dealing poison damage over time. The slowing effect reduces over the duration of the poison.
description_zh: 蝮蛇降低敌方目标单位的移动和攻击速度，同时破坏其被动技能并造成持续毒素伤害。移动和攻击速度会在毒素的持续时间内逐渐恢复。
lore_en: Once used to slay his sadistic summoner, the most powerful of Netherdrake infections spreads through the veins of those foolish enough to cross Viper.
lore_zh: 冥界亚龙身上最具威力的毒素，曾用于屠戮它残酷的主人。不论是谁，只要愚蠢到与蝮蛇作对就会被毒杀。

description_en: Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy, damaging and briefly stunning them.
description_zh: 召唤一道月能的光束打击敌人，造成伤害并短暂眩晕目标。
lore_en: Selemene smites those who encroach upon the Nightsilver Woods.
lore_zh: 那些侵犯银夜森林的家伙会受到赛莉蒙妮的毁灭打击。

description_en: Empowers Luna's glaives, causing her attacks to bounce between enemy units. Deals less damage with each bounce.
description_zh: 强化露娜的月刃，使攻击可以在敌方单位之间弹跳。每次弹跳造成的伤害都会减少。
lore_en: Carefully sharpened, Luna's boomerang-like weapon cuts a wide swath through enemy numbers.
lore_zh: 露娜精心打磨过的回旋镖型武器可以从大群敌人中杀出一条血路。
notes_en: Moon Glaives do not proc any attack modifier except Critical Strikes.
notes_zh: 月刃不会触发致命一击以外的任何攻击特效。

description_en: Grants attack damage to Luna and nearby allied heroes within 1200 range, with Luna receiving double the attack damage bonuses. At night, Lunar Blessing is global, and Luna is blessed with bonus night vision.
description_zh: 提升露娜和附近1200范围内友方英雄的攻击力，露娜获得双倍的攻击力加成。夜晚期间月之祝福为全地图生效，并且露娜受到福佑后夜间视野提升。
lore_en: The Goddess of the Moon smiles upon her kin.
lore_zh: 月之女神对她的族人微笑。

description_en: Showers random nearby enemies with strikes from Luna's current level of Lucent Beam. These beams do not stun their targets, and there is a maximum number of times that a single target can be struck. Also turns day into night for a short time.
description_zh: 召唤一次月蚀，以她当前技能等级的月光随机打击附近敌人。月光只有伤害效果，不会造成眩晕，而且单一目标只能受到有限次数的打击。月蚀会暂时将白天变为黑夜。
lore_en: In times of great need, Selemene herself descends into the world, blocking out the light and hope of the opposed.
lore_zh: 在急需其帮助的时候，赛莉蒙妮亲自降临世间，遮蔽照向敌人的光芒，以及他们的希望。
notes_en: Eclipse doesn't work if Luna doesn't have any points in Lucent Beam.
Beams will stop if Luna is killed.
Will not hit invisible units.
There is a 0.6 seconds gap between beams, 0.3 seconds with scepter.
notes_zh: 如果露娜没有升级月光，月蚀将无法造成伤害，但是变为黑夜效果有效。
露娜阵亡后月光马上中止。
不能伤害隐身单位。
每道月光之间都有0.6秒的间隔。神杖升级后间隔为0.3秒。
scepter_en: Allows Luna to cast Eclipse on an allied unit or herself and have its effects follow them, or cast it on an area. Increases total beams, reduces duration, removes the limit on beams per unit, and makes the beams appear twice as fast.
scepter_zh: 露娜可以对友方单位或自身施放月蚀，使月蚀的效果跟随目标，或者对一片区域施放。增加月光数量，减少月蚀持续时间，并且移除单体打击次数上限，月光的产生间隔缩短一半。

description_en: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.
description_zh: 向龙骑士的前方喷射出一团火焰，烧灼碰到的敌人，并使其攻击力降低。
lore_en: Knight Davion's breath has become that of the mighty Eldwurm Slyrak, remembered for burning numerous other knights to a crisp.
lore_zh: 龙骑士达维安的气息已经变成了斯莱瑞克的古龙之息，人们还记得它将无数骑士烧成了焦炭。
notes_en: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

description_en: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.
description_zh: 龙骑士用盾对身边的一个敌方单位进行打击，对它和它身边的目标造成眩晕和伤害。
lore_en: Davion's combination of dragon talents and knightly skills makes him a vicious opponent in melee combat.
lore_zh: 达维安将神龙的天赋和骑士的技艺完美结合，使他在近身肉搏中无比勇猛。

description_en:
The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's health regeneration and armor.

Regen and armor are increased by 50% during Elder Dragon Form.
description_zh:
神龙的生命之血提升了龙骑士的生命恢复和护甲。

在古龙形态下生命恢复和护甲均提升50%。
lore_en: Slyrak's blood still courses through Davion's veins, giving him twice the vitality of an ordinary knight.
lore_zh: 斯莱瑞克的血液流遍达维安的全身，他获得了寻常骑士身上双倍的活力。

description_en:
Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties. The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative.

Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.

Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.

Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.
description_zh:
龙骑士化身为古龙，提升了技能的施法距离，获得移动速度加成，和拥有各种特性的远程攻击。古龙每级都会进化。加成效果会累加。

1级碧龙：攻击获得持续的腐蚀伤害，也能作用于建筑。

2级赤龙：攻击获得溅射伤害。

3级苍龙：攻击获得无视减益免疫的移动速度和攻击速度降低效果。
lore_en: The dormant dragon power springs forth from within Davion, combining the powers of a legendary knight with a legendary Eldwurm.
lore_zh: 潜藏的神龙力量从达维安体内涌出，骑士之力和古龙之威完美地合二为一。
scepter_en: Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.
scepter_zh: 使古龙形态的当前等级提升1级。增加的4级黑龙拥有自由移动，魔法抗性加成和其他更高的加成效果。

description_en: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.
description_zh: 施放一股锥形的毒素，可以打击多个敌方单位。造成持续伤害和减速。每当目标受到戴泽的攻击，负面效果的持续时间都会刷新，减速效果也会提升。
lore_en: One of the few Dezun rites used for offensive purposes, the paralytic enchantment often proves useful.
lore_zh: 少数进攻性的德尊仪式之一，麻痹魔法经常显示出它的有用之处。
notes_en: The damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.
notes_zh: 伤害格挡类技能不能减少该技能伤害。

description_en: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.
description_zh: 友军身受薄葬的福佑，在其保护下不论受到多大的伤害都不会阵亡。对该友军的治疗效果在持续时间内也会根据其生命值得到增强。
lore_en: Only a seasoned acolyte of the Shadow can properly perform the rite of preventing death.
lore_zh: 只有经验老道的暗影侍僧才能正确做出免死之仪式。
notes_en: HP cannot go below 1 while under the effects of Shallow Grave, but Axe's Culling Blade will still kill the hero.
notes_zh: 在薄葬作用下生命值至少为1点，但是斧王的淘汰之刃还是可以斩杀目标英雄。

description_en: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby. Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
description_zh: 放出一道能量弧，可以瞬间跳跃至目标附近的队友，治疗的同时还将对附近的敌方单位造成伤害。施放暗影波时戴泽必定会享受到治疗效果。
lore_en: While it is a simplistic and routine rite among Shadow Priests, the Shadow Wave is also the most critical for success.
lore_zh: 虽然对暗影牧师来说，暗影波只是很简单也很日常的仪式，不过它确实是取胜的关键所在。
notes_en: Prioritizes allied heroes over creeps.
If enemies are near multiple allied units affected by Shadow Wave, they will take multiple instances of damage.
notes_zh: 优先治疗友方英雄
如果敌军附近有多个我方单位，那么他将受到多重暗影波的伤害。
scepter_en: Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to 100% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.
scepter_zh: 暗影波现在也可对敌人施放，在友军和敌人之间都可以弹跳。弹跳至敌人时，他们会受到伤害，并且治疗附近友军，数值为100%平常治疗和伤害量。戴泽还会对暗影波弹跳到的每个敌人发动一次攻击。

description_en: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.
description_zh: 向附近敌方单位随机射出高能弹片，造成小额魔法伤害和短暂眩晕。
lore_en: Some of Rattletrap's contraptions don't quite work correctly, so detonating them proves useful as an offensive maneuver.
lore_zh: 瑞托崔普挂载的部分装置运作不良，因此将其引爆也是种有效的进攻手段。
notes_en: Remains active if Clockwerk is disabled.
notes_zh: 发条技师被控制后仍然有效。

description_en:
Forms a ring of energized cogs around Clockwerk, trapping any units that are near. Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back, losing health and mana. Once a cog has delivered a shock, it will power down. Damage is increased by 50% of the mana burned.

Cogs can be destroyed by enemy attacks, but Clockwerk can push them up to 850 / 900 / 950 / 1000 distance away with one hit. Clockwerk can move through the cogs freely, disabling them as he passes over.
description_zh:
在发条技师周围形成一圈通电的齿轮，困住附近的单位。在外侧的敌人碰到齿轮会被电流震退，损失一定的生命和魔法。并且50%损失魔法也会加入到伤害。一个齿轮发动过一次震击后就会报废。

敌人攻击齿轮数次后可将其摧毁，而发条技师需要攻击一次会将齿轮推出850 / 900 / 950 / 1000距离。发条技师可以自由穿行齿轮，穿行时会使齿轮失效。
lore_en: One of Clockwerk's inventions of which he is most proud is the power cog - though it is sometimes despised by his allies.
lore_zh: 发条技师最骄傲的发明之一就是他的能量齿轮——虽然有时会被他的盟友轻视。
notes_en: Cogs can shock invisible units.
notes_zh: 齿轮可以震退隐身单位。

description_en: Fires a global range flare that explodes over a given area. Upon impact, enemies in the area take damage and are briefly slowed. Rocket flare provides vision over the impact area for 6 seconds.
description_zh: 向全地图范围内的指定区域发射照明弹。击中时对区域内敌人造成伤害和短暂减速。照明火箭提供6秒击中区域的视野。
lore_en: What started as a festive display has become a useful scouting and bombardment tool.
lore_zh: 最初用作节日的焰火，现在成了侦察和轰炸敌人的工具。

description_en: Fires a grappling device rapidly at the target location. If the hook hits a unit, Clockwerk launches himself into the target, stunning and dealing damage to everyone in a 175 radius around the hit target. Any enemies Clockwerk collides with along the way are damaged and stunned.
description_zh: 向目标位置高速射出钩爪，如果命中一个单位，发条技师会将自己牵引到目标身边，对目标附近175范围内所有敌人造成眩晕和伤害。对牵引时冲撞到的单位也造成伤害和眩晕。
lore_en: A somewhat unwieldy device, the Hookshot sends the otherwise clunky Clockwerk armor flying through the air.
lore_zh: 钩爪虽然是有点笨重的设备，但能让更加厚重的发条装甲在半空中来去如风。
notes_en: Hookshot will latch and take Clockwerk to allies, but not damage or disable them.
notes_zh: 发射钩爪可以抓住友方单位并将发条技师牵引过去，但是不会造成伤害和眩晕。

description_en: Splits the earth under enemies. Deals damage and stuns for a short duration.
description_zh: 撕裂敌人脚下的大地。造成伤害和短暂的眩晕。
lore_en: Twisting nature to his vile will, the shifting earth consumes those unlucky enough to cross Leshrac's path.
lore_zh: 拉席克用他恶毒的意志扭曲大自然，撕裂大地摧毁那些挡他路的倒霉鬼。
notes_en: Split Earth will destroy trees in its area of effect.
There is a 0.35 second delay before the effect is applied.
notes_zh: 撕裂大地将摧毁作用范围内的树木。
技能经过0.35秒延迟后生效。
shard_en: Causes Split Earth to repeat in the same location 2 additional times, with a 5 second delay between each one. Each time the radius increases by 45. Split Earth echo location is visible to both teams.
shard_zh: 撕裂大地在相同地点再重复2次，重复间隔为5秒。每次作用范围增加45。撕裂大地的重复地点对双方队伍可见。

description_en: Saturates the area around Leshrac with magical explosions that deal pure damage to enemy units and buildings. The fewer units available to attack, the more damage those units will take.
description_zh: 使拉席克周围的区域充满魔法性爆炸，对敌方单位和建筑造成纯粹伤害。范围内的敌人越少，他们受到的伤害就越高。
lore_en: Chronoptic energy bursts from one plane to the other, evaporating anything it touches.
lore_zh: 古老的能量从一个位面向另一个位面爆发，将触碰到的一切化为灰烬。
notes_en: The explosions will continue even if Leshrac is killed.
notes_zh: 即使拉席克死亡，爆炸还是会在原地继续。

description_en: Summons a lightning storm that blasts the target enemy unit, then strikes any nearby enemy units. Struck enemies have their move speed slowed.
description_zh: 召唤一片闪电风暴攻击目标敌方单位，并跳跃到附近的敌方单位。被攻击的敌人将会被降低移动速度。
lore_en: The Tormented Soul's mastery of the elements is evident in the massive storms that strike down armies before him.
lore_zh: 受折磨的灵魂用来击倒敌人的闪电风暴展现出他对操控元素的精通。

description_en: Creates waves of damaging energy around Leshrac, one per second, to damage nearby enemy units. Drains Leshrac's mana with each pulse.
description_zh: 拉席克在他周围创造破坏性的能量波，每秒对附近敌方单位造成伤害。每次脉冲都会消耗拉席克的魔法。
lore_en: If necessary, the Tormented Soul can manipulate space time itself, ravaging lesser beings.
lore_zh: 必要时，受折磨的灵魂能操纵时空本身，毁灭弱小的存在。

description_en: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, damaging and trapping it in place and providing vision in a 400 radius.
description_zh: 使一圈树木在一个单位的周围发芽，将其困在其中并造成伤害，提供400范围内的视野。
lore_en: Verdant overgrowth is a common ailment reported by Nature's Prophet's attackers.
lore_zh: 疯长的绿苗是那些攻击自然先知的人报告的常见病症。
notes_en: Sprout can be cast on any unit, or the ground.
Trees created by Sprout have the same interactions with abilities as regular trees.
notes_zh: 发芽的施放目标可以是任何单位或者地面。
发芽产生的树木跟英雄技能的相互作用与平常树木相同。

description_en: Teleports to any point on the map. Gains a barrier after arriving to its destination.
description_zh: 传送到地图上任何位置。到达地点后获得一个护盾。
lore_en: The Prophet keeps his sentinel over the forest, protecting it when in need.
lore_zh: 先知保护着整片森林，当森林需要他的时候立刻出现。
notes_en: Mana and cooldown take effect when the cast is completed. Nature's Prophet will not use any mana or waste the cooldown if the spell is interrupted while casting.
When the cast begins, an effect is created at the target location, which is visible to allies and enemies.
notes_zh: 魔耗和冷却时间都是在技能施放结束后结算。自然先知在施放技能时被打断将不会耗费魔法或使技能进入冷却。
施法开始后，目标地点将产生视觉特效，对队友和敌人均可见。

description_en: Converts an area of trees into Treants under the command of Nature's Prophet.
description_zh: 将一片树木转化成由自然先知操控的树人。
lore_en: Verodicia bestowed the Prophet with the ability to summon the Treant Guard, a mythical sentient army of the wild.
lore_zh: 维萝迪希娅赐予先知召唤树人守卫的能力，这是大自然的神话军队。
notes_en: Nature's Call can only create as many treants as there are trees in the target area.
notes_zh: 自然的呼唤产生的树人不会超过目标区域内树木的数量。

description_en: Damaging energy bounces around the map, striking enemies that are in vision starting with those closest to the cast point. Each enemy hit beyond the first adds damage, up to the maximum after 16 are hit.
description_zh: 伤害性的能量在全地图跳跃，打击视野中的敌人，会先从距目标点最近的敌人开始打击。每击中一个敌人伤害都会增加，击中16个目标后达到最高伤害。
lore_en: Nature's Prophet calls Verodicia's fury to strike down those who might ravage the wilderness.
lore_zh: 自然先知召唤维萝迪希娅的狂怒，消灭那些想要毁坏自然的敌人。
notes_en: Wrath of Nature will not hit units out of vision.
Can be cast through the minimap; the nearest valid target will be selected.
notes_zh: 自然的愤怒只能伤害视野内的单位。
可以通过点击小地图施放；初始目标将选择施放地点最近的有效单位。
scepter_en: Entangles all enemies it hits. Duration scales from 1.5s up to 3s seconds at max bounce.
scepter_zh: 缠绕所有击中的敌人。持续时间根据弹跳次序从1.5秒开始增加，弹跳数达到上限时为3秒。

description_en:
Launch into a maddened rage, becoming Debuff Immune, increasing magic resistance and gaining movement speed.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
description_zh:
进入狂暴状态，变成减益免疫，提升魔法抗性和移动速度。

驱散类型：弱驱散
lore_en: The madness and brutality of N'aix makes him a vicious and unrelenting foe in combat.
lore_zh: 奈克斯的疯狂和残暴使得他在战斗中异常凶狠无情。

description_en: Lifestealer's attacks deal damage and provide heal for a percentage of his target's max health. He gains permanent max HP whenever he kills a unit.
description_zh: 噬魂鬼每次攻击时还会根据目标最大生命值的一定百分比造成伤害，同时获得治疗。每次击杀单位他都会获得永久生命上限。
lore_en: After escaping from his cell in Devarque, N'aix subsisted on flesh and bones of those unfortunate to cross his path.
lore_zh: 从德瓦克的监狱中逃离后，奈克斯就靠着吞噬那些挡路的倒霉蛋的血肉维持生命。
notes_en: Works on allies and enemies. Does not affect Roshan.
The heal is independent of the damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
notes_zh: 对友军和敌人有效。对肉山无效。
回复量与造成伤害相互独立。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

description_en: Lifestealer rends an enemy unit, slowing the victim's movement speed and allowing all allies to regain health for a percentage of the damage they deal to that unit. The victim recovers movement speed over the duration.
description_zh: 噬魂鬼撕裂一个敌方单位，减缓受害者的移动速度，并使所有友军在攻击该单位时根据造成的伤害回复一定比例的生命。受害者在持续时间内逐渐恢复移动速度。
lore_en: Fresh wounds and the scent of blood often draw out the scavengers to finish the job.
lore_zh: 新鲜的伤口和鲜血的芳香通常能引来清道夫清理善后。
notes_en: Open Wounds slows over 8 different steps: 50% / 50% / 40% / 30% / 20% / 10% / 10% / 10%, with the slow decreasing one step per second.
The amount healed is amplified by Lifestealer's Health Restoration Amplification.
notes_zh: 撕裂伤口的减速有8个独立的阶段：50%/50%/40%/30%/20%/10%/10%/10%，每过一秒就会进入下个阶段，减速效果不断降低。
治疗数值会被噬魂鬼的生命回复增强效果提升。

description_en:
Lifestealer infests the body of a target unit, becoming undetectable, and healing for a portion of his max hitpoints every second while inside. He can then explode from the host body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. If the infested unit is an enemy creep or a neutral creep, he can take control of the unit's ability to move and attack, and the creep loses a portion of their max hitpoints over time. Does not work on enemy heroes.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
description_zh:
噬魂鬼进入目标单位的身体，无法被察觉，而且自身在体内时每秒恢复最大生命值的一定百分比。接着可以从宿主体内现身，对周围所有敌方单位造成伤害。如果被感染单位是敌方非英雄单位或中立生物，噬魂鬼可以控制其进行移动和攻击，而且该生物会持续失去最大生命值的一部分。无法对敌方英雄生效。

驱散类型：弱驱散
lore_en: With this infestation, N'aix consumes the life blood of the host, restoring him back to full unholy power.
lore_zh: 奈克斯通过寄生吞噬宿主的生命之血，使他的不洁之力恢复如初。
notes_en: Lifestealer gains experience while under the effects of Infest.
Creeps that are controlled while Infested gain Infest's movement speed bonus.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Infest can be used on Ancient creeps.
notes_zh: 噬魂鬼在感染一个单位期间能够从周围死亡的单位身上获得经验。
被感染控制的单位会获得感染的移动速度加成。
不会触发法术反弹。
感染可以对远古生物使用。
scepter_en: Increases cast range and reduces cooldown to 20s. Infest may target enemy heroes for a short duration, attacking them from the inside while increasing Lifestealer's regeneration rate.
scepter_zh: 提升施法距离并且冷却时间降低至20秒。感染可以对敌方英雄施放，持续时间较短，并在他们体内发动攻击，同时提升噬魂鬼的恢复速率。
shard_en: Consuming a creep with Infest drenches enemies in blood which deals damage over time based on the host's remaining health.
shard_zh: 吞噬感染的中立生物会使敌人沾满鲜血，根据宿主的剩余生命值造成持续伤害。

description_en: Dark Seer creates a vacuum over the target area that sucks in enemy units, disrupting them and dealing damage.
description_zh: 黑暗贤者在目标区域制造一个真空环境，将周围的敌方单位吸入，具有打断效果并造成伤害。
lore_en: Ish'Kafel modifies the center of gravity to a place of his choosing.
lore_zh: 依什卡菲尔能把重心改为他选定的地点。
notes_en: This ability interrupts channeling.
Pulls units over 0.3 / 0.4 / 0.5 / 0.6 seconds before dealing damage.
Trees near the center of the vacuum will be destroyed.
notes_zh: 此技能可以打断持续施法。
牵引过程为0.3 / 0.4 / 0.5 / 0.6秒，伤害在牵引后产生。
真空中央附近的树木将会被摧毁。

description_en: Surrounds the target unit with a bristling shield that damages enemy units in an area around it.
description_zh: 将目标用一个尖刺之盾包裹起来，对周围的敌人造成伤害。
lore_en: The Dark Seer slices holes into the 'Land Behind the Wall,' causing prismatic energy to seep forth.
lore_zh: 黑暗贤者打通“幻墙之末”，让其中的光棱力量渗透出来。
notes_en: Deals small amounts of damage in 0.2 second intervals.
Doesn't damage the target it is cast on.
If cast on a unit that already has Ion Shell, the new Shell replaces the old one.
notes_zh: 每0.2秒造成一次若干伤害。
离子外壳对其作用单位没有伤害。
如果对已经套上离子外壳的单位再次施放，新的离子外壳会取代旧的。

description_en: Charges a target friendly unit with power, giving it a brief burst of phased movement speed. Allows the unit to reach maximum movement speed and cannot be slowed.
description_zh: 为一个友方目标注入能量，使其在短时间内移动速度爆发，并且获得相位移动状态。允许单位达到移动速度上限，并且无法被减速。
lore_en: Ish'Kafel once used his speed of mind to navigate the maze between the walls.
lore_zh: 依什卡菲尔曾经用他迅捷的神智走出幻墙之间的迷宫。
notes_en: Units with Surge cannot be slowed unless the Surge effect is removed.
notes_zh: 奔腾的单位不受减速影响，除非奔腾效果消失。
shard_en: Surged units leave behind a 150 radius trail that lasts 7s, slows enemies around it by 35% and deals 40 damage per second in 0.5s intervals. Can be put on alt-cast to disable the trail.
shard_zh: 奔腾单位的身后留下一道路径，作用范围为150，持续7秒，对附近的敌人造成35%减速，并且每秒造成40点伤害，伤害间隔为0.5秒。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），禁止留下路径。

description_en: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it. Enemy replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will. Replicas last until they are destroyed, or until the wall's duration ends.
description_zh: 制造一堵扭曲的光墙，对穿过的敌方英雄造成伤害和减速，并复制一个其自身的幻象，幻象由黑暗贤者控制，持续到光墙消失，或者被敌人消灭。
lore_en: The Dark Seer, while unable to return to his natural realm, can channel part of the prismatic wall with powerful strength of mind, sowing confusion amongst enemy ranks.
lore_zh: 尽管黑暗贤者无法重返原来的国度，但他仍然能运用强大的心智力量召唤出幻墙的一部分，在敌阵中散播混乱。
notes_en: Doesn't create illusions from other illusions.
There cannot be more than one illusion per player per wall.
notes_zh: 幻象不会产生幻象。
每堵光墙同一时间产生的为一名英雄产生的幻象只有一个。

description_en: CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 克林克兹持续施法，朝目标方向射出多支灼热的箭矢，击中所有敌人，造成克林克兹攻击伤害的一定百分比并施加攻击特效。
lore_en: It's hard to say whether the blur around the Bone Fletcher is from his flaming heart or his speed with the quiver.
lore_zh: 其他人很难分辨骷髅弓箭手身边缭绕的劲风到底是来自他心中的火焰还是他出箭的速度。
notes_en: Bonus Attack Range increases the length of Burning Barrage.
notes_zh: 攻击距离加成会提升炽烈火雨的长度。

description_en:
Imbues Clinkz's arrows with fire for extra damage.

Skeleton Archers will fire Searing Arrows at targets Clinkz attacks for 50% damage.
description_zh:
让克林克兹的箭矢带有火焰，造成更多伤害。

骷髅弓手在攻击克林克兹的攻击目标时会发射灼热之箭，造成50%伤害。
lore_en: Clinkz simply lights his arrows from his flaming essence for quite the destructive effect.
lore_zh: 克林克兹用他的灼热精华点燃弓箭，造成毁灭性打击。
notes_en: Searing Arrows deal damage to structures.
The damage is directly added to Clinkz' attack damage, as physical damage.
notes_zh: 灼热之箭能对建筑造成伤害。
伤害直接作为物理伤害加到克林克兹的攻击伤害中。

description_en:
Clinkz moves invisibly through units until the moment he attacks or uses items. Leaving Skeleton Walk creates Skeleton Archers.

Skeleton Archers are immobile and die within multiple attacks from a hero or tower. Skeleton Archers deal a percentage of Clinkz' damage, and deal 75% less damage to buildings. Attack range is equal to Clinkz' attack range.
description_zh:
克林克兹进入隐身状态，移动可以穿过其他单位，攻击或使用物品时现形。脱离隐身后会产生骷髅弓手。

骷髅弓手不能移动，需要多次英雄或防御塔攻击才会被击杀。骷髅弓手继承克林克兹一定百分比的攻击力，对建筑造成的伤害降低75%。攻击距离与克林克兹相同。
lore_en: With a burst of fire and puff of smoke, the Bone Fletcher was nowhere to be seen.
lore_zh: 随着火焰的爆裂和烟雾的升起，骷髅弓箭手的身形遁于无形。
notes_en: Has a fadetime of 0.6 seconds.
notes_zh: 渐隐时间为0.6秒。

special_values.name: skeleton_health_tooltip
special_values.heading_zh: 骷髅弓手摧毁所需攻击次数：

description_en: Clinkz consumes the target enemy creep or friendly Skeleton Archer, healing and gaining max health. Does not take Clinkz out of Skeleton Walk.
description_zh: 克林克兹以敌方非英雄单位或友方骷髅弓手为吞噬的目标，治疗并获得最大生命值。不会使克林克兹脱离骨隐步。
lore_en: Sutherex' bond of life and death has become a part of Clinkz, and his old bones are refreshed with repetition of the pact on lesser beings.
lore_zh: 萨瑟雷克斯的死亡契约已经成了克林克兹的一部分，他通过杀死那些低等生物来使自己的枯骨获得新生。
notes_en: If the target is an enemy, Clinkz will gain the correct experience and gold.
Increases Clinkz' current and max HP.
When the duration ends, max HP returns to normal, but current HP stays the same.
notes_zh: 如果目标是敌方单位，克林克兹将获得经验和金钱。
克林克兹的当前血量和生命值上限都将提高。
持续时间结束后，血量上限回到正常值，但是当前生命值不变（不会高于血量上限）。

description_en: Instantly heals a friendly unit and damages all nearby enemy units.
description_zh: 立即治疗一个友方单位，并对周围的敌军造成伤害。
lore_en: Priests of the Omniscience are adept at removing impurities from fellow warriors.
lore_zh: 全知的牧师们善于清除己方战士们身心中的污杂。
shard_en: After a 3s delay, the target is Purified again with 65% effectiveness.
shard_zh: 3秒延迟后目标会再次受到65%威力的洗礼。

description_en: Degenerates the movement capabilities of enemy units that stray too near, slowing their movement speed.
description_zh: 削弱过于靠近的敌方单位的移动能力，降低其移动速度。
lore_en: The holy embodiment of Purist Thunderwrath is enough to weaken those of lesser faith.
lore_zh: 作为神圣的化身，普利斯特·雷霆之怒足以削弱那些不忠之徒。
notes_en: Does not affect Debuff Immune units.
notes_zh: 对减益免疫单位无效。

description_en: Omniknight calls upon a Guardian Angel that grants immunity from physical damage to all allied units near Omniknight.
description_zh: 全能骑士召唤出守护天使，使全能骑士附近的所有友方单位对物理伤害免疫。
lore_en: The All Seeing One casts down his protection over those that Purist calls friend.
lore_zh: 全知之主对那些被普利斯特称为“朋友”的人降下保护结界。
scepter_en: Guardian Angel has global radius, affects buildings, and amplifies health restoration.
scepter_zh: 守护天使的作用范围为全地图，影响建筑并增强生命回复。

description_en: Enchantress beguiles her enemies, slowing their attacks when she is attacked.
description_zh: 魅惑魔女让她的敌人神魂颠倒，受到他们攻击时会降低其攻击速度。
lore_en: After attacking Aiushtha, most opponents are overwhelmed with guilt having attacked such a natural beauty.
lore_zh: 在攻击爱由莎之后，大多数敌人都会由于攻击了这样一个天然的美人而不知所措。
notes_en: All units who directly attack Enchantress will get slowed.
The slow is applied on the attacking unit when the attack starts, not when damage is applied.
notes_zh: 所有直接攻击魅惑魔女的敌方单位都会被减速。
减速效果在攻击单位产生攻击动作时出现，而不是伤害生效时。

description_en:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for 3.5 / 4 / 4.5 / 5s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives 40% of their experience bounty. Enchantress can control creeps for up to 30 / 60 / 90 / 120s.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
description_zh:
魅惑魔女诱惑一个敌人。如果目标是英雄，将被驱散，其移动速度也会被减缓，持续3.5 / 4 / 4.5 / 5秒，而魅惑魔女和她的单位攻击目标时拥有额外攻击距离。

如果目标是非英雄单位，魅惑魔女会将其控制，并获得40%相应的击杀经验。魅惑魔女控制的非英雄单位最多持续30 / 60 / 90 / 120秒。

驱散类型：弱驱散
lore_en: A true steward of the forest, Aiushtha befriends all within it - from lowly trolls to powerful centaurs.
lore_zh: 作为森林真正的管家，无论是卑贱的巨魔还是强大的半人马，爱由莎都会和他们成为朋友。
notes_en: Illusions can be converted.
notes_zh: 可以转化幻象。
scepter_en: Enchantress can control multiple creeps at a time.
scepter_zh: 魅惑魔女可以同时控制多个非英雄单位。

special_values.name: slow_movement_speed
special_values.heading_zh:
对英雄：
移动速度减缓：

special_values.name: enchant_health
special_values.heading_zh:
对非英雄单位：
最大生命值加成：

description_en: A cloud of wisps heals Enchantress and any friendly units nearby.
description_zh: 召唤一群小精灵治疗魅惑魔女以及身边的友方单位。
lore_en: Whimsical spirits of the woods possess a healing power that is quite subtle, but gains strength in numbers.
lore_zh: 古怪的森林小精灵拥有的疗伤之力虽然微弱，但可以用数量弥补。
notes_en: Units with full HP will not be selected for the heal.
notes_zh: 不会选择满血单位进行治疗。

description_en: Places an enchantment on each attack while activated, causing it to deal additional damage based on how far away the target is. The farther the target, the greater the damage dealt. Deals double damage to illusions.
description_zh: 激活后每次攻击都有附魔效果，根据与目标的距离造成额外伤害。目标越远，伤害越高。对幻象造成双倍伤害。
lore_en: While Aiushtha favors peaceful means, she is capable of a magical onslaught from a distance, her spears gaining energy from the natural life around her.
lore_zh: 虽然爱由莎更喜欢和平的处事方式，但她还是会用远距离的魔法突击来解决一些问题，她扔出的长矛会从掠过的空气中获得能量。
notes_en: The damage is capped at 1750 distance.
Distance to target is measured when the projectile hits.
notes_zh: 造成伤害上限的距离是1750。
计算与目标之间的距离在攻击弹道击中目标时。

description_en: Huskar sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack. Multiple attacks will stack additional damage. Each attack drains some of Huskar's health.
description_zh: 哈斯卡将其长矛点燃，在普通攻击的同时对敌方单位造成持续伤害。多次攻击会造成持续伤害叠加。每次攻击都将牺牲哈斯卡部分生命值。
lore_en: The Sacred Warrior ignites his weaponry after marking it with his own blood - causing far greater pain than he himself feels.
lore_zh: 神灵武士的武器经过自身鲜血的沾染，燃起了烈火——敌人将领受远超己痛的苦楚。
notes_en: Burning Spear stacks additively when used multiple times on one target. There is no cap.
Huskar cannot kill himself with this skill.
Incendiary does not deal extra Max Health Burn Damage to Roshan.
notes_zh: 沸血之矛在多次施放到目标身上效果可以叠加。没有叠加上限。
哈斯卡不能使用此技能自杀。
炙矛可热不会对肉山造成额外的最大生命值烧灼伤害。

description_en: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.
description_zh: 哈斯卡的伤痛赐予他力量，根据他损失的生命值将获得攻击速度、魔法抗性和生命恢复加成。生命恢复为力量的一定百分比。
lore_en: After losing his birthright, Huskar gained a lethality in physical combat that is only heightened as his own blood is spilled.
lore_zh: 从虚无之境逃出后，哈斯卡的力量会随着血液的损失而增强，使他能够造成致命的物理性破坏。
notes_en: Bonuses are provided linearly, no bonus at Full HP and full bonus at strictly less than 10% HP.
notes_zh: 加成效果为线性增加，满血时没有加成，10%生命时达到最大加成。
shard_en:
Huskar can activate Berserker's Blood for a health cost to cauterize himself. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
shard_zh:
哈斯卡可以消耗一定生命来主动开启狂战士之血，炙疗哈斯卡。进行驱散，然后在一定延迟后回复消耗的生命，并且每驱散一个负面状态，他就会额外回复生命。

驱散类型：弱驱散
