special_values.heading_zh: 每层叠加自身攻速加成：

description_en: Monkey King enlarges his staff and slams it against the ground, stunning enemies in a line and damaging them with bonus damage and a critical hit based on his attack. Has True Strike.
description_zh: 齐天大圣让金箍棒变大，并将其挥起猛击地面，眩晕一条直线上的敌人并造成额外伤害和基于他普通攻击的致命一击伤害。具有克敌机先效果。
lore_en: The legendary Jingu Bang grows to match its master's will, ensuring no enemy can escape the Monkey King's reach.
lore_zh: 传说中的金箍棒根据主人的意愿变大变长，确保敌人都逃不出齐天大圣的手心。
shard_en: Boundless Strike applies Primal Spring with 35% of the max channeling duration power to enemies along the staff and at the end of the staff. When Boundless Strike is set to alt-cast, Monkey King leaps to the end of his staff.
shard_zh: 棒击大地对沿途和末端的敌人施加乾坤之跃，威力为最长持续施法时间的35%。棒击大地设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，齐天大圣还会跳跃至金箍棒的另一端。

description_en: Changes Monkey King's shape to deceive opponents, using the environment nearby as inspiration for the disguise. Taking damage, attacking, or using any item or ability breaks Monkey King's disguise. Grants damage immunity for 0.1 seconds upon transforming.
description_zh: 齐天大圣以周遭事物为启发进行伪装，改变自己的外形，从而欺骗对手。受到伤害，发动攻击或使用任意物品都会失去伪装效果。变化后0.1秒内免疫伤害。
lore_en: Watch out for that tree.
lore_zh: 要小心那棵树。

description_en: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for 3s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
description_zh: 齐天大圣跳上一棵树并停在上面。停留时获得乾坤之跃技能——需要持续施法的跳跃式攻击。如果树木被摧毁，他将从树上掉下，并眩晕3秒。在地面受到伤害时丛林之舞将在一定时间内无法使用，处于冷却状态。
lore_en: Sun Wukong dances nimbly along the treetop canopy, always just out of arm's reach.
lore_zh: 孙悟空在树顶上灵活地跳跃，总是一跃而至。
notes_en: Tree Dance cooldown starts upon landing.
Right-clicking the ground will have Monkey King drop from the tree.
Movement is interrupted if Monkey King is stunned, hexed or banished.
notes_zh: 丛林之舞在落地时进入冷却。
右键点击地面后齐天大圣会从树上跳下。
齐天大圣受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时位移都会被打断。

description_en: Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the fourth hit on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns 4 charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.
description_zh: 齐天大圣的攻击唤醒了金箍棒的力量。连续攻击四次同个敌方英雄后，齐天大圣的下4次攻击得到加强，拥有攻击力加成和吸血效果。
lore_en: Always sensitive to the moods of its master, the Jingu Bang radiates power when Sun Wukong's combat fervor is on full display.
lore_zh: 金箍棒能敏锐感知主人的情绪，在孙悟空展现战意时散发力量。
notes_en: Hitting an enemy with Boundless Strike adds to the hit counter.
Repeatedly hitting an enemy refreshes the Jingu Mastery debuff duration.
Hit charges on enemies cannot be dispelled.
Jingu Mastery buff on self can be dispelled.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
notes_zh: 棒击大地击中敌人时也会计入攻击次数。
再次攻击敌人将刷新如意棒法的计数持续时间。
敌人身上的计数效果无法被驱散。
自身的如意棒法效果可以被驱散。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

description_en:
Monkey King creates a circular formation of soldiers that spread out from his position. If Monkey King leaves the area his soldiers disperse. The soldiers have Monkey King's attack that attacks at a fixed rate of 1.1s, and only targets enemy Heroes. Monkey King is granted bonus armor for the spell's duration.

Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a short duration, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead.
description_zh:
齐天大圣变出圆形的猴子猴孙阵列，猴子猴孙从他的位置散开。若齐天大圣离开范围，猴子猴孙将会消失。猴子猴孙继承齐天大圣的攻击力，攻击频率为固定的1.1秒，并且只会以敌方英雄为目标。在技能持续时间内齐天大圣获得护甲加成。

齐天大圣可以在猴子猴孙期间变成其中一个猴子猴孙，短时间内取代其位置，无法和其他猴子猴孙相区分，并且在原地留下一个猴子猴孙。
lore_en: Monkey King rips out a tuft of fur to blow at his enemies, charging each strand to transform into a copy of himself.
lore_zh: 齐天大圣将一簇猴毛吹向敌人，每根毛都变成了自己的复制体。
notes_en: Soldiers do not receive Jingu Mastery bonuses.
Soldiers do not copy Basher or Abyssal.
notes_zh: 猴子猴孙不会获得如意棒法的加成效果。
猴子猴孙不会继承碎颅锤和深渊之刃的效果。
scepter_en: Spawns a monkey soldier near Monkey King at regular intervals. Soldiers do not spawn while invisible or on trees. Soldiers only attack buildings when Monkey King himself is nearby. Soldiers can now gain Jingu Mastery charges independently.
scepter_zh: 每隔一段时间在齐天大圣附近产生一个猴子猴孙。隐身或上树时不会产生。只有齐天大圣在附近时猴子猴孙才会攻击建筑。猴子猴孙现在独立获得如意棒法的效果。

special_values.name: scepter_spawn_interval
special_values.heading_zh: 单个猴子猴孙产生间隔：

special_values.name: scepter_spawn_duration
special_values.heading_zh: 单个猴子猴孙持续时间：

description_en:
Muerta fires a ghostly trickshot at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes, it damages and briefly slows, then ricochets in the targeted direction.

The ricochet damages all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet are feared away from the impact.
description_zh:
琼英碧灵向一个敌方单位或一棵树发射一颗幽灵子弹。子弹击中时会对敌人造成伤害和短暂减速，然后沿矢量目标的方向弹去。

跳弹将会对穿过的所有单位造成伤害，击中英雄后停下。被跳弹击中的英雄会被恐惧。
lore_en: A steady gunhand and an eternity of practice produce trickshots that defy the mortal mind.
lore_zh: 握枪的手能纹丝不动，再加上永世的练习，产生了让凡人的头脑难以经受的花式射击。
notes_en: Feared enemies are phased and unslowable.
The ricochet will travel 1.5x Dead Shot's cast range.
Can ricochet off of magic immune targets.
notes_zh: 被恐惧的敌人为相位状态，无法被减速。
跳弹的行进距离为弹无虚发施法距离的1.5倍。
可以弹离减益免疫目标。
scepter_en: Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.
scepter_zh: 弹无虚发的伤害提升。弹无虚发的作用范围在弹跳后会扩大，并且跳弹恐惧敌人时会穿过敌方英雄。

description_en: Summons a group of 4 revenants that slowly circle the targeted location. Enemies within the area are slowed. Revenants deal damage and silence enemies as they pass through them.
description_zh: 召唤4个亡魂，缓慢地环绕目标地点。在区域内的敌人会被减速。亡魂会在敌人穿过时造成伤害和沉默。
lore_en: Muerta's family are forever beyond the spirit veil, but her deal with Death allows her to briefly call on them in times of want or need.
lore_zh: 琼英碧灵的家人永远都在生界之外，但是她与死神的交易让她可以在需要的时候看望他们片刻。

description_en: Toggleable. When toggled on, Muerta's attacks have a chance to fire a second shot at another target.
description_zh: 可以开关。开启后，琼英碧灵攻击时有几率对另一个目标再射一枪。
lore_en: Muerta offers all of her victims Mercy. Some are fortunate enough to also earn Grace.
lore_zh: 琼英碧灵会给予她所有目标仁慈。部分交上了好运还会获得恩泽。
notes_en: If no other units are in range, she fires both guns at the original target.
Secondary shots can hit units within Muerta's attack range plus 175.
The secondary shot can trigger attack modifiers.
Prioritizes heroes, then non-hero units, then buildings.
notes_zh: 如果距离内没有其他单位，她会向原目标发射两枪。
第二枪可以击中琼英碧灵攻击距离加上175范围内的单位。
第二枪可以触发攻击特效。
以英雄优先，然后是非英雄单位，然后是建筑。

description_en:
Muerta transforms, becoming ethereal, gaining bonus base damage and phased movement.

Passively allows Muerta to always attack ethereal targets and attack when she is ethereal. When either she or her target is ethereal, all of her attack damage is dealt as magical damage and her physical lifesteal is treated as spell lifesteal.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
description_zh:
琼英碧灵变身，成为虚无状态，获得基础攻击力加成和相位移动状态。

被动使总是可以攻击虚无状态下的目标，并且她在虚无状态下也能攻击。在她或目标处于虚无时，她的所有攻击伤害均为魔法伤害，她的物理吸血被视为技能吸血。

驱散类型：弱驱散
lore_en: Muerta sheds her corporeal form, crossing the spirit veil and striking her enemies with the fury of the damned.
lore_zh: 琼英碧灵脱去她的实体形态，穿过生死之界，利用恶灵的愤怒打击她的敌人。
notes_en: Muerta will dodge projectiles upon transformation.
Muerta cannot attack buildings while transformed.
notes_zh: 琼英碧灵在变身期间可以躲避弹道。
琼英碧灵在变身后无法攻击建筑。

name_en: 1.5x Flesh Heap and Meat Shield bonuses
name_zh: 1.5倍 腐肉堆积和肉盾加成

name_en: +1 Armor Corruption to Visage and Familiars
name_zh: +1 维萨吉和佣兽削弱护甲
description_en: This effect can stack among multiple sources and lasts 10s.
description_zh: 本效果的多个来源可以叠加，持续10秒。

name_zh: 冰霜魔盾提供+50 生命恢复

name_en: 25% Damage Resistance for Chaotic Offering Golems

name_zh: 2.5倍 瘟疫守卫生命/攻击力

description_en: Increases both stun and path duration.
description_zh: 同时提升眩晕和路径持续时间。

name_en: +1.5% Infernal Blade Max HP As Damage

name_zh: +12 神龙之血生命恢复/护甲

description_en: Releases 11 additional Deafening Blasts around Invoker in a circular pattern. An enemy can only be hit once per cast.
description_zh: 以祈求者为圆心施放11道超震声波。每个敌人只能受到一次作用。

name_zh: 实相裂隙无视减益免疫

name_en: +30 Astral Spirit Bonus Damage per Hero
name_zh: +30 灵体游魂触碰英雄攻击力

description_en: The duration of the stun is not affected.
description_zh: 眩晕的持续时间不受影响。

description_en: Launches two extra Stifling Daggers towards random visible enemies within the cast range.
description_zh: 对施法距离内随机两个视野内敌人分别施放一把窒碍短匕。

name_zh: +60 静态风暴最高每秒伤害
+75 死亡旋风树倒额外伤害
烈焰破击施加4层粘性燃油
-0.7% 血怒每秒最大生命值伤害

description_en: The extra arrows are launched in a cone shape, 25 degrees to the left and right of the original arrow, and cannot hit the same target.
description_zh: 额外的神箭将以锥形射出，分别为施法方向向左和向右偏移25度，无法重复击中同个目标。

name_zh: 极度饥渴期间-0.15秒基础攻击间隔
+5 麻痹之咬额外攻击伤害

name_en: Hand of God Fully Heals Chen and His Creeps
name_zh: 上帝之手治愈陈和他的单位
description_en: Initial Heal fully heals. Heal over time is still applied.
description_zh: 初始治疗会回复至满血。依然会施加持续治疗。

name_zh: +20 缠绕之根每秒缠绕伤害
description_en: Also applies to Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws Root
description_zh: 也会施加给熊灵的缠绕之爪的缠绕

name_en: +1% Target Max Health Voodoo Restoration Heal
name_zh: 巫毒疗法+1% 目标最大生命值治疗

description_en: Allied heroes within 1200 range of Centaur gain the Return Damage aspect of Retaliate.
description_zh: 半人马战行者附近1200范围内友方英雄都具有反伤的反击伤害。

description_en: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.
description_zh: 在地图任意地点创造一朵雷云，雷云将自动对附近敌人施放雷击。
lore_en: Where the thunder god's ire grows, storm clouds quickly gather.
lore_zh: 雷神的怒气滋长之地，雷云也会很快聚集。
notes_en: Grants 125 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
Affects the closest enemy unit with strikes from Zeus's current level of Lightning Bolt.
Towers and creeps do half damage to the Nimbus.
notes_zh: 敌方英雄将其摧毁后可以获得125金。
以宙斯当前等级的雷击作用于最近的敌方单位。
防御塔和非英雄单位对雷云造成半额伤害。

description_en: Dark Willow creates a 500 AoE maze of 8 brambles that grow in the target area after 0.3 seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts 12 seconds.
description_zh: 0.3秒后邪影芳灵在目标区域创造出500范围的迷宫，迷宫拥有8棵荆棘。进入荆棘的敌人将被缠绕，并且持续受到伤害。迷宫持续12秒。
lore_en: The fae realm exists all around you, merely waiting to draw you in...
lore_zh: 仙灵之境将你环绕，只是在等着让你深陷……
notes_en: Does not interrupt channeling spells upon rooting.
notes_zh: 缠绕无法打断持续施法。

description_en: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies. Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.
description_zh: 邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物在持续时间内围绕自身飞行，快速攻击周围敌人。恐吓生效期间不能使用作祟。
lore_en: You'll have to excuse my friend Jex. He's really into murder.
lore_zh: 你得原谅我的朋友杰克斯。他是有点杀红了眼。

description_en: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable. Her next attack has 600 bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after 3 seconds.
description_zh: 邪影芳灵遁入暗影之境，无法成为攻击或技能的目标。她的下次攻击具有600额外攻击距离，并且造成额外魔法伤害，暗影之境技能也会随之结束。在暗影中时间越长，伤害越高。在暗影之境内的时间超过3秒将达到最高伤害。
lore_en: What you can't see will most definitely hurt you.
lore_zh: 你看不见的东西肯定会害你。
notes_en: Disjoints projectiles upon cast.
Grants phased movement.
Spells which require vision cannot affect Dark Willow in the Shadow Realm.
notes_zh: 施法时能躲避弹道。
获得相位移动状态。
需要视野的技能无法作用于暗影之境中的邪影芳灵。
scepter_en: Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.
scepter_zh: 发动普通攻击不再使邪影芳灵脱离暗影之境。持续时间内每次攻击都带有额外伤害。

description_en: Dark Willow casts an ancient fae curse on the target. After a delay, the target and nearby enemies are stunned.
description_zh: 邪影芳灵授予敌人一顶被诅咒的古老仙灵王冠。经过一定延迟后，目标和周围的所有敌人都会被眩晕。
lore_en: Didn't anyone ever tell you? Never strike a deal with a fairy...
lore_zh: 没人告诉过你吗？千万别和仙女打交道……
shard_en: Cursed Crown creates 4 brambles in a 175 radius around the target after the counter ends. Triggers even upon dispel. Cursed Crown cooldown reduced by 1.5 seconds.
shard_zh: 诅咒王冠在倒计时结束时会围绕目标在175范围内产生4朵荆棘。即使效果被驱散也会触发。诅咒王冠的冷却时间减少1.5秒。

description_en:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with 80% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land.

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
description_zh:
石鳞剑士卷成一个减益免疫状态的圆球，拥有80%魔法抗性，隆隆地向前滚去。滚动时移动速度提升，可以碾过树木，但是转身速率降低。敌人被击中后会被击退，然后受到与他的攻击力成正比的伤害，并且被眩晕。

与地形障碍相撞后会暂时停止滚动，并且滚动方向变反。

驱散类型：弱驱散
lore_en: Where his ancestors sought only refuge, the Pangolier saw opportunity...
lore_zh: 他的祖先只能找到安全感的地方，石鳞剑士却看见了机遇……
notes_en: Enemies can be stunned multiple times per use, but cannot be affected a subsequent time until the previous stun duration ends.
If Pangolier is disabled while rolling, he will continue to stun and knock enemies that come within range.
It takes Pangolier 1s to reach full roll speed.
notes_zh: 敌人在技能期间可以多次被眩晕，但是只有上一次眩晕结束后才会再次被眩晕。
即使石鳞剑士在滚动时被控制，他依然会对范围内敌人造成眩晕和击退。
石鳞剑士需要1秒才能达到全额的滚动速度。

description_en:
Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.

Lucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
description_zh:
石鳞剑士先冲向目标地点，再向指示方向上的所有敌人刺出数剑并减速他们。

刺剑有几率触发幸运一击。
lore_en: The Pangolier's blade is even nimbler than his tongue.
lore_zh: 石鳞剑士的剑比舌头还要灵活。
notes_en: Casting Swashbuckle during Rolling Thunder ends Rolling Thunder.
notes_zh: 在地雷滚滚期间施放虚张声势将使地雷滚滚提前结束。

name_zh: +400 不稳定化合物最高伤害
+600 裂地尖刺施法/行进距离

description_en: The Returning Shockwave deals 100% damage and travels an extra 200 distance.
description_zh: 回归的震荡波造成100%伤害，并且额外行进200距离。

name_en: --0.1s Eye of the Storm Strike Interval
Focus Fire Kills Advance Cooldown by 16s
name_zh: 集中火力击杀后减16秒冷却

description_en:
Pangolier jumps in the air and slams back to the ground in front of his current position damaging all enemies in a radius. Pangolier gains an all damage barrier for a short time if Shield Crash hits an enemy hero.

Forward movement is maintained if Shield Crash is used while Rolling Thunder is active, and allows Rolling Thunder to clear walls or cliffs.
description_zh:
石鳞剑士跃入空中，再落向当前位置的前方地面造成冲击，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害。甲盾冲击只要击中任意敌方英雄，他就能在短时间内获得一定数值的全伤害护盾。

地雷滚滚过程中使用甲盾冲击将会保持前进，并且可以使地雷滚滚跨过地形障碍。
lore_en: Only in the midst of his enemies does the Pangolier truly thrive.
lore_zh: 只有被敌人层层包围，石鳞剑士才能真正地一展雄风。
scepter_en: Causes Shield Crash to cast a 2-attack Swashbuckle every 90 degrees around your hero that deals 75% damage.
scepter_zh: 甲盾冲击将围绕英雄每90度施放一个刺击2次的虚张声势，造成75%伤害。

description_en: Void Spirit temporarily fades into the aether, creating a number of portals through which he can reassemble himself. Upon exiting a portal, he damages all enemies in the area.
description_zh: 虚无之灵暂时遁入太虚，创造数个灵扉。穿过灵扉他能重组自身。穿出灵扉后，他对区域内所有敌人造成伤害。
lore_en: Inai much prefers to observe our plane free from the confines of corporeal form.
lore_zh: 无玄更愿意脱离肉体的限制，自由地观察我们的位面。

name_zh: +30 蜥蜴绝吻烧灼每秒伤害

description_en: Snapfire unloads with a wide blast that damages and slows enemies in a cone. Damage is increased by 25% and Movement Slow, Attack Slow and Slow Duration are increased by 50% for enemies caught at point-blank range.
description_zh: 电炎绝手开枪产生大范围的爆炸，对锥形区域内的敌人造成伤害和减速。平射距离内的伤害提升25%，移动速度减缓、攻击速度降低和减速持续时间额外提升50%。
lore_en: A favorite from her collection, Beadie crafted Ol' Rackatee as her first line of defense when she ventured into the Outlands.
lore_zh: 碧婆婆珍藏中的最爱，她打造这把“老坏蛋”作为自己闯入世外之地的首道防线。

description_en: Snapfire's friend launches a barrage of firespit globs over 5.5 seconds. Globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time. Snapfire has a reduced turn rate for the duration and a minimum launch range of 600. Each glob can be targeted with a right click.
description_zh: 电炎绝手的伙伴在5.5秒内喷吐出密集的火团。火团造成冲击伤害，在地面上产生炽烈的炎洼，可以使敌人减速并造成持续伤害。电炎绝手在持续时间内转身速率降低，并且具有最小喷吐距离，为600。点击右键可以选择火团的目标区域。
lore_en: Little did Beadie know when she adopted Mortimer, dragon toads--which aren't even toads at all--share more than just a name with their distant draconic cousins.
lore_zh: 碧婆婆收养小莫迪时她一无所知，龙蜥——根本都不是蜥蜴——和他们遥远的龙族表亲并非只是名字一样而已。
notes_en: Can be cancelled by pressing Stop, Hold Position, or using another ability.
Has a minimum travel time of 0.8 and maximum travel time of 2.
notes_zh: 可以通过停止、停在原位或使用其他技能来终止。
最短飞行时间为0.8秒，最长飞行时间为2秒。

description_en: Snapfire feeds a potent cookie to Mortimer or an ally, causing them to hop a short distance. The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.
description_zh: 电炎绝手将一块烈性饼干喂给小莫迪或一名队友，使他们短距离跳跃。跳跃的单位将在落地时对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。
lore_en: With the help of a secret mixture that pairs Beadie's baking skills with her passion for black powder, these battle biscuits pack a punch.
lore_zh: 在神秘配方的帮助下，碧婆婆的烘焙技艺和她对黑火药的热情相得益彰，这些战斗饼干相当猛烈。
notes_en: The cookie projectile has a speed of 1200.
notes_zh: 饼干的弹道速度为1200。
shard_en: Firesnap cookies become even more potent, healing the target and launching a Mortimer Kiss that does 40% impact damage to the landing destination.
shard_zh: 龙炎饼干变得更具威力，治疗目标，并且朝着陆地点发射一个40%冲击伤害的蜥蜴绝吻。

description_en: Mortimer gobbles up a creep or an allied hero, which he can then spit towards enemies. The unit stays in his belly up to 0 seconds.
description_zh: 小莫迪吞下一个小兵或一名友方英雄，再朝敌人吐出。单位停留在他肚子里最多可达0秒。
lore_en: SHLORP!
lore_zh: 哧！
notes_en: Snapfire earns the creep's bounty after it has been spat out and died.
notes_zh: 电炎绝手在小兵被吐出并阵亡后获得相应的金钱。

description_en: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has a no minimum launch range.
description_zh: 小莫迪吐出他肚子里的单位，对大片区域造成冲击伤害和眩晕。留下的火痰根据蜥蜴绝吻的当前等级还将持续造成减速和伤害。喷吐没有最小发射距离。
lore_en: SPITTOOO!
lore_zh: 噗！

description_en: Snapfire heats up her mounted turret to rapidly fire 5 attacks dealing fixed damage plus a percentage of her attack damage. Each attack reduces the enemy's armor. Provides bonus attack range for the duration.
description_zh: 电炎绝手开动蜥蜴坐骑上的加农炮，快速发动5次固定伤害加上自身攻击伤害一定百分比的攻击。每次攻击都将削弱敌人的护甲。在持续时间内提供攻击距离加成。
lore_en: Beadie constantly tinkers with a design she first dreamed up plotting an exodus from her old gang.
lore_zh: 碧婆婆一直在修补她原来为秘密计划离开劫匪帮所设计的作品。
notes_en: Sets base attack time to 1s for the duration.
Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on Lil' Shredder attacks.
notes_zh: 持续时间内基础攻击间隔变为1。
霹雳铁手的攻击也有几率触发攻击特效。

description_en: Binds a targeted enemy hero to its nearest allied hero within the bind radius, preventing both from moving away from each other. Any unit-targeted ability that either bound hero receives also gets cast on the other hero. If the bind is broken before the duration expires, the initial target will be bound to its nearest allied hero in the radius.
description_zh: 将一名敌方英雄与束缚作用范围内最接近的队友相连，阻止他们远离彼此。任何指向性技能击中任一英雄时，这两名敌方英雄都会受到作用。若连接在效果截止前断裂，初始目标将再次与其距离内最接近的队友相连。
lore_en: The Ascended were chosen sons of Ashkavor, granted immense power by the bonds forged between their own souls and those they were charged with protecting. In the years that followed the ruination of his kin, Grimstroke discovered much more sinister applications for the binding rituals...
lore_zh: 飞升之人皆为烬州城的选召之子，通过自己的灵魂和他们应守护的族人之间创造的束缚获得了巨大的力量。在同胞毁灭的多年之后，天涯墨客发现束缚仪式更为凶险的用途……
notes_en: If bound to another unit, affected units are leashed and prevented from blinking.
Provides vision of both leashed units.
notes_zh: 如果与另一个单位一起被束缚，作用下单位均被束缚，而且无法使用闪烁类技能。
被束缚的单位都将提供视野。

description_en: Mars smashes enemies in front of him with his shield, knocking them back and damaging them with a critical hit based on his attack. Bonus damage is added when hitting heroes. Has True Strike.
description_zh: 玛尔斯举起他的战盾粉碎前方的敌人，将他们击退并且基于自身攻击力造成致命一击伤害。攻击英雄时攻击伤害提升。具有克敌机先效果。
lore_en: There isn't a warrior alive who can stand unmoved by the sting of Mars' rebuke.
lore_zh: 在玛尔斯谴戒的刺痛下世上还没有战士能纹丝不动。
notes_en: Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on God's Rebuke attacks.
notes_zh: 神之谴戒的攻击也有几率触发攻击特效。

name_en: 5% Fiery Soul Magic Resist Per Stack

description_en: Applies Magnetize at its current duration to enemy Heroes around Earth Spirit, and can be refreshed with Stone Remnants.
description_zh: 把当前持续时间的磁化施加给大地之灵附近的敌方英雄，而且可以用残岩刷新。

name_en: +25 Damage to Beastmaster and his summons
name_zh: 兽王及其召唤物+25 攻击力

description_en: A second Soul Assumption is launched towards a random enemy unit within the cast range, prioritizing Heroes.
description_zh: 施放灵魂超度时会同时对施法距离内一个随机敌方单位施放，以英雄优先。

name_en: -1 Moment of Courage Attacks To Trigger
name_zh: -1 勇气之霎触发需攻击次数

name_en: +3.5% Liquid Frost and Fire Max Health Damage
description_en: Deals +3.5% of the target's max health as damage. This damage does not apply to Buildings.
description_zh: 造成+3.5%目标最大生命值的伤害。这个伤害不会对建筑生效。

name_zh: 绝冥再生施放冥火爆击
description_en: Instead of being slowed, all enemy units within 900 range have the current level of Wraithfire Blast cast on them when Reincarnation triggers.
description_zh: 触发绝冥再生时900范围内所有敌方单位将受到当前等级冥火暴击的作用。

description_en:
Mars wields his massive shield to block a portion of each physical attack when hit from the front or sides.

Can be toggled, granting phased movement, removing Mars's ability to attack, and locking the direction he is facing. When active, reduces movement speed and re-directs 70% of the attack projectiles aimed at allies towards himself.
description_zh:
每当玛尔斯受到来自正面或侧面的攻击时，他就挥舞他那面巨大的战盾来格挡一定百分比的伤害。

可以开启，开启后获得相位移动状态，但无法攻击，自身锁定为面朝的方向，并且移动速度降低，但飞向队友的攻击弹道中70%将改变方向朝他飞去。
lore_en: Only the very foolish dare to fight fair with the god of war.
lore_zh: 只有蠢到家了才胆敢与战神公平作战。
notes_en: Redirect only works if the projectile targets are in a cone behind Mars or within 100 range of him.
Break disables the front and side damage reduction.
notes_zh: 改向只会在弹道目标位于玛尔斯身后锥形区域内或他身边100范围内才会生效。
破坏会使正面和侧面减伤效果失效。

description_en: Mars throws his legendary Spear with deadly precision, damaging each enemy unit it strikes. The first enemy hero it hits is skewered on the spear, pushing it back. If a skewered hero hits a tree, building, or cliff, they will be impaled to it and stunned.
description_zh: 玛尔斯以致命的精准掷出他强大的战矛，对击中的每个敌方单位造成伤害。击中的第一个敌方英雄将被战矛刺穿，并被击退。若战矛击中树木、建筑或悬崖，目标将会被钉在上面，并受到眩晕。
lore_en: The legendary Spear of Mars still glows with the heat of the forge god's fires.
lore_zh: 玛尔斯的传奇战矛上依然闪耀着熔铸之神烈焰的热力。
notes_en: Spear of Mars can hit invisible units and reveals them if they are stunned.
Spear of Mars will only pin a unit to cliffs onto elevated areas, otherwise it will push them off onto lower ground.
notes_zh: 战神迅矛可以击中隐身单位，造成眩晕还使其显形。
战神迅矛只会将单位从低地钉在地势变高的地方，否则会将他们推下高地。
shard_en: Spear of Mars impales up to 1 heroes and leaves a fire trail behind that deals damage over time and slows movement speed.
shard_zh: 战神迅矛可以刺中最多1名英雄，并留下一道火焰路径，持续造成伤害并减缓移动速度。

name_en: +65 Curse of Avernus Attack Speed Bonus

name_zh: +5% 火焰飞行最高移速加成

name_en: Cinder Brew applies Fear when ignited
name_zh: 余烬佳酿点燃时施加恐惧
description_en: Lasts 1.5 seconds.
description_zh: 持续1.5秒。

name_zh: +0.6秒 混乱之箭最短/最长眩晕

description_en: A Searing Arrows attack will send another arrow into a random enemy within Clinkz's attack range.
description_zh: 灼热之箭的攻击会向克林克兹攻击距离内一个随机敌人再射出一箭。

name_zh: +35 压倒性优势英雄提供伤害
+25/50 月之祝福友军/自身攻击力

name_en: +0.8% of Current Mana as Movement Speed

name_zh: +9%/18% 绝人之路最低/最高减速
真熊形态提供70% 减速抗性
攻击羁绊友军的目标（50%伤害）
description_en: While tethered to a friendly Hero, each time that Hero attacks, Io will attack the same target automatically.
description_zh: 羁绊连接至友方英雄时，每次该英雄攻击也会使艾欧自动攻击同一目标。

name_zh: +4% 冰晶爆轰斩杀血量上限

description_en: Also affects Kinetic Fence
description_zh: 也会影响动能栅栏

name_zh: +20/40 幽冥剧毒最低/最高伤害
窃取的技能+40% 技能增强
+10% 上古封印加深魔法伤害

name_en: 450 Distance Auto Remnant in Ball Lightning
name_zh: 球状闪电每450距离释放残影
description_en: Every 450 distance travelled in Ball Lightning creates a Static Remnant.
description_zh: 施放球状闪电每行进450距离将产生一个残影。

name_zh: +1.25% 烈日炙烤最大生命值伤害

description_en: Throws the tree at the target unit, proccing your attack on it and splashing damage around the target.
description_zh: 将树木扔向目标单位，触发自身对其的攻击，并且对周围目标造成溅射伤害。
lore_en: Even enemies can share in Tiny's arbor ardor.
lore_zh: 就算是敌人也能分享小小对树木的热情。

description_en: Applies a basic dispel to Templar Assassin.
description_zh: 对圣堂刺客施加一个弱驱散效果。

name_en: +6 Max / +1 Hero Attack Reactive Armor Stacks
name_zh: +6/+1 活性护甲最大/英雄攻击叠加
+75% 伐木锯链距离/发射速度
+10% 寄生种子伤害转为治疗

description_en: Can be cast while stunned and applies a strong dispel to Troll Warlord.
description_zh: 被眩晕时也能施放，对巨魔战将施加一个强驱散效果。

name_zh: 普攻有12%几率触发海象神拳！
description_en: Walrus Punch gains a chance to be triggered on normal attacks, independent of mana cost or cooldown.
description_zh: 普通攻击有几率触发海象神拳，与技能的魔法消耗或冷却时间相互独立。

name_zh: +10% 衰退光环降低/获得攻击力
+30 灵魂超度每点灵魂伤害

description_en: The slow is still applied for the same duration.
description_zh: 减速效果的持续时间不变。

name_zh: -25% 巫毒疗法每秒消耗魔法

description_en: Grants a 20% chance to avoid damage entirely. Disabled by break.
description_zh: 拥有20%几率完全避免受到伤害。会被破坏禁用。

description_en: Toss can target the ground as well as enemy units.
description_zh: 投掷除了以敌方单位为目标，还可以对地施放。

name_en: +75% Hammer of Purity Bonus Base Damage
name_zh: +75% 纯洁之锤基础攻击力伤害

description_en: Creates an additional ring of 7 soldiers at 1100 range from the center.
description_zh: 额外产生一个半径为1100距离的7人圆阵。

name_zh: 照明火箭具有真实视域
攻击有17%几率触发火焰爆轰

name_en: +40s Glaives of Wisdom Int Steal Duration
Lucent Beam Hits An Additional Target
name_zh: 月光额外打击一个目标
description_en: Random target within 500 range of the primary target.
description_zh: 主目标500范围内随机目标。

name_zh: +10% 脉冲新星期间承伤降低

name_en: Earthbind grants True Strike on Targets
name_zh: 攻击地之束缚目标具有克敌机先

description_en: Beastmaster calls forth a Boar to aid in the battlefield. The Boar has a passive poison attack that slows attack and movement speeds.
description_zh: 兽王召唤一头豪猪前来助阵。豪猪拥有被动的毒素攻击，可以减缓攻击和移动速度。
lore_en: After befriending the strange beast of his childhood, Beastmaster has learned to call to animals in times of need.
lore_zh: 度过了与异兽互惠互助的孩童时期，兽王学会了如何随时召唤野兽。

description_en: Beastmaster summons 2 hawks that circle around Beastmaster and dive-bombs at enemies with a base attack rate of every 4s, damaging and rooting them. Attack rate increases with the Hawk's attack speed. Prioritizes heroes.
description_zh: 兽王召唤2只战鹰环绕在他周围，战鹰以4秒的基础攻击间隔俯冲攻击敌人，造成伤害并缠绕。战鹰提升攻击速度后会提升攻击频率。以英雄优先。
lore_en: After befriending the strange beast of his childhood, Beastmaster has learned to call to animals in times of need.
lore_zh: 度过了与异兽互惠互助的孩童时期，兽王学会了如何随时召唤野兽。

description_en: In a fiery rage, knocks all nearby enemies away from you to a fixed distance, dealing damage and silencing them.
description_zh: 在炽烈的狂暴下将附近所有敌人击退至固定距离外，造成伤害和沉默。
lore_en: Not even Huskar's own flesh can contain the unending expansion of his life force.
lore_zh: 就连哈斯卡自己的肉体都容纳不了他不断膨胀的生命力。

description_en: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.
description_zh: 裂魂人获得移动速度和状态抗性加成，在敌人之间横冲直撞。可以在冲刺期间使用。
lore_en: Barathrum warps the fabric of reality around him, lessening its influence on his physical form.
lore_zh: 巴拉森扭曲了他周遭现实的结构，减轻他的肉体形态受到的影响。

description_en:
Passively provides an aura that grants increased health regeneration. Can be cast on allies to provide them with bonus armor and increasing the healing and health regeneration they receive.

If cast on Chen, all units controlled by Chen receive the buff.
description_zh:
被动提供光环，提供生命恢复加成。可以主动对友军施放，提供护甲加成，以及治疗和生命恢复增强。

对陈施放后，陈控制的所有单位都会获得增益效果。
lore_en: Chen's zeal is infectious, blessing his allies with vitality and compelling them to his side.
lore_zh: 陈的狂热极具感染力，他的盟友得到了生命力的祝福，还被迫在他身旁战斗。

description_en: Pangolier rolls the dice and lets fate decide the outcome for his enemies. Grants a chance to drastically slow their attack speed and reduce armor on any damage dealt by Pangolier's attacks or abilities.
description_zh: 石鳞剑士孤注一掷，让命运决定敌人的下场。石鳞剑士的攻击或技能拥有一定几率大幅降低攻击速度，同时削弱护甲。
lore_en: The Pangolier's blade is guided more often by whim than reason.
lore_zh: 石鳞剑士出剑更多时候是因心血来潮，而非理智。

description_en: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
description_zh: 连接独行德鲁伊和熊灵，提升双方的移动速度，另外双方共享一定百分比的吸血效果。
lore_en: Sylla is emboldened by the presence of his companion, his vitality replenished with each swipe of the Spirit Bear's claws.
lore_zh: 悉拉在他伙伴身旁倍感鼓舞，熊灵每次挥爪都让他的生命力得到补充。
notes_en: Break disables the shared lifesteal.
notes_zh: 破坏会使共享吸血效果失效。

description_en:
Rolls a barrel of ale at enemies that damages enemies along its path and spills out at the target location.

Any enemy in the path or the spill area is drenched in cinder brew, becoming slowed. If the enemy receives Magic or Pure damage, they will be ignited, extending the duration by 3s and causing them to take damage over time.
description_zh:
向敌人扔出一个酒桶，对沿途的敌人造成伤害，并在目标地点溅出酒液。

路径上和溅酒点的敌人会浸满余烬佳酿，并且被减速。受到魔法或纯粹伤害后还将被点燃。点燃时持续时间增加3秒，并且受到持续伤害。
lore_en: The Order of the Oyo's solution to all problems - another round!
lore_zh: 奥尤社解决所有问题的方法——再喝一轮！

description_en: Passively grants magic resistance. Counterspell may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks and reflects any targeted spells.
description_zh: 被动提升魔法抗性。可以主动开启法术反制，创造一个环绕敌法师的反魔法外壳，抵挡和反弹所有指向性技能。
lore_en: With the proper focus, Anti-Mage turns innate resistance into calculated retaliation.
lore_zh: 经过潜心的专注后，敌法师将内在的韧性转为精心的报复。
notes_en: Break disables the passive magic resistance.
notes_zh: 破坏会使被动魔法抗性失效。
shard_en: Creates a blinked fragment of Anti-Mage next to the enemy caster upon reflecting their unit-targeted spell while active.
shard_zh: 开启后反弹指向性技能时会在敌方施法者身边制造一个敌法师的闪烁碎片。

description_en: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
description_zh: 在目标区域召唤幻火。幻火交替闪亮和闪灭。闪亮时蛊惑敌人靠近，并造成伤害。
lore_en: Though he would not claim to 'know' them, Ezalor holds an uncanny influence over many powerful creatures always willing to come to his aid.
lore_zh: 虽然伊扎洛不会宣扬自己“认识”他们，但他离奇地影响着很多愿意援助他的强大生物。
notes_en: Ignus Fatuus applies a non-interrupting pull towards it on all enemies within the radius.
notes_zh: 幻火会对作用范围内所有敌人施加朝其牵引的效果，该牵引效果不会打断。

description_en:
Steals health from the enemy with each strike and heals all other Meepos for that amount.

Reduced to 60% against creeps.
description_zh:
每次攻击都会窃取敌人的生命值，并治疗所有其他米波相同数值生命。

对非英雄单位的效果减少至60%。
lore_en: So you gonna need that, or...?
lore_zh: 所以你要吗，还是……？
notes_en: Amount healed is amplified by Health Restoration Amplification
notes_zh: 治疗数值会被生命回复增强效果提升。

description_en: Summons a row of Burning Skeleton Archers in the target location.
description_zh: 在目标地点召唤一列烈焰骷髅弓手。
lore_en: Existing on the brink of life and death, Clinkz has learned to temporarily bridge the gap between the two.
lore_zh: 克林克兹存在于生与死的边缘，他能自如地在这两者之间架起短暂的桥梁。

description_en: Rubick's mastery of the arcane allows him to have a larger cast range and bonus spell amplification.
description_zh: 拉比克对奥术的熟稔使他拥有更远的施法距离，和额外技能增强。
lore_en: Not every magus can be a Grand Magus...
lore_zh: 不是每一个魔导师都能成为大魔导师……

description_en: Activate to temporarily apply a negative debuff aura around you, causing enemies that are attacked under it to take bonus physical damage and reduced movement speed. Lasts 6 seconds.
description_zh: 主动使用后暂时施加一个具有负面效果的光环，使作用范围内的敌人被攻击时承受额外物理伤害，并且移动速度被减缓。持续6秒。
lore_en: Even far from Cobalt, Tusk carries the 'Barrier Chill' in his very bones.
lore_zh: 就算远离钴蓝冰原，巨牙海民骨子里还是有着“寒战屏障”。
notes_en: Affects attacks from allied heroes, Tusk or any of his units.
notes_zh: 影响来自友方英雄、巨牙海民和他控制的所有单位的普通攻击。

description_en: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 使一个敌方单位着魔，缓慢走到巫妖与其之间的一点，并吸取其当前魔法值的一定百分比。
lore_en: Mind the cold...
lore_zh: 当心寒意……
scepter_en: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of 400 in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.
scepter_zh: 阴邪凝视变成范围型技能，对目标区域400范围内所有单位生效。在阴邪凝视的持续施法期间可以施放其他技能。

description_en: Void Spirit dispatches a remnant to the target location. The remnant stands watch over the region, facing the direction of his vector. When a unit crosses its gaze, the remnant pulls it in and damages it.
description_zh: 虚无之灵向目标地点派出一个残像。残像观察着一片区域，面朝矢量的方向。当有目标进入其视线，残像会拉扯，并造成伤害。
lore_en: Inai exists far beyond the scope of a single point in space and time.
lore_zh: 无玄的存在远超时间和空间中的一个点。
shard_en: Creates an additional watcher path that rotates around the remnant. The remnant now provides True Sight, and no longer triggers on creeps, instead dealing 50% damage to them every second in both paths. Does not reveal wards.
shard_zh: 额外产生一道观察路径，会围绕残阴旋转。残阴现在会提供真实视域，不再对非英雄单位触发，而是每秒在两道路径上造成50%伤害。不会使守卫显形。

description_en: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for 1.25 seconds and then detonates.
description_zh: 虚无之灵撕裂现实进入精神位面，再出现在目标地点，对沿途的所有敌人造成伤害。此次攻击将施加一个太虚印记，造成1.25秒减速，然后引爆。
lore_en: A small step for Inai creates great devastation on the mortal plane.
lore_zh: 无玄的一小步就能在凡间引发极大的毁灭。
notes_en: Astral Step attacks do not cleave.
notes_zh: 太虚之径的攻击不会分裂。

description_en: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.
description_zh: 虚无之灵将自己包裹在保护性护盾之中，可以吸收物理伤害，并围绕自身发出一次伤害性脉冲。脉冲每击中一名敌方英雄，护盾的伤害吸收量都会提升。
lore_en: Inai never hesitates to shroud himself in the essence of his true self when forced to interact with the mortal plane.
lore_zh: 被迫与物质位面互动时，无玄从不犹豫将自己包裹在本真的精华中。
scepter_en: Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain 2 charges.
scepter_zh: 共鸣脉冲可以沉默敌人，并获得2点能量点数。

special_values.name: absorb_per_hero_hit
special_values.heading_zh: 每击中一个英雄护盾数值：

description_en: Attacks made with Astral Step deal a critical strike.
description_zh: 太虚之径产生的普通攻击造成致命一击。

description_en:
Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location.

Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.
description_zh:
獸向目标地点扔出一块岩石，对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。岩石无法扔向獸身边的最小范围内。岩石落地后会分裂成3块碎石，落在初始目标地点的后方。

砸每击中一名英雄都会增加咤的一层叠加效果。
lore_en: AGAIN WITH THE ROCKS!
lore_zh: 又是岩石！

description_en: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 小小进行持续施法，随机将自身周围的树木扔向目标范围。每棵树对该区域内敌人造成的伤害为小小的攻击伤害加上扔树的额外伤害。
lore_en: Sticks thrown from stones are like to shatter many bones.
lore_zh: 从石头上扔的木棍能打断很多骨头。

description_en: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has 90% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.
description_zh: 制造目标敌方英雄的墨色幻象。幻象为减益免疫状态，拥有90%魔法抗性，移动速度和继承攻击力超过本体。
lore_en: No dark creation is beyond the skill of the master's hand.
lore_zh: 没有暗黑的创造能逃得过大师之手的技艺。

description_en: CHANNELED - Allows Templar Assassin to teleport to any Psionic Trap after channeling for 2 seconds, detonating it upon arrival as if it was fully charged and instantly dealing 400 bonus damage. Channeling Psionic Projection does not break Meld.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 圣堂刺客经过2秒持续施法后可以传送至任意灵能陷阱，到达时引爆灵能陷阱，陷阱总是最大效果，并且立刻造成400点额外伤害。灵能投射在持续施法时不会脱离隐匿效果。
lore_en: In reward for her service, Lanaya has been granted access to secrets that unlock new techniques for her psionic gifts.
lore_zh: 作为她效忠的报酬，拉娜娅得以查探秘密，使她的灵能天赋解开了新的技巧。

name_en: Powershot Executes Enemy Heroes Under 16% Max HP
name_zh: 强力击斩杀16%血量下敌方英雄
description_en: Execute Threshold ranges from 10% to 16% Max HP based on the arrow's power.
description_zh: 斩杀临界值范围为10-16%最大生命值，取决于箭矢的威力

description_en: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
description_zh: 破晓辰星将她的战锤旋转3次，对敌人造成攻击伤害以及额外伤害。最后一次打击时，她将战锤击向地面，对她前方的敌人造成眩晕和伤害。
lore_en: Across the vast lineage of star progeny, there were multitudes unwilling to align with the aims of the Children of Light. To those who dared organize defiance, the Children would dispatch Valora and her hammer to show a measure of their power--to leave the rebels either shattered or set back to rights.
lore_zh: 在星辰后裔的庞大血脉中，有许多不愿追随光之子。对于胆敢挑战的星宿，光之子就会派出维罗拉和她的重锤，展示出他们的力量——让反对者粉身碎骨或幡然醒悟。
notes_en: Dawnbreaker travels at a rate of 215 for the duration of the ability and takes a brief 0.2s to recover after the final strike.
Celestial Hammer or Solar Guardian cannot be cast during the combo.
Cleave does not work with this ability.
Can be self-cast to move forward.
The first two strikes will slow enemy movement speed by -100% for 0.12s.
notes_zh: 破晓辰星在技能持续时间内以215的移动速度行进，并且最后一击后需要0.2秒才能复原。
连击期间无法施放上界重锤或天光现世。
此技能不继承分裂效果。
可以对自身施放来向前移动。
前两次挥击会减少敌人-100%移动速度，持续0.12秒。
shard_en: Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity with 50% magic resistance and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by 35% down to a minimum of 215.
shard_zh: 破晓辰星在星破天惊期间获得减益免疫，50%魔法抗性加成和自由移动状态。破晓辰星会被减速35%，移速最低为215。

special_values.name: movespeed_bonus_self_max
special_values.heading_zh: 每次挥击的攻击速度加成：

special_values.name: movespeed_bonus_ally_max
special_values.heading_zh: 每次挥击的攻击速度加成（友军）：

description_en:
CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within 350 units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for 6s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.

After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.

Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
description_zh: 持续施法 - 破晓辰星在地图上任意友方英雄350距离内的一个地点创造一个脉冲效果，并制造持续6秒的白天。每次脉冲都会对敌人造成伤害，并治疗友军。经过一段短暂时间后，她飞向目标地点，落地时造成额外伤害并眩晕敌人。开始持续施法后，破晓辰星无法中止此技能。
lore_en: Only in defense of an ally will Valora relent to call upon the last reserves of her old powers that still allow cosmic flight.
lore_zh: 只有为了保护盟友，维罗拉才会愿意召唤最后一点她原先的力量来完成穿越宇宙的飞行。
notes_en: Pulse interval is 0.5s.
Total flight duration is 1.7 seconds of channel time + 0.8 of flight time.
Instantly recalls the Hammer on cast.
notes_zh: 脉冲间隔为0.5秒。
总飞行时间为1.7秒持续施法时间 + 0.8秒飞行时间。
施放时立刻召回战锤。
scepter_en: Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for 2s after landing.
scepter_zh: 天光现世的光环在破晓辰星落地后会跟随2秒。

description_en: Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for 2 seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
description_zh: 破晓辰星向一个目标扔出她的武器，对沿途的敌人造成伤害。战锤会在目的地停留2秒，再飞回她的手中，期间留下一道炽烈之径，减缓敌人的移动速度。破晓辰星可以随时召回战锤，将自身朝战锤牵引，使二者在中点相遇。
lore_en: The Brightmaul is Valora's oldest companion and sole remaining connection to the glow of her creators.
lore_zh: 光明之锤是维罗拉最长久的伙伴，也是她与创造者们的光芒之间仅存的维系。
notes_en: The hammer damages enemies both when thrown and when returning to Dawnbreaker.
Dawnbreaker's Converge movement distance is capped at the ability's cast range.
Starbreaker cannot be cast while the Hammer is out.
notes_zh: 战锤在飞出和飞回时都会对敌人造成伤害。
破晓辰星的会合移动距离不会超过技能的施法距离。
星破天惊无法在战锤脱手时施放。

description_en: After a number of attacks, Dawnbreaker powers up, charging her next attack with a critical hit that heals all allied heroes within 650 units around her for a portion of attack damage dealt. Creeps and neutral enemies provide less healing. Allies are healed for 50% of the amount.
description_zh: 破晓辰星在数次攻击后提升了力量，她的下一次攻击会造成致命一击，并治疗她附近650范围内所有友方英雄，治疗量为攻击伤害的一定百分比。攻击小兵和野怪产生的治疗量有所减少。对友军的治疗量为50%。
lore_en: Diminished in power without access to the Children's replenishing light, Valora can still recharge herself and her allies by creating order from the chaos which resides within each fight.
lore_zh: 由于接触不到光之子的光芒，力量无法恢复而不断衰退，但维罗拉还是从每场战斗中存在的混沌里创造了秩序，使自身和盟友得到休整。
notes_en: Luminosity Heal is increased by sources of Health Restoration Amplification.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
notes_zh: 熠熠生辉的治疗效果可以通过生命回复增强效果获得提升。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。

special_values.name: heal_from_creeps
special_values.heading_zh: 攻击普通单位治疗减少：

name_zh: +40% 上界重锤路径/战锤伤害
-1 熠熠生辉所需攻击次数

description_en:
Grimstroke paints a curved path of ink with his brush, damaging and slowing enemies. The damage is increased with each enemy the ink hits.

Can be put on alt-cast to have the path be straight.
description_zh:
天涯墨客画出一道弯曲的墨迹，对敌人造成伤害和减速。墨迹每碰到一个敌人，造成的伤害都会增加。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），使墨迹为直线。
lore_en: The corruptive force of Grimstroke's ink, drawn from the reservoir of his fallen people, consumes any enemy caught in its path.
lore_zh: 天涯墨客的墨迹带有腐化的力量，吸取自他死去的族人，将吞噬抓住的任何敌人。

special_values.name: bonus_damage_per_creep
special_values.heading_zh: 每个幻象/非英雄提高伤害：

name_en: +70% Stroke of Fate Speed and Travel Range

description_en:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.
description_zh:
召唤一个快速向目标移动的幻影，到达时将其缠住。缠住后对其造成伤害和沉默。若她在纠缠期间存活，将会撕裂目标，造成大量伤害，并刷新戾影的冷却时间。

英雄对幻影的单次攻击记为3次。
lore_en: Grimstroke holds no sorrow for the downfall of his people. Only for Yaovhi, she who was most dear to him, does he feel even a semblance of longing.
lore_zh: 天涯墨客并不为族人的毁灭感到悲伤。只有对瑶薇，他最亲近的女子，他才稍稍感觉到思念。
notes_en: The phantom falls off if the target becomes invisible or spell immune.
The phantom will return if the target dies during the latch.
notes_zh: 幻影在目标隐身或进入减益免疫状态后掉下。
目标在纠缠期间阵亡后幻影将会回归。

description_en: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After 3 seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.
description_zh: 天涯墨客将一个友方单位笼罩在一片墨汁中，目标的移动速度得到提升。友方单位附近的敌人会持续被墨须伤害。3秒后将根据墨须对英雄造成伤害的时间对区域内单位造成伤害和眩晕。
lore_en: Now that the rise of the ink tide no longer threatens to overwhelm Grimstroke, its tendrils of power are never far from his hand.
lore_zh: 既然高涨的墨潮不再对天涯墨客构成威胁，那么力量的墨须就不难为他所用。
shard_en:
Ink Swell dispels the allied unit when cast. Causes Ink Swell to deal 40% more damage and heal the target for 40% of the damage Ink Swell deals.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
shard_zh:
墨涌在施放时会驱散友方单位。墨涌造成的伤害增加40%，并且治疗目标，治疗量为墨涌造成伤害的40%。

驱散类型：弱驱散

description_en: Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, 80% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn. Can be cast during Rolling Thunder to temporarily hit the brakes. Can cast Rolling Thunder and Shield Crash during Roll Up. If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.
description_zh: 石鳞剑士将自身卷成保护性的圆球，获得减益免疫状态，拥有80%魔法抗性加成，并且可以转身。可以在地雷滚滚期间施放，暂停滚动。可以在卷土重来期间施放地雷滚滚和甲盾冲击。若敌人在此期间发动攻击，将滚离攻击者，对途中的敌人施加地雷滚滚的伤害/眩晕。
lore_en: It requires deft tailwork and immense balance to defy momentum in the heart of battle.
lore_zh: 在战场的中心，需要灵巧的尾巴和极强的平衡感才能抵挡住各方的来势。

description_en:
Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. Can take 4 hero hits or 8 creep hits and when destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it.

Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 hero attack if there are no other enemies in range.

Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 hero attack.
description_zh:
在目标地点创造一根寒冰尖柱，减缓范围内敌人的移动速度。可以承受4次英雄攻击或8次非英雄攻击，并且被摧毁时会在附近产生一个寒霜爆发的效果。

连环霜冻可以对尖柱施放，并且范围内没有其他敌人时可以弹跳至冰柱上，同时对尖柱造成1点英雄攻击。

巫妖可以对其施放冰霜魔盾。冰霜魔盾每次造成伤害时会治疗尖柱，使其回复1次英雄攻击次数。
lore_en: The waters within the Black Pool remain liquid far below the point of freezing and immediately crystallize when removed.
lore_zh: 暗黑之湖的水远在冰点之下，但仍处于液态，取走以后立刻结晶。

description_en: Available for 1.5 seconds after landing Time Walk. If used in this period, you will reverse your time walk back to your previous cast location. Does not affect health or proc scepter hits.
description_zh: 时间漫游落地后1.5秒内可使用。施放时，自身将逆转时间漫游，回到上一个施放地点。不会影响生命值或触发神杖效果。
lore_en: It's all relative.
lore_zh: 一切都是相对的。

description_en:
Hoodwink charges up and fires a deadly bolt from her crossbow, dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero. The damage and debuff duration scale up to max after 3 seconds, and the bolt is fired automatically after 5 seconds.
Hoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of 350 from the force of the shot. Creeps hit by the bolt are damaged for half the values.
description_zh:
森海飞霞装载她的弩机，射出致命的一箭，对一名敌方英雄造成高额伤害，并施加破坏和减速效果。伤害和负面状态持续时间随着装载时间增加，3秒后达到最大效果，弩箭在5秒后自动发射。
由于弩箭的威力，森海飞霞后退350距离。弩箭穿过的非英雄单位会受到半额伤害。
lore_en: While her first arbalest was a chance discovery, Hoodwink now takes great care in carving and caring for her own -- of course with some necessary components pilfered or otherwise cleverly procured.
lore_zh: 虽然森海飞霞的第一把弩机是碰巧发现的，但现在她非常精心地雕刻她自己的劲弩，并且做好防护工作 - 当然，某些必要的部件是顺手牵羊得来的，不然就是通过机智的手段获得。
scepter_en: Increases arrow speed and movement speed slow.
scepter_zh: 提升箭矢速度和减速效果。

special_values.name: max_slow_debuff_duration
special_values.heading_zh: 最长负面状态持续时间：

description_en: Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.
description_zh: 森海飞霞变为隐身，提升移动速度，并且产生一个引诱敌人的幻象，幻象会瞄准最近的敌方英雄开始蓄力准备发射伤害较低的一箭穿心。如果幻象被攻击或被指向性技能击中，幻象将被摧毁并且攻击者将受到较弱的野地奇袭效果。
lore_en: The best traps trigger whether you touch them or not.
lore_zh: 最好的陷阱是不论有没有碰到都会触发。

description_en: Tosses a net trap that stuns enemies if they are near a tree in the area. Affected enemies take damage over time and are pulled towards the tree nearest to them within the target area, and have their vision reduced to 0 for the duration of the stun.
description_zh: 扔出一张网，对区域内靠近树木的敌人造成眩晕。敌人会持续受到伤害并被拖拽到目标区域内最近的树上，并且眩晕期间视野降低至0。
lore_en: Hoodwink favors Ironwood groves for ambushes, but the wary step carefully in all areas of the mistwoods.
lore_zh: 森海飞霞喜欢利用铁树之木的树丛来伏击，但机警的人在永雾林渊的所有地方都会小心行走。
notes_en: Units can be freed from the stun by destroying the tree.
Bushwhack does not hit invisible units.
notes_zh: 若树木被摧毁，被影响的单位将解除眩晕。
野地奇袭不会击中隐身单位。

description_en: Marci grabs an allied or enemy target and throws it effortlessly behind her, damaging and slowing the unit if it's an enemy. Any enemy units in the landing area will also be damaged and slowed.
description_zh: 玛西抓起一个友方或敌方目标，将其轻松地向她身后摔去，敌方目标将受到伤害并被减速。落地区域内所有敌方单位也会受到伤害并被减速。
lore_en: Marci excels at removing obstacles from Princess Mirana's path.
lore_zh: 玛西擅于扫除米拉娜公主在路上碰到的障碍。

description_en:
Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for 2s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for 1.5s.

Marci gains 15% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
description_zh:
玛西释放潜藏的力量，获得狂怒的猛攻效果，使自身可以发动快速的打击，并且降低打击目标的移动和攻击速度，持续2秒。每次狂怒连技的最后一击都会创造一个脉冲效果，对目标周围的敌人造成伤害。在狂怒连技的间隔，玛西无法攻击，持续1.5秒。

玛西施放怒拳破时移动速度提升15%。
lore_en: Though some have sought to understand its origins, Marci rebuffs all attempts to divine the source of her power.
lore_zh: 虽然有不少人在探究玛西神力的源头，但玛西对他们全不理睬。
notes_en: Once a Fury combo is started, each attack must be delivered within 1s or the Fury combo expires.
Removes attack speed limit.
notes_zh: 每次狂怒连技开始后，每次攻击都必须在1秒内完成，否则连技将会终止。
移除攻击速度限制。
scepter_en:
Reduces Unleash cooldown by 10 seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci. While Unleash is Active, all of Marci's abilities unleash pulses when cast. All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for 1 seconds.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
scepter_zh:
怒拳破的冷却时间减少10秒，并且施放时对玛西施加弱驱散。怒拳破生效期间，玛西的所有技能在施放时都会施放脉冲。玛西的所有怒拳破脉冲都会沉默敌人，持续1秒。

驱散类型：弱驱散

description_en:
Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

The ally receives 15 / 20 / 25 / 30% bonus movement speed for 4s.
description_zh:
玛西跃向友方目标单位，选好她要弹离的方向和距离。到达目标后玛西冲向最终的目的地，对落地点的敌人造成伤害和眩晕。

回身踢设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，玛西会把她的友军目标带向最终目的地。

友军将获得15 / 20 / 25 / 30%移动速度加成，持续4秒。
lore_en: With a friendly or brazen boost, Marci can find her way into the midst of any fight.
lore_zh: 有了他人亲切或粗暴的托垫，玛西可以直入任何焦灼的战斗中。
notes_en: Marci's initial run to her target unit can be disjointed.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Does not bring allies who are Rooted or Leashed when alt-cast.
notes_zh: 玛西冲刺时目标单位可以躲避该效果。
不会触发法术反弹。
多样施法时不会带走被缠绕或束缚的友军。
shard_en: Increases damage. Rebound can be cast on enemies, and causes Marci to also get the speed boost when she casts it.
shard_zh: 提升伤害。回身踢可以对敌人施放，并且玛西施放后自身也会获得加速效果。

name_zh: 100 回光返照献祭每秒伤害
description_en: Affects Abaddon and all enemies in a 400 AoE.
description_zh: 作用于亚巴顿和400范围内所有敌人。

name_zh: 威吓提供375 全伤害护盾

description_en: Dark Willow releases her pet wisp to terrorize her enemies. After a short delay, all enemies in the target area become fearful and run toward their home fountain. Terrorize cannot be used while Bedlam is active.
description_zh: 邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物恐吓她的敌人。经过一定延迟后，目标区域内所有敌人变得害怕，朝自己的泉水狂奔。作祟开启期间不能使用恐吓。
lore_en: You think you know the first thing about fear? Jex'll show you what that word truly means...
lore_zh: 你觉得你知道恐惧的意思？杰克斯会让你见识这词的真谛……
notes_en: Terrorize provides vision on affected units.
notes_zh: 恐吓提供受作用单位的视野。

description_en:
Fires Hoodwink's attack with an acorn at the target unit. The acorn bounces to nearby targets, slowing them and dealing a percentage of Hoodwink's attack with bonus damage.
If point targeted, a tree is created at the target position and the acorn will bounce to nearby targets. The ability may be placed on alt-cast to force this behavior.
description_zh:
森海飞霞向目标单位发射一颗橡栗，可以弹射至附近敌人，减缓他们的移动速度，并造成攻击伤害的一定百分比和额外伤害。
可以对地面施放，在目标地点种出一棵树，而橡栗会弹射至附近目标。设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后会强制沿用该行为。
lore_en: Though she'll make do with almost anything, Oak and Ironwood acorns make the most effective projectiles -- and the bulk of Hoodwink's stash.
lore_zh: 虽然她几乎什么都能凑合着用，不过橡树和铁树之木的栗子是最有效的炮弹——也是森海飞霞大部分的存货来源。
notes_en: The same target can be hit more than once.
Bounces will seek units in the fog of war in a 525 radius, but not invisible units.
The planted tree lasts for 20 seconds.
notes_zh: 同一个目标可以被击中超过一次。
弹射会搜寻525范围内战争迷雾中的单位，但无视隐身单位。
种下的树持续20秒。

name_zh: 自然之助期间+30移动速度
虚张声势+20% 攻击伤害

name_en: +8% Movement Speed per active Battle Hunger
name_zh: 每个战斗饥渴+8% 移速

name_en: Diabolic Edict Hits An Additional Target
name_zh: 恶魔敕令额外击中一个目标

description_en: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time. While active, the redirect chance of Mistwoods Wayfarer is multiplied by 2.
description_zh: 森海飞霞在短时间内获得移动速度加成，相位移动状态和穿行树木效果。开启时林渊旅人的转向几率为2倍。
lore_en: There's not a nook or cranny in the Wood Tomo'kan out of reach of Hoodwink's paws.
lore_zh: 托莫干森林里没有一处角落或者裂缝是森海飞霞的爪子够不着的。
